title: Non-Monotonic Exciton Transport Efficiency in Multi-layer Ring-shaped Quantum Networks inspired by Photosystem I
abstract: Photosystem I (PSI) is one of the most efficient natural photosynthetic complexes and serves as a structural prototype for understanding excitation energy transfer (EET) and designing artificial light-harvesting systems. Here, we construct a multilayer elliptical-conical quantum network inspired by PSI to investigate how antenna architecture affects EET. Excitation dynamics are simulated using the quantum jump approach combined with coherent modified Redfield theory (QJA-CMRT). The transfer efficiency exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence on pigment density, reaching a maximum of 0.86 at x=6 in the five-layer network. The optimal configuration contains 91 pigments, close to the number of core antenna pigments in natural PSI. Our combined density-of-states and kinetic analyses reveal that this nonmonotonic dependence originates from a trade-off: at low pigment densities, enhanced band overlap promotes energy transfer, whereas at high densities, excessive exciton delocalization compromises funnel directionality and reduces efficiency; the optimal configuration is consequently achieved at x=6. These findings provide insights into PSI antenna organization and offer guidelines for designing efficient artificial light-harvesting systems.
summary:
光系统 I (PSI) 是最有效的天然光合作用复合体之一，可作为理解激发能量转移 (EET) 和设计人工光捕获系统的结构原型。在这里，我们受 PSI 启发构建了一个多层椭圆锥体量子网络，以研究天线架构如何影响 EET。使用量子跳跃方法与相干修正雷德菲尔德理论 (QJA-CMRT) 相结合来模拟激发动力学。转移效率对颜料密度表现出明显的非单调依赖性，在五层网络中 x=6 时达到最大值 0.86。最佳配置包含 91 种颜料，接近天然 PSI 中核心天线颜料的数量。我们结合的态密度和动力学分析表明，这种非单调依赖性源于一种权衡：在低颜料密度下，增强的能带重叠促进能量转移，而在高密度下，过度的激子离域会损害漏斗方向性并降低效率；因此，在 x=6 时实现最佳配置。

这些发现提供了对 PSI 天线组织的见解，并为设计高效的人工光采集系统提供了指导。

title: Domain of Applicability of the Distorted Wave Born Approximation (DWBA): A Critical Analysis for X-ray and Visible-Light Interface Scattering
abstract: The Distorted Wave Born Approximation (DWBA) is established for X-ray interface scattering, yet its domain of applicability has never been stated explicitly. The DWBA implicitly rests on the small refractive index deviation (SRID) condition - satisfied by X-rays ($|n-1| \sim 10^{-6}$) but violated by visible light ($|n-1| \sim 0.5$). The DWBA mixes microscopic and macroscopic Maxwell equations, whereas a rigorous optical theory must be built on the macroscopic Maxwell equations and constitutive relations. Rigorous alternatives for two specific inconsistencies in the standard DWBA are discussed. The Extended Transfer Matrix Approach (ETMA) for visible-light interface scattering is outlined.
summary: 扭曲波生近似（DWBA）是针对 X 射线界面散射而建立的，但其适用范围从未明确说明。 DWBA 隐含地依赖于小折射率偏差 (SRID) 条件 - X 射线满足 ($|n-1| \sim 10^{-6}$) 但可见光违反 ($|n-1| \sim 0.5$)。 DWBA 混合了微观和宏观麦克斯韦方程组，而严格的光学理论必须建立在宏观麦克斯韦方程组和本构关系的基础上。讨论了针对标准 DWBA 中两个特定不一致问题的严格替代方案。概述了用于可见光界面散射的扩展传输矩阵方法 (ETMA)。

title: On physical implementability of reinforcement-learning-driven reasoning
abstract: In the machine learning community, the reinforcement-learning-driven reasoning process has been intensively studied since around 2025. In this article, we present a negative result on the hardware implementation of this reinforcement-learning-driven reasoning process in a physical neural network model in the presence of a reward external potential energy for a given reward. In this hardware implementation, the existence of a chain of thought in dynamics contradicts the Lyapunov stability of the system.
summary: 在机器学习社区中，自 2025 年左右以来，强化学习驱动的推理过程得到了深入研究。在本文中，我们在物理神经网络模型中，在给定奖励存在奖励外部势能的情况下，提出了这种强化学习驱动推理过程的硬件实现的负面结果。在这个硬件实现中，动力学思想链的存在与系统的李亚普诺夫稳定性相矛盾。

title: Electric-dipole-induced nuclear electric resonance in silicon
abstract: The nuclear spin of a phosphorus atom in silicon is considered as a promising quantum information carrier for quantum computing due to its long coherence time. Coherent control of the nuclear spin is typically realized using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). In this work, we theoretically propose that with the aid of hyperfine interactions and magnetic field gradients, fast electric-dipole-induced nuclear electric resonance (EDNER) can be achieved. The stronger EDNER (compared with NMR) arises from the combined effects of hyperfine interaction between the nuclear and electron spins and coupling between the electron spin and charge degrees of freedom mediated by magnetic field gradients in this scheme. By operating at specific working points, the nuclear-spin splitting becomes less sensitive to electrical noise, enabling long coherence times and high-fidelity quantum operations. All elctrical, addressable control of nuclear spins paves the way for scalable silicon-based quantum computing.
summary: 硅中磷原子的核自旋由于其相干时间长而被认为是量子计算有前途的量子信息载体。核自旋的相干控制通常使用核磁共振（NMR）来实现。在这项工作中，我们从理论上提出，借助超精细相互作用和磁场梯度，可以实现快速电偶极子诱导核电共振（EDNER）。更强的 EDNER（与 NMR 相比）源自该方案中核自旋和电子自旋之间的超精细相互作用以及由磁场梯度介导的电子自旋和电荷自由度之间的耦合的综合效应。通过在特定工作点运行，核自旋分裂对电噪声变得不太敏感，从而实现长相干时间和高保真量子操作。对核自旋的所有电气、可寻址控制为可扩展的基于硅的量子计算铺平了道路。

title: Exact SU($N$) symmetry resolution of bosonic Hubbard models: general boson-fermion mappings and flat-band singlet-cluster states
abstract: We show how to perform exact diagonalization of SU($N$)-symmetric Bose-Hubbard models separately in each irreducible representation of SU($N$), by exploiting the Howe duality between U($L$) and U($N$). Three structural consequences follow for any lattice and any Hamiltonian built from the U($L$) generators: (i) the spectrum in a given orbital sector is independent of $N$ and of the particle statistics, (ii) the canonical partition functions for bosons and fermions obey the exact identity $Z_{\mathrm{b}}(-N)=(-1)^{N_\mathrm{b}}Z_{\mathrm{f}}(N)$, (iii) with unfrustrated hopping the groundstate is always a color ferromagnet, so that the color-resolved method we introduce is useful to study excited sectors, frustrated lattices and finite temperatures. As applications, we first derive the finite-temperature phase diagram of attractive SU($N$) bosons on few-site rings at large $N$ for arbitrary filling. We then show the emergence of singlet-cluster states from frustrated hopping, the counterpart of fermionic ferromagnetism, with the example of the sawtooth and kagome lattice.
summary: 我们展示了如何通过利用 U($L$) 和 U($N$) 之间的豪对偶性，在 SU($N$) 的每个不可约表示中分别执行 SU($N$) 对称 Bose-Hubbard 模型的精确对角化。对于从 U($L$) 生成器构建的任何晶格和任何哈密顿量，都遵循三个结构后果：(i) 给定轨道扇区中的频谱独立于 $N$ 和粒子统计数据，(ii) 玻色子和费米子的规范配分函数遵循精确恒等式 $Z_{\mathrm{b}}(-N)=(-1)^{N_\mathrm{b}}Z_{\mathrm{f}}(N)$， （iii）在不受挫跳跃的情况下，基态始终是彩色铁磁体，因此我们引入的颜色解析方法可用于研究激发扇区、受挫晶格和有限温度。作为应用，我们首先推导出大$N$的少位环上吸引SU($N$)玻色子的有限温度相图，用于任意填充。然后，我们以锯齿晶格和戈薇晶格为例，展示了受挫跳跃（费米子铁磁性的对应物）单重态团簇态的出现。

title: Benchmarking machine-learning interatomic potentials using classical force fields
abstract: We propose a rational comparison between several well-known machine-learning interatomic potentials (linear atomic cluster expansion, the Behler-Parrinello high-dimensional neural network potential, and the graph neural network-based MACE potential) by testing their performance for fitting classical potentials such as the Lennard-Jones and Stillinger-Weber potential. With this we assess their advantages and limitations regarding several aspects: varying training dataset size, robustness to noise, carbon footprint, as well as the ability to reproduce the radial distribution function as an example observable. Overall the MACE models are shown to most accurately reproduce the potential energy surface, with little sign of overfitting, but at a significant computational cost, highlighting important questions regarding the choice of models in computational materials science.
summary: 我们通过测试几种著名的机器学习原子间势（线性原子团簇扩展、Behler-Parrinello 高维神经网络势和基于图神经网络的 MACE 势）对它们拟合经典势（如 Lennard-Jones 和 Stillinger-Weber 势）的性能进行理性比较。由此，我们评估了它们在几个方面的优点和局限性：不同的训练数据集大小、对噪声的鲁棒性、碳足迹，以及重现径向分布函数作为可观察示例的能力。总体而言，MACE 模型能够最准确地再现势能面，几乎没有过度拟合的迹象，但计算成本很高，这凸显了计算材料科学中模型选择的重要问题。

title: Explicit Solutions in a Probabilistic Cellular Automaton Model for Self-Assembled Monolayer Degradation
abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs), formed by the adsorption of a monomolecular layer of adsorbate onto a surface, have emerged as leading candidates for plat- forms for electrochemical biosensors. In order to characterize the working age of a SAM-based biosensor, it is necessary to understand the long-term degradation of the monolayer, with particular emphasis on the intermolecular forces present in the self-assembly process. In this work, discrete- and continuous-time proba- bilistic cellular automaton (PCA) models for the degradation of SAMs involving adsorbate-adsorbate interactions are proposed in which adsorbate molecules desorb at a rate dependent only on the number of adsorbed neighbors. Impor- tantly, we make no assumptions on the relationship between degradation rate and adsorbed neighbors. Using techniques from generating function theory and complex analysis, the expected degradation curve is solved for explicitly in one dimension and shown to be a sigmoid curve related to the Gompertz function.
summary: 自组装单分子层（SAM）是通过将吸附物的单分子层吸附到表面上而形成的，已成为电化学生物传感器平台的主要候选者。为了表征基于 SAM 的生物传感器的工作寿命，有必要了解单层的长期降解，特别强调自组装过程中存在的分子间力。在这项工作中，提出了涉及吸附物-吸附物相互作用的 SAM 降解的离散和连续时间概率元胞自动机 (PCA) 模型，其中吸附物分子解吸的速率仅取决于吸附的邻居的数量。重要的是，我们没有对降解率和吸附邻居之间的关系做出任何假设。使用生成函数理论和复分析技术，在一维中明确求解预期退化曲线，并显示为与 Gompertz 函数相关的 S 形曲线。

title: Competitive scaling of small-subsystem-optimization heuristics for LABS
abstract: The low autocorrelation binary sequences (LABS) problem, often formulated as a spin-lattice energy-minimization problem, is a combinatorial optimization problem with a very rugged energy landscape. We demonstrate that iterative optimization of very small subsystems of n spins that are decoupled from the rest of the system achieves global optimization of LABS with a time-to-solution scaling that is competitive with heuristics that optimize the global system of N spins directly. Our isolated-subsystem heuristic with n = 4 achieves a time scaling of O(1.333N ) on the interval N = [27, 60], while the current state-of-the-art classical and quantum scalings are respectively O(1.34N ) and O(1.21N ). Our results suggest that specialized optimization hardware with only small numbers of logical spins may be of practical relevance.
summary: 低自相关二元序列 (LABS) 问题通常被表述为自旋晶格能量最小化问题，是一个具有非常崎岖能量景观的组合优化问题。我们证明，对与系统其余部分分离的 n 个自旋的非常小的子系统进行迭代优化，可以实现 LABS 的全局优化，其解决方案时间缩放可与直接优化 N 个自旋的全局系统的启发式方法相媲美。我们的 n = 4 的孤立子系统启发式在区间 N = [27, 60] 上实现了 O(1.333N ) 的时间缩放，而当前最先进的经典和量子缩放分别为 O(1.34N ) 和 O(1.21N )。我们的结果表明，仅具有少量逻辑旋转的专门优化硬件可能具有实际意义。

title: Explicit Solvents Reverse Temperature Dependence of Phase Behavior in Charged Fluids
abstract: In most theories of electrolyte and polyelectrolyte solutions, the solvent is treated implicitly as a dielectric continuum. While this approximation has enabled major advances, it neglects coupling between ionic and dipolar degrees of freedom. Using molecular dynamics simulations and the mean-spherical approximation, we show that this coupling qualitatively alters electrostatically driven phase behaviour. At finite ion concentrations, many-body ion-dipole correlations reverse the temperature dependence of effective electrostatic interactions, leading to upper-critical solution temperature (UCST) behaviour in direct contrast to the lower-critical solution temperature (LCST) behaviour predicted by implicit-solvent electrostatic theories. This phase reversal arises from ion-induced suppression of local dipolar screening, a collective effect inaccessible to pairwise implicit-solvent descriptions.
summary: 在大多数电解质和聚电解质溶液的理论中，溶剂被隐含地视为介电连续体。虽然这种近似取得了重大进展，但它忽略了离子自由度和偶极自由度之间的耦合。使用分子动力学模拟和平均球近似，我们表明这种耦合定性地改变了静电驱动的相行为。在有限离子浓度下，多体离子偶极子相关性反转了有效静电相互作用的温度依赖性，导致上临界溶液温度（UCST）行为与隐式溶剂静电理论预测的下临界溶液温度（LCST）行为形成直接对比。这种相反转是由离子诱导的局部偶极屏蔽抑制引起的，这是成对隐式溶剂描述无法达到的集体效应。

title: Atoms that Matter: Largest Materials Datasets Are 99% Redundant, and Local Chemistry Can Guide the Required 1%
abstract: General-purpose machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) for materials are now trained on the order of $100$ million structures, assuming transferability requires such scale. We test this premise on OMat24, the largest available materials dataset, by training MACE models on subsets of $6.5$ million atoms, less than $1\%$ of OMat24, selected in three complementary ways: at random, by latent-space clustering of a pretrained MLFF (DIRECT), and by a new model-free method maximizing the diversity of discrete, interpretable local environments (EnvTok). All three models approach the full-data reference MACE-OMAT-0 model to within a few tens of $\mathrm{meV}/\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ in forces, and remain close to or exceed it on formation energies, elastic moduli, heat capacities, Li$^{+}$ migration barriers, and molecular-dynamics stability up to $3000\,$K and $500\,$GPa. This near-independence from the selection strategy shows that chemical environment diversity, not size, defines OMat24's information content: the remaining $99\%$ of structures are largely redundant. Broad sampling of chemical space thus remains essential, but reference labels are needed only for structurally and chemically distinct configurations. Using atomic positions and species, optionally augmented by magnetic moments, EnvTok identifies these before any labelling or training, yielding compact, architecture-independent datasets. This hundredfold reduction makes hybrid-DFT or higher-level relabelling of general-purpose training sets feasible, and frees computational budget for extending environmental coverage and multi-fidelity learning.
summary:
材料的通用机器学习力场 (MLFF) 现在以 1 亿美元的结构进行训练，假设可转移性需要这样的规模。我们在最大的可用材料数据集 OMat24 上测试这个前提，通过在价值 650 万美元的原子子集上训练 MACE 模型，这些原子的子集不到 OMat24 的 1\%$，以三种互补的方式选择：随机、通过预训练的 MLFF 的潜在空间聚类（DIRECT），以及通过一种新的无模型方法最大化离散、可解释的局部环境的多样性（EnvTok）。所有三个模型均接近全数据参考 MACE-OMAT-0 模型，其力值在 $\mathrm{meV}/\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ 范围内，并且在形成能、弹性模量、热容、Li$^{+}$ 迁移势垒以及高达 $3000\,$K 和 $500\,$GPa 的分子动力学稳定性方面保持接近或超过它。这种与选择策略近乎独立的情况表明，化学环境的多样性（而不是大小）定义了 OMat24 的信息内容：其余的 $99\%$ 结构在很大程度上是多余的。

因此，化学空间的广泛采样仍然至关重要，但仅对于结构和化学上不同的配置才需要参考标签。 EnvTok 使用原子位置和物种（可选择通过磁矩增强）在任何标记或训练之前识别这些位置和物种，从而生成紧凑的、独立于体系结构的数据集。这种数百倍的减少使得混合 DFT 或更高级的通用训练集重新标记变得可行，并释放计算预算以扩展环境覆盖范围和多保真度学习。

title: Pre-pairing and polarization of doped charge carriers in unconventional superconductors
abstract: Based on first principles calculations, we show in hole-doped La2-xSrxCuO4, the Sr dopants prefer to form dimers, rather than be isolated as generally believed. Same trend applies to other superconductors such as Na-doped Ca2CuO2Cl2, and electron type Nd2-xCexCuO4. The dimer structure makes the two doped holes (electrons) bound up and form a singlet which is also polarized. Another type of dopant in cuprates is oxygen which behaves similarly. So, we propose that, for all oxide high TC superconductors, the holes (electrons) are pre-paired (Z-pairs) during the preparation of the superconductor. The spontaneously formed Z-pairs are conceptually different from not only the Cooper pairs, but also the Zhang-Rice singlets. The attraction force in a Z-pair originates basically from the strong antiferromagnetic exchange energy. We also found that the on-site Coulomb repulsion (U) is no longer a constant due to doping. Around a doping site, U can reduce its value discontinuously, which plays a key role in stabilizing the Z-pairs against isolated holes (electrons). A Z-pair is a p-wave like localized state which breaks the symmetry of the CuO2 plain and attracts each other along the direction perpendicular to the polarization. The Z-pairs may be popular in all of the unconventional superconductors and the periodic assembly can result in the emergence of coherence states and superconductivity.
summary:
根据第一性原理计算，我们发现在空穴掺杂的 La2-xSrxCuO4 中，Sr 掺杂剂更喜欢形成二聚体，而不是像通常认为的那样被隔离。同样的趋势也适用于其他超导体，例如 Na 掺杂 Ca2CuO2Cl2 和电子型 Nd2-xCexCuO4。二聚体结构使两个掺杂空穴（电子）结合并形成单线态，该单线态也是极化的。铜酸盐中的另一种掺杂剂是氧，其行为类似。因此，我们建议，对于所有氧化物高TC超导体，空穴（电子）在超导体的制备过程中预先配对（Z对）。自发形成的 Z 对在概念上不仅不同于库珀对，而且也不同于张-赖斯单线态。 Z 对中的吸引力基本上源自强反铁磁交换能。我们还发现，由于掺杂，现场库仑斥力 (U) 不再是常数。在掺杂位点周围，U可以不连续地降低其值，这对于稳定Z对免受孤立空穴（电子）的影响起着关键作用。

Z 对是类似 p 波的局域态，它打破了 CuO2 平面的对称性，并沿垂直于偏振的方向相互吸引。 Z对可能在所有非常规超导体中都很流行，并且周期性组装可以导致相干态和超导性的出现。

title: Large Out-of-plane Polarization in Two-dimensional Bi2O3 Monolayers Predicted by an AI-driven Inverse-design Workflow
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) polar oxides with built-in electric fields offer promising opportunities for nanoscale electronics, optoelectronics, and surface charge engineering. However, their discovery remains challenging due to the enormous structural complexity of nonlayered oxide networks. Here, we combine inverse structural design with a machine-learning interatomic potential and first-principles calculations to explore 2D oxide configurations. Using Bi2O3 as a representative system, we identify two previously unreported polar monolayers with tetragonal and orthorhombic symmetries. Both structures exhibit vertically separated Bi and O sublayers, giving rise to pronounced intrinsic polarity with Berry-phase 2D polarizations of 34.12 and 37.15 pC/m, respectively. Notably, the o-Bi2O3 monolayer exhibits one of the largest reported out-of-plane polarizations among 2D oxides. Both monolayers exhibit dynamical stability, finite-temperature structural integrity, and wide band gaps (~3.8 eV). The large polarization originates from dimensionality-induced reconstruction of the nonlayered Bi-O network, which breaks local coordination symmetry and produces out-of-plane charge redistribution, while the stereochemically active Bi 6s2 lone pair further favors asymmetric Bi-O bonding. These findings suggest dimensionality-induced local-coordination symmetry breaking as a promising design motif for high-polarization 2D oxides, and demonstrate the utility of combining inverse design with machine-learning-assisted screening to explore unconventional polar phases in nonlayered oxide networks.
summary:
具有内置电场的二维（2D）极性氧化物为纳米级电子学、光电子学和表面电荷工程提供了有前景的机会。然而，由于非层状氧化物网络结构的巨大复杂性，他们的发现仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将逆向结构设计与机器学习原子间势和第一原理计算相结合，以探索二维氧化物构型。使用 Bi2O3 作为代表性系统，我们识别出两种先前未报道的具有四方和斜方对称性的极性单层。两种结构都表现出垂直分离的 Bi 和 O 子层，产生明显的固有极性，贝里相 2D 极化分别为 34.12 和 37.15 pC/m。值得注意的是，o-Bi2O3 单层表现出二维氧化物中最大的面外极化之一。两个单层均表现出动态稳定性、有限温度结构完整性和宽带隙（~3.8 eV）。

大极化源于非层状 Bi-O 网络的维数诱导重构，打破了局域配位对称性并产生面外电荷重新分布，而立体化学活性的 Bi 6s2 孤对电子进一步有利于不对称 Bi-O 键合。这些发现表明，维度引起的局部配位对称性破缺是高极化二维氧化物的一种有前途的设计主题，并证明了将逆向设计与机器学习辅助筛选相结合以探索非层状氧化物网络中非常规极性相的效用。

title: Fluctuation-based evaluation of thermal conductivity using deviational phonon Monte Carlo simulations
abstract: We develop a fluctuation based Monte Carlo method for evaluating thermal conductivity within the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) framework. Starting from the energy based variance reduced formulation of the BTE, we derive a relation between the spatial spreading of deviational phonon energy and the macroscopic heat conduction equation. The resulting formulation expresses thermal conductivity in terms of the mean square displacement of deviational phonon particles, without imposing thermal reservoirs. Consequently, thermal conductivity along multiple directions can be evaluated from a single simulation. The method is demonstrated for crystalline silicon at room temperature in bulk, square nanowires, and anisotropic polycrystalline nanostructures. The calculated thermal conductivities agree with theoretical predictions, including the size dependence induced by phonon boundary scattering and the mode-resolved contributions. For anisotropic polycrystalline structures, the method simultaneously resolves the directional thermal conductivities and captures their dependence on grain morphology. These results demonstrate the validity of the proposed fluctuation-based approach for evaluating thermal conductivity across different transport regimes and structural configurations.
summary:
我们开发了一种基于涨落的蒙特卡罗方法，用于评估声子玻尔兹曼输运方程 (BTE) 框架内的热导率。从 BTE 的基于能量的方差减少公式出发，我们推导了偏差声子能量的空间扩散与宏观热传导方程之间的关系。所得公式以偏差声子粒子的均方位移来表示热导率，而无需强加热库。因此，可以通过单个模拟来评估沿多个方向的导热率。该方法针对室温下的块体、方形纳米线和各向异性多晶纳米结构的晶体硅进行了演示。计算的热导率与理论预测一致，包括声子边界散射引起的尺寸依赖性和模式解析的贡献。对于各向异性多晶结构，该方法同时解析了定向热导率并捕获它们对晶粒形态的依赖性。

这些结果证明了所提出的基于波动的方法用于评估不同传输机制和结构配置的导热率的有效性。

title: Quantum Geometry and Pair Breaking in Intra- and Intervalley Superconductivity of Rhombohedral Graphene
abstract: The observation of superconductivity emerging from a spin- and valley-polarized normal state in rhombohedral graphene raises a basic puzzle: intravalley Cooper pairs involve states that are not generically degenerate because of trigonal warping, and therefore lack the particle--particle nesting underlying the conventional Cooper instability. While recent model studies suggest that nontrivial band geometry can strongly promote chiral pairing, how this geometric enhancement competes with realistic band-structure-induced pair breaking remains unclear. Here we study Kohn--Luttinger superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral tetralayer graphene using a DFT-fitted multiorbital tight-binding model, retaining the full Bloch-wave-function form factors in both RPA screening and the projected Cooper interaction. We separate the superconducting instability into three contributions: the symmetry-resolved form-factor-dressed interaction, the Cooper-pair phase space determined by the symmetrized pair dispersion, and the energy mismatch generated by trigonal warping. We find that the Bloch form factors strongly favor intravalley pairing, with a leading predominantly $p_x-ip_y$ instability and a substantially larger maximum $T_c$ than the intervalley reference state. At the same time, trigonal-warping-induced mismatch cuts off the Cooper logarithm and confines intravalley superconductivity to a much narrower region of the phase diagram. The dominant instability occurs near pair-Lifshitz transitions and primarily in reconstructed annular or three-lobed Fermi-surface regimes. Our results show that superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene is controlled by the combined effects of quantum-geometry-dressed interactions, pair fermiology, and trigonal-warping-induced pair breaking.
summary:
对菱面体石墨烯中自旋和谷极化正常态出现的超导性的观察提出了一个基本难题：谷内库珀对涉及由于三角翘曲而一般不会简并的状态，因此缺乏传统库珀不稳定性背后的粒子-粒子嵌套。虽然最近的模型研究表明，非平凡的能带几何形状可以强烈促进手性配对，但这种几何增强如何与现实的能带结构引起的配对断裂竞争仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用 DFT 拟合的多轨道紧束缚模型研究电子掺杂菱面体四层石墨烯中的 Kohn-Luttinger 超导性，在 RPA 筛选和预测库珀相互作用中保留完整的布洛赫波函数形状因子。我们将超导不稳定性分为三个部分：对称解析的形状因子修饰的相互作用、由对称对色散确定的库珀对相空间以及由三角翘曲产生的能量失配。

我们发现，布洛赫形状因子强烈支持谷内配对，其主要的 $p_x-ip_y$ 不稳定性和比区间参考状态大得多的最大 $T_c$ 。与此同时，三角翘曲引起的失配切断了库珀对数，并将谷内超导性限制在相图的一个更窄的区域。主要的不稳定性发生在对李夫席兹跃迁附近，并且主要发生在重建的环形或三瓣费米面区域中。我们的结果表明，菱面体石墨烯的超导性是由量子几何修饰的相互作用、电子对费米学和三角翘曲引起的电子对断裂的综合效应控制的。

title: Exotic metallic phase in a heterotic Kondo lattice: violation of Luttinger's theorem and absence of Kondo gap
abstract: Fermi surface transformation accompanied by quantum phase transition is widely observed in correlated electron systems including heavy fermion materials and van der Waals quantum heterostructures. The unified Anderson lattice description for this phenomenon suggests that their interacting ground states in the case of electron half filling always destabilize the metallic phase in the strong Kondo-coupling regime. We examine this issue within the paramagnetic phase of a Kondo lattice system with a heterotic layered structure. In the weak Kondo-coupling regime, the system exhibits a fractional Dirac liquid involving the massless or massive Dirac fermions and a charge neutral spinon Fermi surface. In the strong Kondo-coupling regime, the spinons hybridize with the Dirac fermions resulting in an intermediate nearly-flat hybridizing band together with the conduction and valence heavy fermion bands, yielding a large electric Fermi surface. Absence of the Kondo gap between these bands is observed depending on the stacking configurations of the layered structure. In particular, the system remains metallic even at the exact half filling in this regime and Luttinger's theorem is violated across the critical point. Implications of these results on the van der Waals quantum heterostructures are briefly discussed.
summary:
伴随量子相变的费米表面转变在相关电子系统中广泛观察到，包括重费米子材料和范德华量子异质结构。这种现象的统一安德森晶格描述表明，在电子半填充的情况下，它们相互作用的基态总是会破坏强近藤耦合状态下金属相的稳定性。我们在具有异质层状结构的近藤晶格系统的顺磁相中研究了这个问题。在弱近藤耦合状态下，系统表现出分数狄拉克液体，涉及无质量或重质量狄拉克费米子和电荷中性自旋费米表面。在强近藤耦合体系中，自旋子与狄拉克费米子杂交，产生中间近平坦的杂交带以及导带和价重费米子带，产生大的电费米面。根据层状结构的堆叠配置，观察到这些带之间不存在近藤能隙。

特别是，即使在该状态下精确的半填充下，系统仍保持金属性，并且在临界点上违反了拉廷格定理。简要讨论了这些结果对范德华量子异质结构的影响。

title: Crossed Electric Spin Generation in Multilayers
abstract: We propose a crossed electric spin generation effect in multilayer structures. This effect combines the advantages of in-plane and gate electric fields for manipulating spin, and unveils a nice quantum geometric structure in terms of the underlying hybrid Berry curvatures that are unique to quasi-2D systems and manifest inherent spin-layer-orbital coupling. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict sizable spin generation in 2D ferromagnetic Fe3GeTe2 and altermagnetic V2Te2O. Our theory opens a new Berry-curvature route for all-electric spin manipulation in 2D materials
summary: 我们提出了多层结构中的交叉电自旋产生效应。这种效应结合了面内电场和栅极电场在操纵自旋方面的优点，并根据潜在的混合贝里曲率揭示了一种良好的量子几何结构，这是准二维系统所独有的，并且表现出固有的自旋层轨道耦合。将我们的理论与第一性原理计算相结合，我们预测二维铁磁 Fe3GeTe2 和交变磁 V2Te2O 中会产生大量自旋。我们的理论为二维材料中的全电自旋操纵开辟了一条新的贝里曲率路线

title: Active remodeling rescues a microswimmer from geometric trapping
abstract: Natural habitats confront microorganisms with heterogeneous, mechanically complex surroundings that shape how they move and explore. Most studies of motility in complex media treat the environment as either a homogeneous fluid or a rigid obstacle field. Here we instead study a medium that is simultaneously soft and reconfigurable --- deformable by the organism moving through it. We track the unicellular biflagellate microalga \emph{Chlamydomonas reinhardtii} swimming in a soft, disordered suspension of microgel particles comparable in size to the cell itself, across a range of gel packing fractions. With increasing packing fraction, trajectories change from long straight runs to short, frequently reorienting ones, and the effective translational diffusivity decreases monotonically. The bimodal run/tumble speed distribution, characteristic of the free-swimming gait, collapses toward a single mode as the packing fraction increases, by near-proportional slowing of both gait states rather than a redistribution of cells between them. Recasting trajectories as alternating hops and traps reveals the signature of a deformable medium: hop lengths halve as the gel densifies, approaching the microgel aggregate scale, while trapping times do not increase with increasing packing fraction. Independent force estimates place the cell's propulsive force close to an order of magnitude above that needed to deform a single grain, so remodeling is expected rather than merely observed. A minimal \emph{active remodeler} model --- an active Brownian particle among mobile, rigid obstacles --- shows that obstacle mobility alone is sufficient to relocate the onset of permanent trapping. Thus, our results establish obstacle mobility as a control parameter for motility in soft, disordered matter.
summary:
自然栖息地使微生物面临着异质的、机械复杂的环境，这些环境决定了它们的移动和探索方式。大多数复杂介质运动研究都将环境视为均匀流体或刚性障碍场。在这里，我们研究的是一种既柔软又可重构的介质——可以通过在其中移动的有机体而变形。我们追踪单细胞双鞭毛微藻 \emph{莱茵衣藻} 在柔软、无序的微凝胶颗粒悬浮液中游动，微凝胶颗粒的大小与细胞本身相当，跨越一系列凝胶填充部分。随着堆积分数的增加，轨迹从长的直线变为短的、经常重新定向的轨迹，并且有效平移扩散率单调减小。双峰奔跑/翻滚速度分布是自由游泳步态的特征，随着堆积分数的增加，通过两种步态状态近乎成比例的减慢而不是它们之间的细胞重新分布，向单一模式崩溃。

将轨迹重铸为交替的跳跃和陷阱揭示了可变形介质的特征：随着凝胶致密化，跳跃长度减半，接近微凝胶聚集体规模，而捕获时间不会随着堆积分数的增加而增加。独立的力估计使细胞的推进力比单个颗粒变形所需的推进力高出接近一个数量级，因此重塑是预期的，而不仅仅是观察到的。最小\emph{主动重塑器}模型——移动的刚性障碍物中的活跃布朗粒子——表明仅障碍物的移动性就足以重新定位永久捕获的开始。因此，我们的结果将障碍物移动性确定为软无序物质运动的控制参数。

title: Emergent one-dimensional Bloch oscillations in coupled Ising layers
abstract: Bloch oscillations typically arise in periodic systems subjected to a constant force generated by a potential gradient. Here, we study domain-wall dynamics in coupled Ising layers under asymmetric longitudinal fields. The interlayer coupling is of Heisenberg type and acts as an effective transverse coupling in the emergent pseudospin representation. We show that the rung pseudospin structure gives rise to kinetic constraints, restricting the many-body dynamics to an emergent one-dimensional quasiparticle subspace within the original two-dimensional system. Furthermore, the imbalance between the longitudinal fields of the two layers induces an effective linear potential for the emergent domain-wall excitations, leading to their confinement between two oppositely polarized ferromagnetic domains. Remarkably, the resulting Wannier--Stark ladder of domain-wall excitations gives rise to Bloch oscillations in the absence of a conventional tilted potential, revealing a distinct mechanism for coherent quantum dynamics. Numerical simulations of time-dependent observables confirm the analytical predictions.
summary: 布洛赫振荡通常出现在受到势梯度产生的恒定力的周期性系统中。在这里，我们研究不对称纵向场下耦合伊辛层的畴壁动力学。层间耦合是海森堡型的，在出现的赝自旋表示中充当有效的横向耦合。我们表明，梯级赝自旋结构产生了动力学约束，将多体动力学限制在原始二维系统内的新兴一维准粒子子空间。此外，两层纵向场之间的不平衡会导致出现的磁畴壁激发产生有效的线性电势，从而导致它们被限制在两个相反极化的铁磁磁畴之间。值得注意的是，由此产生的畴壁激发的万尼尔-斯塔克阶梯在没有传统倾斜势的情况下引起了布洛赫振荡，揭示了相干量子动力学的独特机制。随时间变化的可观测值的数值模拟证实了分析预测。

title: A Higher-Order Stroh Framework for Weakly Nonlinear Post-Bifurcation Analysis
abstract: Linear stability analysis predicts the onset of wrinkling, while weakly nonlinear analysis determines whether the bifurcation is supercritical or subcritical through the sign of the cubic amplitude coefficient. When this coefficient vanishes, higher-order terms are needed. In this paper, we develop a higher-order Stroh framework for weakly nonlinear post-bifurcation analysis of finitely deformed elastic solids. For each nonzero harmonic, the same base-state Stroh operator is retained at every order, with nonlinear source terms assembled from lower-order fields to account for geometry, constitutive laws and constraints. This recursive structure, together with Fredholm solvability conditions, enables us to derive cubic, quintic and higher-order amplitude equations. Here, we demonstrate the power of this framework by analysing wrinkling in an incompressible neo-Hookean film bonded to an exponentially graded substrate. The results recover established linear instability benchmarks and the supercritical-subcritical transition in the homogeneous-substrate limit. For graded substrates, the cubic coefficient vanishes on a surface in the parameter space of modulus ratio and substrate gradation. On this surface, the quintic coefficient takes both signs, corresponding to supercritical and subcritical bifurcations. These regions are separated by a curve along which the quintic coefficient also vanishes. Determining the branch direction along this curve requires higher-order terms, which can be calculated within the same framework.
summary:
线性稳定性分析预测起皱的开始，而弱非线性分析则通过三次振幅系数的符号确定分岔是超临界还是亚临界。当该系数消失时，需要更高阶的项。在本文中，我们开发了一个高阶 Stroh 框架，用于有限变形弹性固体的弱非线性后分岔分析。对于每个非零谐波，在每个阶都保留相同的基态 Stroh 算子，并由低阶场组合而成的非线性源项来解释几何、本构定律和约束。这种递归结构与 Fredholm 可解性条件一起使我们能够导出三次、五次和高阶振幅方程。在这里，我们通过分析粘合到指数梯度基材上的不可压缩新胡克薄膜的皱纹来展示该框架的强大功能。结果恢复了既定的线性不稳定性基准和均质基底极限内的超临界-亚临界转变。

对于分级基材，立方系数在模量比和基材分级的参数空间中消失在表面上。在此表面上，五次系数具有两个符号，对应于超临界和亚临界分岔。这些区域由一条曲线分隔开，五次系数也沿着该曲线消失。确定沿该曲线的分支方向需要高阶项，这些项可以在同一框架内计算。

title: Pressure-transferable universal machine-learning potentials: the WBM-MatPES benchmark and Tuga-FF
abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials hold the promise to replace costly ab initio calculations in materials science workflows. However, the accuracy and transferability of current models are limited by the availability of training data. We release WBM-MatPES, a dataset of 182 thousand structures recomputed with consistent MatPES settings, together with two reference convex hulls of different depths and test sets at six pressures up to 150 GPa. These datasets reproduce a realistic discovery workflow and allow potentials to be ranked systematically at this level of theory, similar to the Matbench Discovery leaderboard at the Materials Project settings. In this benchmark, five published MatPES potentials agree within 12 meV/atom at 25 GPa, yet their errors increase dramatically to 0.4-5 eV/atom at 150 GPa. To address this limitation, we develop Tuga-FF, a graph transformer trained on datasets spanning ambient and high-pressure configurations alike. Tuga-FF is the most accurate model in the benchmark at ambient pressure, with an energy error of 13.6 meV/atom, and maintains an error of just 21 meV/atom at 150 GPa. We believe this benchmark will encourage the community to train higher-accuracy models and generate richer datasets, advancing machine-learned interatomic potentials as a whole.
summary:
通用机器学习原子间势有望取代材料科学工作流程中昂贵的从头计算。然而，当前模型的准确性和可转移性受到训练数据可用性的限制。我们发布了 WBM-MatPES，这是一个使用一致的 MatPES 设置重新计算的 182,000 个结构的数据集，以及两个不同深度的参考凸包和在高达 150 GPa 的六种压力下的测试集。这些数据集再现了现实的发现工作流程，并允许在这一理论水平上系统地对潜力进行排名，类似于材料项目设置中的 Matbench 发现排行榜。在此基准测试中，五个已发布的 MatPES 势在 25 GPa 下一致在 12 meV/原子内，但它们的误差在 150 GPa 下急剧增加至 0.4-5 eV/原子。为了解决这个限制，我们开发了 Tuga-FF，这是一种在跨越环境和高压配置的数据集上进行训练的图形转换器。 Tuga-FF 是环境压力下基准测试中最准确的模型，能量误差为 13.6 meV/atom，在 150 GPa 下保持误差仅为 21 meV/atom。

我们相信这个基准将鼓励社区训练更高精度的模型并生成更丰富的数据集，从而整体提升机器学习的原子间潜力。

title: Pressure-Driven Evolution of the Physical Properties of Layered Y2GaB and Y2InB MAB Phases: A Comparative First-Principles Study
abstract: MAB phases are nanolaminated ternary borides in which strong in-plane M-B bonds and weaker interlayer interactions drive their distinctive stability and functionality. Hydrostatic pressure offers a direct route to tune the in-plane and interlayer interactions that govern the stability and functionality of layered Y2GaB and Y2InB borides. Here, first-principles calculations are used to compare their structural, elastic, thermophysical, electronic, bonding, optical, and vibrational responses from 0 to 20 GPa. Elastic criteria show that Y2GaB is stable at 0, 5, and 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB is stable only at ambient pressure. Within the stable Y2GaB range, compression increases the elastic moduli, acoustic velocities, Debye temperature, and lattice thermal conductivity while reducing the elastic anisotropy. Both compounds are multiband metals and spin-orbit coupling modifies local dispersions without opening a gap. Y2GaB retains nine Fermi-surface sheets from 0 to 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB has eight at ambient pressure, with no pressure-induced topological reconstruction. Charge-density and overlap analyses indicate mixed ionic-covalent Y-B bonding within a delocalized metallic background. Optical parameters are anisotropic. Unit-cell phonon spectra contain positive frequencies at 0 and 10 GPa, although expanded-supercell calculations reveal low-frequency sensitivity. These results establish mechanically viable pressure windows and clarify substitution-driven structure-property relationships for these borides.
summary:
MAB 相是纳米层压三元硼化物，其中强的面内 M-B 键和较弱的层间相互作用驱动其独特的稳定性和功能。静水压力提供了调节面内和层间相互作用的直接途径，这些相互作用控制着层状 Y2GaB 和 Y2InB 硼化物的稳定性和功能。在这里，第一性原理计算用于比较它们在 0 至 20 GPa 范围内的结构、弹性、热物理、电子、键合、光学和振动响应。弹性标准表明，Y2GaB 在 0、5 和 10 GPa 下稳定，而 Y2InB 仅在环境压力下稳定。在稳定的 Y2GaB 范围内，压缩会增加弹性模量、声速、德拜温度和晶格热导率，同时降低弹性各向异性。这两种化合物都是多带金属，自旋轨道耦合可以在不打开间隙的情况下改变局部色散。 Y2GaB 在 0 至 10 GPa 范围内保留了 9 个费米面层，而 Y2InB 在环境压力下保留了 8 个费米面层，没有压力引起的拓扑重建。电荷密度和重叠分析表明，离域金属背景中存在混合的离子-共价 Y-B 键合。

光学参数是各向异性的。尽管扩展超晶胞计算揭示了低频灵敏度，但晶胞声子谱在 0 和 10 GPa 处包含正频率。这些结果建立了机械上可行的压力窗口，并阐明了这些硼化物的替代驱动的结构-性能关系。

title: Time-temperature-composition equivalence of the viscoelastic behavior through the glass transition of digitally mixed 3D-printed polymers
abstract: The linear viscoelastic behavior of a polymer shows an equivalence of loading frequency and temperature, the time-temperature equivalence (TTE). Horizontal shifting extends moduli measured over limited ranges to much wider ranges, through the glass transition. Multimaterial 3D printing has created digitally mixed polymers, a new class in which elastomeric and glassy resins are mixed voxel by voxel in prescribed ratios. Composition shifts the location and breadth of the glass transition and increases the rubbery modulus. Here we extend TTE to a time-temperature-composition equivalence (TTCE). Across all measured temperatures, frequencies, and compositions, the storage modulus collapses onto one master curve. Composition translates the transition and stretches its breadth, both linearly. The phase angle and relaxation spectrum superpose under the same operations, so the family shares one distribution of relaxation times. A single closed-form TTCE gives the storage and loss moduli of the family, guiding graded and architected designs for elasticity and dissipation.
summary: 聚合物的线性粘弹性行为显示了加载频率和温度的等效性，即时间-温度等效性（TTE）。通过玻璃化转变，水平位移将在有限范围内测量的模量扩展到更宽的范围。多材料 3D 打印创造了数字混合聚合物，这是一种新类型，其中弹性体和玻璃状树脂按规定的比例逐个体素地混合。成分改变了玻璃化转变的位置和宽度并增加了橡胶模量。在这里，我们将 TTE 扩展到时间-温度-成分等价（TTCE）。在所有测量的温度、频率和成分中，储能模量都集中在一条主曲线上。构图平移了过渡并延伸了其宽度，两者都是线性的。相位角和弛豫谱在相同的操作下叠加，因此该族共享一种弛豫时间分布。单个封闭式 TTCE 提供了该系列的存储模量和损耗模量，指导弹性和耗散的分级和架构设计。

title: EpNet-Si: Atomic Form Factors Learned from Band Structures
abstract: The empirical pseudopotential method (EPM) computes band structures with one diagonalization per $k$ point and no self-consistency, but its fixed atomic form factors do not transfer between crystal structures. To address this limitation, we introduce EpNet-Si, an EPM for silicon in which an equivariant network predicts each atom's plane-wave form factor from its local environment: a species potential plus monopole, dipole and quadrupole corrections, mixed by a learned router over atomic densities, together with an $s/p$ nonlocal projector. With 6{,}195 parameters, the model is trained through the eigensolver on reference density functional theory (DFT) band energies of only 77 cells. Among 231 distortions of the trained structure types, the 142 gapped cells have mean band and gap errors of 15 and 8\,meV; among 192 unseen structures, the 165 gapped cells have mean errors of 38 and 49\,meV. Physical properties derived from EpNet-Si, including effective masses, gap pressure coefficients, deformation potentials and the density of states at the Fermi level, agree with those obtained from the reference DFT calculations. These results suggest that the classical EPM, fitted to a small set of reference data, can be extended into a fast alternative for modern electronic band-structure calculations.
summary:
经验赝势法 (EPM) 计算能带结构时，每 $k$ 点有一次对角化，并且没有自洽性，但其固定的原子形状因子不会在晶体结构之间转移。为了解决这个限制，我们引入了 EpNet-Si，一种用于硅的 EPM，其中等变网络根据其局部环境预测每个原子的平面波形状因子：物种势加上单极子、偶极子和四极子校正，由学习路由器在原子密度上混合，以及 $s/p$ 非局部投影仪。该模型具有 6{,}195 个参数，通过特征求解器在仅 77 个单元的参考密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能带能量上进行训练。在训练的结构类型的 231 个扭曲中，142 个带隙单元的平均带和带隙误差分别为 15 和 8meV；在 192 个看不见的结构中，165 个有间隙的单元的平均误差分别为 38 和 49meV。从 EpNet-Si 得出的物理性质，包括有效质量、间隙压力系数、变形势和费米能级的态密度，与参考 DFT 计算获得的物理性质一致。

这些结果表明，适合一小组参考数据的经典 EPM 可以扩展到现代电子能带结构计算的快速替代方案。

title: Spectral Mapping Theorem between SU(N) and SU(Ns/N) Heisenberg Models and Exact Diagonalization of SU(4) and SU(7) Long-Range Ordered Phases on the Triangular Lattice
abstract: We first show that, for the SU(N) Heisenberg model with isotropic two-site interactions on an arbitrary lattice of Ns sites, the full spectrum in its singlet sector (when N divides Ns) is the negative of the full spectrum in its singlet sector of the SU(Ns/N) Heisenberg model defined on the same lattice. This theorem, valid for models with the fundamental irreducible representation (irrep) at each lattice site, follows naturally from a transposition operation in the basis of Standard Young Tableaux (SYTs). Second, this basis -- previously recognized as particularly convenient for exact diagonalization (ED) of SU(N) Heisenberg models -- admits an efficient, memory-saving implementation, thereby enabling large-scale diagonalizations for unprecedented system sizes Ns and numbers of colors N>3. We apply these ideas to an ED study of the SU(4) and SU(7) Heisenberg models on the triangular lattice (TL), extending the calculations up to Ns=28 sites. In particular, starting from the SU(4) case, whose nearest-neighbor ground state remains debated, we confirm that next-nearest-neighbor couplings stabilize four-sublattice long-range order. We further find that increasing the number of colors from N=4 to N=7 provides another route toward a Néel-like ground state, even without such additional couplings. N = 4 to N = 7 provides another route toward a Néel-like ground state, even without such additional couplings.
summary:
我们首先证明，对于在 Ns 位点的任意晶格上具有各向同性两位点相互作用的 SU(N) 海森堡模型，其单重态扇区中的全光谱（当 N 除 Ns 时）是在同一晶格上定义的 SU(Ns/N) 海森堡模型的单重态扇区中的全光谱的负数。该定理对于每个格点处具有基本不可约表示 (irrep) 的模型有效，自然地从基于标准 Young Tableaux (SYT) 的转置运算得出。其次，这一基础——以前被认为对 SU(N) 海森堡模型的精确对角化 (ED) 特别方便——承认一种高效、节省内存的实现，从而能够实现前所未有的系统尺寸 Ns 和颜色数量 N>3 的大规模对角化。我们将这些想法应用于三角晶格 (TL) 上 SU(4) 和 SU(7) 海森堡模型的 ED 研究，将计算扩展到 Ns=28 个位点。特别是，从 SU(4) 的情况开始，其最近邻基态仍存在争议，我们证实次近邻耦合稳定了四子晶格的长程有序。

我们进一步发现，即使没有这种额外的耦合，将颜色数量从 N=4 增加到 N=7 也提供了另一条通往类尼尔基态的途径。 N = 4 到 N = 7 提供了另一条通往类似 Néel 基态的途径，即使没有这种额外的耦合。

title: Nucleation at the GST--oxide interface and beam-driven ordering in amorphous Ge--Sb--Te: HAADF, EDS and electron pair distribution functions across a 4D-STEM dose series
abstract: Where crystal nuclei form in amorphous phase-change materials decides how they switch. We study six successive 4D-STEM scans, with simultaneous HAADF and EDS data, of a magnetron-sputtered Ge-Sb-Te (GST) film, restricted to the GST layer and its interface with the oxide beneath it. Nucleation sites do not differ in composition or number density: the nuclei lie on the same robust HAADF-EDS relation as the matrix, and at fixed HAADF the spread of the summed EDS signal equals its Poisson counting noise (ratio 1.03 +- 0.05). The nuclei are nevertheless crystalline and stand out in the 4D-STEM max-intensity virtual image (median z = 11.0) but not in HAADF (z = 1.3) or EDS (z = 0.3). We classify the film in four ways (HAADF intensity, I(q) phase mapping, PCA of the whole diffraction patterns and a self-supervised SimCLR encoder) and compare the electron pair distribution functions (PDFs) of all classes after calibrating reciprocal space on the Au cap. All bulk classes share one short-range structure (first shell 2.70-2.74 Å); towards the interface the first sharp diffraction peak (FSDP) moves to lower q, and every method isolates a thin interface-edge environment with a shorter or missing first shell. The I(q) classification isolates, in every scan, an interface environment that holds 62-100% of the nucleus pixels (1.2-2.5-fold above depth) and persists when the nucleus pixels are removed before classification. The interface, rather than a distinct composition or density of the nucleating volume, therefore marks where nuclei form. Over 4.7e3 e/Å^2 the HAADF signal falls by 17%, the first shell shortens by 0.03 Å and the FSDP narrows by 9%, apparently ordering the film as it damages it. All analyses used PySTEMLab, an interactive 4D-STEM analysis environment developed for this work.
summary:
非晶相变材料中晶核形成的位置决定了它们如何转变。我们研究了磁控溅射 Ge-Sb-Te (GST) 薄膜的六次连续 4D-STEM 扫描，同时使用 HAADF 和 EDS 数据，仅限于 GST 层及其与其下方氧化物的界面。成核位点在成分或数量密度上没有差异：核位于与基质相同的稳健的 HAADF-EDS 关系上，并且在固定的 HAADF 处，总 EDS 信号的扩散等于其泊松计数噪声（比率 1.03 ± 0.05）。然而，原子核是晶体，在 4D-STEM 最大强度虚像（中值 z = 11.0）中很突出，但在 HAADF (z = 1.3) 或 EDS (z = 0.3) 中则不然。我们以四种方式对薄膜进行分类（HAADF 强度、I(q) 相位映射、整个衍射图案的 PCA 和自监督 SimCLR 编码器），并在校准金帽上的倒易空间后比较所有类别的电子对分布函数 (PDF)。

所有块体类别共享一个短程结构（第一壳层 2.70-2.74 Å）；朝向界面，第一个尖锐的衍射峰（FSDP）移动到较低的 q，并且每​​种方法都隔离具有更短或缺失的第一壳的薄界面边缘环境。 I(q) 分类在每次扫描中隔离一个界面环境，该界面环境容纳 62-100% 的核像素（深度的 1.2-2.5 倍），并且在分类前移除核像素时仍然存在。因此，界面，而不是成核体积的独特组成或密度，标记了核形成的位置。超过 4.7e3 e/Å^2，HAADF 信号下降 17%，第一个壳缩短 0.03 Å，FSDP 变窄 9%，显然是在薄膜损坏时对其进行排序。所有分析均使用 PySTEMLab，这是为此工作开发的交互式 4D-STEM 分析环境。

title: Local Suppression of Superconductivity in Niobium Films by Focused Silicon Ion Implantation
abstract: Magnetic flux trapped in a superconducting circuit shifts the critical currents of nearby Josephson junctions and disturbs the operation of the circuit. The usual remedy is a moat etched through the ground plane to hold the flux away from the logic. We report direct write silicon ion implantation with a focused ion beam as a way to make moats without etching the film, by locally suppressing superconductivity in niobium (Nb). Single implanted lines were written across Nb electrodes in films of three thicknesses over two orders of magnitude in ion fluence, and the transition temperature, resistance, and critical current density of each line were measured. The transition temperature of the line falls with fluence while the surrounding Nb is unchanged, and the critical current density falls by about two orders of magnitude before the line becomes resistive at 4.2 K. The product of the critical current and the resistance of the lines follows a single power law in reduced temperature. This gives an estimate of the critical current of a line at any temperature from its transition temperature and resistance. A time dependent Ginzburg-Landau simulation indicates that an implanted region can capture and hold a vortex. From these results we suggest a starting ion energy and fluence for implanted moats in a 100 nm Nb ground plane at 4.2 K and estimate the equivalent broad beam fluence.
summary:
超导电路中捕获的磁通量会改变附近约瑟夫森结的临界电流，并干扰电路的运行。通常的补救措施是在接地平面上蚀刻一条护城河，以阻止磁通量远离逻辑。我们报道了使用聚焦离子束直写硅离子注入，通过局部抑制铌（Nb）的超导性，在不蚀刻薄膜的情况下形成护城河。在离子注量超过两个数量级的三种厚度的薄膜中，在铌电极上写入单条注入线，并测量每条线的转变温度、电阻和临界电流密度。当周围的 Nb 不变时，线路的转变温度随注量下降，并且在线路在 4.2 K 处变成电阻之前，临界电流密度下降了大约两个数量级。在降低的温度下，临界电流和线路电阻的乘积遵循单一幂律。这可以根据线路的转变温度和电阻来估计任何温度下线路的临界电流。

与时间相关的金兹堡-兰道模拟表明，植入区域可以捕获并保持涡流。根据这些结果，我们建议 4.2 K 下 100 nm Nb 接地平面中注入护城河的起始离子能量和注量，并估计等效宽束注量。

title: Valley-resolved high harmonics probe symmetry breaking beyond the Dirac cone
abstract: Low-energy electrons in graphene obey an emergent, rotationally invariant Dirac equation, while the honeycomb lattice enters only through higher-order, symmetry-breaking corrections, the leading one being trigonal warping. This provides a unique solid-state arena to address a cornerstone challenge in quantum gravity: how to detect ultraviolet symmetry-breaking granular corrections, suppressed by a fundamental scale, atop an emergent infrared relativistic continuum. We show that intense counter-rotating $\omega$-$2\omega$ fields and valley-resolved high-harmonic generation (HHG) provide such a probe. Within a family of models that interpolates continuously between the isotropic Dirac cone and nearest-neighbour graphene at fixed Fermi velocity, the valley contrast of the harmonic yield vanishes identically in the symmetric theory, grows linearly with the warping coupling, and its valley-even counterpart appears only at second order, as expected from effective-field-theory power counting. The stronger the laser, the farther it drives electrons from the Dirac points, so the laser intensity plays the role of the collision energy. For the fourth harmonic, the leading warping correction alone accounts for the valley contrast of real graphene up to fundamental intensities of about $10^{11}$ W/cm$^2$, below the damage threshold of monolayer graphene, whereas the fifth harmonic already reveals higher-order lattice corrections at intensities around $10^{10}$ W/cm$^2$. The two harmonics, which rotate in opposite directions, are emitted by opposite valleys. Valley-resolved harmonics are far more sensitive than the residual valley populations, making them a practical detector of lattice-scale physics hidden beneath an emergent Dirac theory.
summary:
石墨烯中的低能电子遵循新兴的、旋转不变的狄拉克方程，而蜂窝晶格只能通过高阶、对称破缺校正进入，其中最主要的校正是三角翘曲。这提供了一个独特的固态舞台来解决量子引力中的基石挑战：如何在新兴的红外相对论连续体之上检测被基本尺度抑制的紫外线对称性破缺的颗粒校正。我们证明，强烈的反向旋转 $\omega$-$2\omega$ 场和谷分辨高次谐波产生（HHG）提供了这样的探针。在以固定费米速度在各向同性狄拉克锥和最近邻石墨烯之间连续插值的一系列模型中，谐波产额的谷对比度在对称理论中同样消失，随着翘曲耦合线性增长，而其谷偶对应物仅出现在二阶，正如有效场理论功率计数所预期的那样。激光越强，驱动电子距离狄拉克点越远，因此激光强度起到了碰撞能量的作用。

对于第四次谐波，仅领先的翘曲校正就可以解释真实石墨烯的谷对比度高达约 $10^{11}$ W/cm$^2$ 的基本强度，低于单层石墨烯的损伤阈值，而第五次谐波已经揭示了强度约为 $10^{10}$ W/cm$^2$ 的高阶晶格校正。沿相反方向旋转的两个谐波由相反的波谷发出。谷分辨谐波比剩余谷群灵敏得多，使它们成为隐藏在新兴狄拉克理论之下的晶格尺度物理的实用探测器。

title: Weyl's theorem and the theoretical origin of Boson peak in two-dimensional scalar spring network
abstract: The origin of the anomalous low-frequency vibrational density of states (VDOS) universally observed in amorphous solids has been debated for decades. In this work, we model amorphous solids as a zero-temperature scalar spring network, the simplest model that captures both the amorphous structure and the features of the anomalous VDOS. Using this scalar network, we mathematically demonstrate that disorder can lead to a shift of the VDOS toward low frequencies, thereby accumulating the anomalous part there. Disorder is defined through the topological connectivity of the network. The validity and universality of the theoretical framework are general and valuable for real-world scenarios because it rests only on Weyl's theorem for Hermitian matrices and is free of perturbation and phenomenological assumptions. This work strips away complex factors and reveals, at the level of mathematical principles, a profound and clean mechanism for the origin of the anomalous VDOS in amorphous solids.
summary: 在非晶固体中普遍观察到的异常低频振动态密度（VDOS）的起源已经争论了几十年。在这项工作中，我们将非晶固体建模为零温标量弹簧网络，这是捕获非晶结构和反常 VDOS 特征的最简单模型。使用这个标量网络，我们在数学上证明了无序可以导致 VDOS 向低频移动，从而在那里积累异常部分。无序是通过网络的拓扑连接性来定义的。该理论框架的有效性和普遍性对于现实世界场景来说具有普遍性和价值，因为它仅基于埃尔米特矩阵的韦尔定理，并且不受扰动和现象学假设的影响。这项工作剥离了复杂的因素，并在数学原理的层面上揭示了非晶固体中异常 VDOS 起源的深刻而清晰的机制。

title: Matrix-product-state GPLHR for non-Hermitian many-body eigenproblems
abstract: Computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators plays an important role in investigating excitation spectra, spectral properties, and relaxation dynamics in interacting and open quantum systems. However, this task is challenging because the eigenvectors are generally nonorthogonal and the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with system size. Here, we formulate the generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual (GPLHR) method in a matrix product state (MPS) framework to efficiently compute multiple targeted right eigenstates whose eigenvalues lie near a specified shift in the complex plane. Successive randomized compression (SRC) is employed to accelerate operator applications. We test the method on transcorrelated and complex Hubbard chains, an interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain, and a Liouvillian model. The results demonstrate that GPLHR combined with MPS provides an efficient and accurate approach for computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators.
summary: 计算非厄米多体算子的多个本征态在研究相互作用和开放量子系统中的激发光谱、光谱特性和弛豫动力学方面发挥着重要作用。然而，这项任务具有挑战性，因为特征向量通常是非正交的，并且希尔伯特空间维度随着系统规模呈指数增长。在这里，我们在矩阵乘积状态（MPS）框架中制定了广义预条件局部谐波残差（GPLHR）方法，以有效计算其特征值位于复平面中指定位移附近的多个目标右本征态。采用连续随机压缩（SRC）来加速算子应用程序。我们在互相关和复杂的 Hubbard 链、交互的非厄米 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链和 Liouvillian 模型上测试了该方法。结果表明，GPLHR 与 MPS 相结合，为计算非 Hermitian 多体算子的多个本征态提供了一种高效、准确的方法。

title: Extended-range percolation on lattices with cubic and non-compact neighborhoods in three dimensions
abstract: Using MC simulations based on an efficient single-cluster growth algorithm, we investigate two types of three-dimensional extended-range percolation models, namely cubic and complex (non-compact) neighborhoods. We obtain high-precision percolation thresholds $p_c$ for approximately 100 distinct structures and further explore the relationship between these thresholds and the topology of the lattices, which includes the total coordination number $z$, the number of sites $z_i$ and these sites' distance to the central site $r_i$ of the given neighborhood in the $i$th coordination zone. Both bond and site percolation are analyzed for cubic neighborhoods on the SC lattice. For bond percolation, the asymptotic value of $zp_c$ tends to Bethe-lattice behavior ($zp_c\sim1$), and finite-$z$ correction is found to be consistent with $zp_{c}-1\sim a_{1}z^{-x}$, where $x=(d-1)/d$. For site percolation, the value of $zp_c$ varies non-monotonically, exhibiting an initial increase followed by a decrease with the coordination number $z$. Linear fitting leads to $zp_c\sim2.5987(1)$ for large $z$, predicting a value of continuum percolation threshold of aligned cubes $\eta_c=0.324838(12)$ using $zp_c=2^{d}\eta_c$. We then examine site percolation for non-compact neighborhoods extending to the fifth coordination zone on SC, FCC, and BCC lattices. Through a comparison of the three indices of $z$, $\xi=\sum_iz_ir_i^2/i$, and $\zeta=\sum_iz_ir_i$, we find that $\zeta$ is effective in removing the degeneracy. The results obtained show power-law dependence $p_c\propto(\zeta/K)^{-\gamma}$ with $\gamma_{\mathrm{SC}}^{\zeta}=0.703(12)$, $\gamma_{\mathrm{FCC}}^{\zeta}=0.728(10)$, and $\gamma_{\mathrm{BCC}}^{\zeta}=0.699(12)$ for SC, FCC, and BCC lattices, and $p_c\propto\zeta^{-\gamma}$ with $\gamma^{\zeta}=0.719(9)$ independent of the underlying lattice. The number $K$ indicates lattice connectivity.
summary:
使用基于高效单簇增长算法的 MC 模拟，我们研究了两种类型的三维扩展范围渗流模型，即立方邻域和复杂（非紧致）邻域。我们获得了大约 100 个不同结构的高精度渗滤阈值 $p_c$，并进一步探讨了这些阈值与晶格拓扑之间的关系，其中包括总配位数 $z$、站点数量 $z_i$ 以及这些站点到第 $i$ 个协调区域中给定邻域的中心站点 $r_i$ 的距离。对 SC 晶格上的立方邻域的键和位点渗透进行了分析。对于键渗流，$zp_c$ 的渐近值趋向于 Bethe 晶格行为 ($zp_c\sim1$)，并且发现有限 $z$ 校正与 $zp_{c}-1\sim a_{1}z^{-x}$ 一致，其中 $x=(d-1)/d$。对于位点渗透，$zp_c$ 的值非单调变化，随着配位数 $z$ 的变化，先增加后减少。

对于大$z$，线性拟合导致$zp_c\sim2.5987(1)$，使用$zp_c=2^{d}\eta_c$预测对齐立方体$\eta_c=0.324838(12)$的连续渗流阈值。然后，我们检查延伸至 SC、FCC 和 BCC 网格上第五个协调区的非紧凑邻域的场地渗透。通过$z$、$\xi=\sum_iz_ir_i^2/i$和$\zeta=\sum_iz_ir_i$这三个指标的比较，我们发现$\zeta$对于消除简并性是有效的。所得结果显示幂律依赖性 $p_c\propto(\zeta/K)^{-\gamma}$ 且 $\gamma_{\mathrm{SC}}^{\zeta}=0.703(12)$、$\gamma_{\mathrm{FCC}}^{\zeta}=0.728(10)$，以及$\gamma_{\mathrm{BCC}}^{\zeta}=0.699(12)$ 对于 SC、FCC 和 BCC 晶格，$p_c\propto\zeta^{-\gamma}$ 与 $\gamma^{\zeta}=0.719(9)$ 独立于底层晶格。数字$K$表示晶格连通性。

title: Non-Hermitian Two-Kink Control of Corner States in Twisted Chern Bilayers
abstract: Corner states are bound by boundary-mass defects, but this geometric anchoring restricts their spatial and internal control. Focusing on twisted bilayers assembled from Chern insulators with opposite Chern numbers, we show that a mass-phase kink carried by a non-Hermitian interlayer mass and an independent imaginary-momentum kink separate the spectral, in-plane, and interlayer control of mass-defect corner states. The mass-phase kink creates the parent corner pole and fixes its energy and intrinsic decay, while directed interlayer tunneling encodes its layer polarization. The imaginary-momentum texture instead reshapes the closed-boundary envelope and redistributes stationary right-state weight between corners. A twisted Qi--Wu--Zhang bilayer verifies this division on arbitrary, including concave, boundaries. A $30^\circ$ twisted Haldane dodecagon realizes twelve finite-energy parent states whose in-gap spectral manifold persists while boundary patterns redistribute its normalized right-subspace weight toward six, three, two, or one target corners. The two kinks therefore cooperate or compete while keeping spectral ancestry, spatial weight, and layer character distinct, thereby establishing a unified framework for controlling mass-defect corner states across disparate boundary geometries and mass textures.
summary:
角态受到边界质量缺陷的约束，但这种几何锚定限制了它们的空间和内部控制。着眼于由具有相反陈数的陈绝缘体组装而成的扭曲双层，我们证明了非厄米层间质量所携带的质量相位扭结和独立的虚动量扭结将质量缺陷角态的光谱、面内和层间控制分开。质量相位扭结创建了父角极并固定了其能量和固有衰减，而定向层间隧道则编码了其层偏振。相反，虚动量纹理重塑了封闭边界包络，并重新分配角之间的静态右状态权重。扭曲的 Qi-Wu-Zhang 双层验证了任意边界（包括凹边界）的这种划分。一个 $30^\circ$ 扭曲的 Haldane 十二边形实现了 12 个有限能量母态，其间隙内谱流形持续存在，而边界模式将其归一化右子空间权重重新分配到六个、三个、两个或一个目标角。

因此，这两个扭结在保持光谱祖先、空间权重和层特征不同的同时合作或竞争，从而建立一个统一的框架来控制不同边界几何形状和质量纹理的质量缺陷角状态。

title: A Solvable Model in the Half-filled Landau Level
abstract: A solvable microscopic model of interacting electrons in a half-filled Landau level is presented. The Hamiltonian is a well-defined limit of the electron-electron interaction. The low energy sector consists of a set of independent, spatially interlaced, one-dimensional systems of non-interacting fermionic dipoles, each system with a Fermi sea ground state. The total number of dipoles in the set of Fermi seas forming the two-dimensional ground state equals the number of electrons in the system and the density of states at the Fermi level is that of a two-dimensional Fermi gas. The model is obtained by generalizing, or rather adopting, the existing exact solution on a thin, but not too thin, torus to the two-dimensional bulk case.
summary: 提出了半填充朗道能级中相互作用电子的可解微观模型。哈密​​顿量是电子-电子相互作用的明确定义的极限。低能部分由一组独立的、空间交错的、非相互作用费米偶极子的一维系统组成，每个系统都具有费米海基态。形成二维基态的费米海集合中偶极子的总数等于系统中电子的数量，费米能级的态密度是二维费米气体的态密度。该模型是通过将薄但不太薄的环面上的现有精确解推广或采用二维体块情况而获得的。

title: Generalized Constraint-Controlled Rheological Model: Two Constitutive Pathways under Sinusoidal Periodic Shear Deformation
abstract: We formulate the Generalized Constraint-Controlled Rheological Model (GCCRM) for entangled linear and long-arm-branched polymer melts under sinusoidal periodic shear deformation (SPSD), spanning the linear and strongly nonlinear regimes. Molecular architecture, conformation, chain stretch, flow-active constraints, convective constraint release, dynamic tube dilation, and activated arm retraction define a common upstream molecular state. This state feeds two time-domain constitutive pathways (a configurational stress and a dissipative internal-variable stress) which are recombined before Fourier analysis. For branched polymers, the architecture is described by an entire backbone of molecular weight $M_{bb}$ and $N_a$ long arms of molecular weight $M_a$, with a compliance-weighted representative-constitutive-cell partition. The linear limit is normalized so that the configurational moduli sum to the entanglement modulus, while dynamic tube dilation and stretch drive distinct contributions to dissipative activation. Under reduced closures, GCCRM generates a smooth nonlinear elastic response with an onset of nonlinearity, an approximately logarithmic growth regime, an architecture-dependent maximum, and distinct high-deformation asymptotes. Fourier harmonics, ELR, VLR, and Lissajous curves are treated as post-processing observables of the total stress. The framework establishes a consistent constitutive architecture whose quantitative validation requires one parameter set per material across SPSD and, prospectively, transient shear histories.
summary:
我们为正弦周期性剪切变形 (SPSD) 下纠缠的线性和长臂支化聚合物熔体制定了广义约束控制流变模型 (GCCRM)，涵盖线性和强非线性状态。分子结构、构象、链拉伸、流动活性约束、对流约束释放、动态管扩张和激活臂缩回定义了共同的上游分子状态。这种状态提供两个时域本构路径（构型应力和耗散内变应力），这两个路径在傅里叶分析之前重新组合。对于支化聚合物，其结构由分子量为 $M_{bb}$ 的整个主链和分子量为 $M_a$ 的 $N_a$ 长臂以及柔量加权的代表性组成单元分区来描述。线性极限被归一化，使得构型模量总和为纠缠模量，而动态管膨胀和拉伸对耗散激活产生不同的贡献。

在减少闭合的情况下，GCCRM 生成平滑的非线性弹性响应，具有非线性起始点、近似对数增长状态、依赖于体系结构的最大值以及明显的高变形渐近线。傅立叶谐波、ELR、VLR 和 Lissajous 曲线被视为总应力的后处理可观测量值。该框架建立了一个一致的本构架构，其定量验证需要跨 SPSD 的每种材料设置一个参数，并且前瞻性地需要瞬态剪切历史。

title: Ergodicity breaking transition beyond qubits
abstract: The local Hilbert space dimension is a fundamental parameter in quantum many-body systems, but its role in controlling the ergodicity-breaking transition remains less explored. We systematically study this question by introducing toy models of qudits in zero dimensions that exhibit an ergodicity-breaking transition. Using the hybridization condition, we analytically obtain the dependence of the critical value of the interactions on the local Hilbert space dimension. Numerical studies of spectral correlation measures show agreement with the theoretical predictions, hence confirming the existence of the ergodicity-breaking transition in these models. We further introduce a distinct higher spin version of the model and numerically obtain the same critical behavior, demonstrating that the observed critical point is independent of the microscopic structure of interactions considered.
summary: 局部希尔伯特空间维度是量子多体系统中的基本参数，但其在控制遍历性破坏转变中的作用仍然很少被探索。我们通过引入零维量子玩具模型来系统地研究这个问题，这些模型表现出遍历性破坏的转变。使用杂交条件，我们分析地获得了相互作用的临界值对局部希尔伯特空间维数的依赖性。谱相关性测量的数值研究表明与理论预测一致，从而证实了这些模型中遍历性破坏转变的存在。我们进一步引入了模型的独特的更高自旋版本，并在数值上获得了相同的临界行为，证明观察到的临界点与所考虑的相互作用的微观结构无关。

title: Unlocking the potential of polymer networks for high strength through topology
abstract: A covalent polymer network is orders of magnitude weaker than individual covalent bonds. This large gap reveals an unrealized potential. The weakness of a network comes not from individual covalent bonds, but from how they are connected. Here we unlock this potential by identifying a topological criterion, involving optimally sparse crosslinks, long chains, and dense entanglements. Optimizing each topological variable alone is insufficient for high strength, yet exceptional strength emerges when they are combined within a narrow regime. We describe the physics of this synergy, and use the criterion to strengthen networks widely used but known to be weak. For example, we prepare a polyacrylamide hydrogel of 90 wt% water, amplifying strength from a commonly reported value of ~0.1 MPa to ~6.5 MPa. The exceptional strength is achieved without sacrificing other properties, such as softness, toughness, and elasticity. The criterion establishes topology as a general design principle for strong polymer networks.
summary: 共价聚合物网络比单个共价键弱几个数量级。这一巨大差距揭示了未实现的潜力。网络的弱点不是来自单个共价键，而是来自它们的连接方式。在这里，我们通过确定拓扑标准来释放这种潜力，包括最佳稀疏交联、长链和密集纠缠。单独优化每个拓扑变量不足以获得高强度，但当它们在狭窄的范围内组合时，就会出现非凡的强度。我们描述了这种协同作用的物理原理，并使用该标准来加强广泛使用但已知较弱的网络。例如，我们制备了 90 wt% 水的聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶，将强度从通常报道的 ~0.1 MPa 放大到 ~6.5 MPa。在不牺牲其他性能（例如柔软性、韧性和弹性）的情况下实现了卓越的强度。该标准将拓扑确立为强聚合物网络的一般设计原则。

title: Dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in rotating QED$_3$: critical flavor number and the occupation-reweighting channel
abstract: We study dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in $(2{+}1)$-dimensional QED on a rigidly rotating disc, $\Omega R<1$, within the rainbow Schwinger--Dyson framework. At zero temperature the rotation response of the condensate vanishes identically, so $N_c^{\rm SD}(\Omega,T{=}0)=N_c^{\rm SD}(0)=2.60\pm0.01$ (using three operational definitions). At finite temperature, rotation suppresses the condensate through a dominant occupation-reweighting channel, $\hat{\kappa}_{\rm occ}=-1.55$, accounting for $\ge 99.995\%$ of the linearized total response at the reference parameters, with self-consistent feedback amplifying it by $26.5$. The screening channel is reported at fixed regularization, $\hat{\kappa}_{\rm scr}(\varepsilon = 0.01)=-0.97$; its $\varepsilon \to 0$ behavior is logarithmically divergent. The crossover flavor $N^{*}(\Omega)$ falls monotonically at fixed temperature (a corollary). The critical flavor number is unchanged by rotation at $T=0$ (theorem). Together these results set the finite-temperature reference for the model.
summary: 我们研究了彩虹 Schwinger-Dyson 框架内刚性旋转圆盘 $\Omega R<1$ 上 $(2{+}1)$ 维 QED 中动态手性对称性破缺。在零温度下，凝结水的旋转响应同样消失，因此 $N_c^{\rm SD}(\Omega,T{=}0)=N_c^{\rm SD}(0)=2.60\pm0.01$ （使用三个操作定义）。在有限温度下，旋转通过占主导地位的占据重加权通道 $\hat{\kappa}_{\rm occ}=-1.55$ 抑制凝结物，占参考参数处线性化总响应的 $\ge 99.995\%$，自洽反馈将其放大 $26.5$。筛选通道以固定正则化报告，$\hat{\kappa}_{\rm scr}(\varepsilon = 0.01)=-0.97$;它的 $\varepsilon \to 0$ 行为是对数发散的。交叉风味 $N^{*}(\Omega)$ 在固定温度下单调下降（推论）。在 $T=0$ 时，临界风味数不会因旋转而改变（定理）。这些结果共同为模型设定了有限温度参考。

title: Field Response of the Orbital Moment Probed by Integrated Magnetic Circular Dichroism
abstract: Magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) is an optical probe of orbital time reversal symmetry breaking. Although frequency integrated MCD is related to the self-rotation contribution to orbital magnetization at zero field, its magnetic response generally differs from the thermodynamic orbital susceptibility. Here, we define the MCD susceptibility and derive general expressions for multiband systems using an electromagnetic $U(1)$ gauge invariant approach. For insulators, the response contains contributions from the non-Abelian quantum metric, Berry curvature, and field induced interband mixing. For metals, a finite temperature Green function formulation separates the smooth response into Fermi sea and Fermi surface contributions. An independent Landau level calculation confirms the expressions for the zero-field MCD moment and its linear magnetic response. In a continuum model for twisted bilayer graphene, the MCD susceptibility vanishes within the charge neutrality gap, while the thermodynamic orbital susceptibility remains markedly diamagnetic. Near the gap edges, the orbital moment term dominates the response. Features near the van Hove energies are associated with density of states enhancement. These results clarify how the two susceptibilities reflect different orbital processes even for the same electronic structure and thus establish the MCD susceptibility as a distinct probe of orbital magnetic response.
summary:
磁圆二色性（MCD）是一种轨道时间反转对称性破缺的光学探针。尽管频率积分MCD与零场下轨道磁化强度的自转贡献有关，但其磁响应通常与热力学轨道磁化率不同。在这里，我们定义 MCD 磁化率，并使用电磁 $U(1)$ 规范不变方法导出多频带系统的一般表达式。对于绝缘体，响应包含非阿贝尔量子度量、贝里曲率和场诱导带间混合的贡献。对于金属，有限温度格林函数公式将平滑响应分为费米海和费米表面贡献。独立的朗道能级计算证实了零场 MCD 力矩及其线性磁响应的表达式。在扭曲双层石墨烯的连续介质模型中，MCD 磁化率在电荷中性间隙内消失，而热力学轨道磁化率仍然具有明显的抗磁性。在间隙边缘附近，轨道矩项在响应中占主导地位。

范霍夫能量附近的特征与态密度增强相关。这些结果阐明了即使对于相同的电子结构，这两种磁化率如何反映不同的轨道过程，从而将 MCD 磁化率确立为轨道磁响应的独特探针。

title: Developing the Statistical Mechanics of Evolving Assembly Spaces
abstract: A gap exists in connecting biological evolution within the framework of statistical mechanics. It has been hoped that statistical mechanics would provide us with a general predictive principle for the emergence of novelty and complexity. However, the emergence of novel functional features initiated by stochastic processes remains difficult to describe, because these processes commonly arise outside near-equilibrium or linear-response regimes. To understand how environmental influences generate diverse, open-ended, complex objects by driving physical systems to specific regions of phase space over long spatial and temporal scales, a new approach to non-equilibrium thermodynamics is necessary. Here, we present the coupling of assembly theory (AT) with statistical mechanics as a framework that works within the laws of thermodynamics, but can contextualise the processes of novelty, complexity, and evolution within these laws. We map construction processes from physical space to assembly space (AS) and introduce the concept of an assembler, a machine that constructs objects contingent on previous states and is represented by bitwise operations. Using this approach, we apply principles from stochastic thermodynamics with AT to define selection within large combinatorial spaces1 and estimate the work required to create novel and complex objects. This approach allows us to represent complex processes, such as selection, within large combinatorial spaces as a set of rules for a memory-feedback loop followed by the assembler. This framework concretely defines the relationships between thermodynamics and information theory by introducing a novel aspect of physics that uses history and causal contingency to influence the probabilistic time evolution of complex systems.
summary:
在统计力学框架内连接生物进化方面存在差距。人们希望统计力学能为我们提供新颖性和复杂性出现的一般预测原则。然而，由随机过程引发的新功能特征的出现仍然难以描述，因为这些过程通常出现在近平衡或线性响应状态之外。为了理解环境影响如何通过在长时空尺度上将物理系统驱动到相空间的特定区域来产生多样化、开放式、复杂的物体，需要一种新的非平衡热力学方法。在这里，我们提出了装配理论（AT）与统计力学的耦合作为一个在热力学定律范围内工作的框架，但可以将这些定律中的新颖性、复杂性和演化过程置于背景中。我们将构造过程从物理空间映射到装配空间（AS），并引入装配器的概念，这是一种根据先前状态构造对象并由按位运算表示的机器。

使用这种方法，我们应用随机热力学原理和 AT 来定义大型组合空间中的选择，并估计创建新颖且复杂的对象所需的工作。这种方法使我们能够将大型组合空间中的复杂过程（例如选择）表示为汇编器遵循的内存反馈循环的一组规则。该框架通过引入物理学的一个新颖方面，利用历史和因果偶然性来影响复杂系统的概率时间演化，具体定义了热力学和信息论之间的关系。

title: Spatial interference changes the symmetry class of a Josephson element
abstract: Spatial interference can break the inversion symmetry of an effective Josephson potential even in a laterally homogeneous junction with inversion-symmetric local energy. We derive a general criterion based on harmonic-dependent complex spatial form factors: a single local harmonic remains a shifted cosine, whereas multiple harmonics can acquire phases incompatible with any common inversion center, permitting cubic interactions and three-wave mixing. Phase reflection reverses all odd-order expansion coefficients about corresponding minima while preserving the even-order ones. For a capacitively shunted junction at fixed charging energy and arbitrary offset charge, it also preserves the complete quantum spectrum, enabling reversal of the odd nonlinear sector without spectral retuning. A centered cross junction with multiple local harmonics is one concrete example. Within the imposed-field model, a three-component magnetic field can generate an inversion-asymmetric effective potential, and reversing an odd number of field components exactly reflects it without changing the quantum spectrum of the capacitively shunted junction.
summary: 即使在具有反演对称局部能量的横向均匀结中，空间干扰也可以打破有效约瑟夫森势的反演对称性。我们基于谐波相关的复杂空间形状因子得出了一个通用标准：单个局部谐波仍然是平移余弦，而多个谐波可以获得与任何公共反演中心不兼容的相位，从而允许三次相互作用和三波混频。相位反射反转有关相应最小值的所有奇数阶展开系数，同时保留偶数阶展开系数。对于固定充电能量和任意偏移电荷的电容分流结，它还保留了完整的量子光谱，从而无需光谱重新调谐即可反转奇数非线性部分。具有多个局部谐波的中心交叉点就是一个具体示例。在外加场模型中，三分量磁场可以产生反转不对称的有效电势，并且反转奇数个场分量可以准确地反映它，而不会改变电容分流结的量子谱。

title: Variational Minimization of Almost Strong Zero Modes in Parafermionic Wires
abstract: Strongly interacting fermionic chains obeying a $Z_n$ symmetry can host topological phases with highly degenerate ground-state manifolds. The different ground states are connected by strongly bound fractionalized edge modes called parafermionic zero modes. While exactly preserved under time evolution at zero temperature, interactions lead to a destabilization of these modes at finite energy densities, and, given a generic Hamiltonian, obtaining the lifetime of these modes is often impossible as it requires knowledge of the full spectrum of the Hamiltonian or long time evolutions. Here, we propose a novel quantum-inspired algorithm that can be used to variationally search for these almost strong zero modes in generic parafermionic chain models. We demonstrate analytically and numerically that our ansatz faithfully reproduces the exact results and finds strongly bound parafermionic operators in the non-integrable Kitaev-Hubbard chain and chiral Potts model. Our results further allow us to verify the existence of a true strong zero mode in the symmetrical limit of the chiral Potts model for $Z_3$-parafermions.
summary: 遵循 $Z_n$ 对称性的强相互作用费米子链可以容纳具有高度简并基态流形的拓扑相。不同的基态通过强束缚的分数化边缘模式（称为顺子零模式）连接。虽然在零温度下的时间演化下精确保留，但相互作用会导致这些模式在有限能量密度下不稳定，并且，给定通用哈密顿量，获得这些模式的寿命通常是不可能的，因为它需要哈密顿量或长时间演化的全谱知识。在这里，我们提出了一种新颖的量子启发算法，可用于在通用顺子链模型中变分搜索这些几乎强的零模式。我们通过分析和数值证明，我们的 ansatz 忠实地再现了准确的结果，并在不可积的 Kitaev-Hubbard 链和手性 Potts 模型中找到了强束缚的顺费米子算子。我们的结果进一步使我们能够验证 $Z_3$-parafermions 手性 Potts 模型的对称极限中是否存在真正的强零模式。

title: Magpie: A Graphical Magnon Software
abstract: Magpie is a fully graphical linear spin-wave software which has its main focus on 3-d visualisation of magnetic models and magnon dispersion relations. The software is distributed under an open-source license and is written in high-performance, portable C++. Its modular architecture allows for a rapid development of new calculation modules and permits the inclusion into external applications. Included code generators ensure seamless interoperability with other linear spin-wave libraries.
summary: Magpie 是一款全图形化线性自旋波软件，主要关注磁模型和磁振子色散关系的 3D 可视化。该软件根据开源许可证分发，并使用高性能、可移植的 C++ 编写。其模块化架构允许快速开发新的计算模块并允许包含到外部应用程序中。包含的代码生成器确保与其他线性自旋波库的无缝互操作性。

title: Emergence of Active Foams in a Minimal Cognitive Flocking Model
abstract: We investigate a minimal visual perception-driven model of self-propelled particles that interact through purely position-based cohesive steering within a finite vision cone, in the absence of velocity alignment and physical volume exclusion. Building on a previously proposed minimal cognitive model, we extend the interaction range from the previously studied short-range and distance-independent limits to an intermediate regime, enabling a systematic investigation of how a finite vision range influences collective behavior. We find that this regime exhibits a rich state diagram that combines characteristics of both limiting cases while giving rise to qualitatively new collective states. Besides the gas, nematic-band, and polar file states, we uncover the emergence of \emph{active foams} -- system-spanning fractal-like networks sustained by dynamically evolving particle streams. These structures arise solely from non-reciprocal vision-based interactions and are absent in both the short and long vision-range limits. For larger vision angles, the system self-organizes into a variety of aggregate morphologies, including condensates, rings, and multi-twist filaments, revealing a strong interplay between interaction range and anisotropic perception in shaping collective organization.
summary:
我们研究了自驱动粒子的最小视觉感知驱动模型，在没有速度对齐和物理体积排除的情况下，在有限视锥内通过纯粹基于位置的内聚转向进行交互。基于先前提出的最小认知模型，我们将交互范围从先前研究的短程和距离无关的限制扩展到中间状态，从而能够系统地研究有限的视觉范围如何影响集体行为。我们发现，该政权展示了丰富的状态图，它结合了两种极限情况的特征，同时产生了新的集体状态。除了气体、向列带和极性文件状态之外，我们还发现了\emph{活性泡沫}的出现——由动态演化的粒子流维持的系统跨越分形网络。这些结构仅源自基于视觉的非互惠交互，并且在短视觉范围和长视觉范围限制中都不存在。

对于更大的视角，该系统自组织成各种聚合形态，包括凝聚体、环和多捻细丝，揭示了相互作用范围和各向异性感知在塑造集体组织时的强烈相互作用。

title: Eigenstate transitions and critical transport in 3D Aubry-André model
abstract: We numerically study spectral and wave-function properties, as well as time evolution, in finite-size commensurate approximations of the 3D Aubry-André model. We explicitly show, through scaling analysis, the existence of two critical points. One of the critical points is a localization-delocalization transition in real-space, similar to the critical point in the 3D Anderson model. The other is a localization-delocalization transition in a dual momentum space, which does not have any analog in the 3D Anderson model. We estimate their values from spectral measures, such as the gap ratio and the spectral form factor, as well as from wave-function measures, such as the inverse participation ratio and the participation entropy. Additionally, we demonstrate that both critical points exhibit hallmarks of critical points between quantum ergodicity and localization. First, the eigenstates and the eigenspectrum at the critical point fulfill the mutual universal relation between the eigenspectrum compressibility $\chi$ and the eigenstate fractal dimension $d^{(1)}$ [S. Jiricek et al., Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 123, e2518027123 (2026)]. Second, the dynamics of the wave packet at the critical point is governed by the critical dynamical exponent $z$, characterized by the spectral fractal dimension and the dimensionality of the lattice [M. Hopjan and L. Vidmar, Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 060401 (2025)]. Thus, similarly to the 3D Anderson model, the critical dynamical exponent is sub-diffusive with the value of $z=3$.
summary:
我们在 3D Aubry-André 模型的有限尺寸相称近似中对光谱和波函数特性以及时间演化进行数值研究。通过尺度分析，我们明确地表明了两个临界点的存在。关键点之一是真实空间中的定位-离域转变，类似于 3D Anderson 模型中的关键点。另一种是双动量空间中的局域-离域转变，这在 3D Anderson 模型中没有任何类似物。我们根据光谱测量（例如间隙比和光谱形状因子）以及波函数测量（例如逆参与比和参与熵）来估计它们的值。此外，我们证明两个临界点都表现出量子遍历性和局域化之间的临界点的特征。首先，临界点的本征态和本征谱满足本征谱压缩率$\chi$和本征态分形维数$d^{(1)}$之间的相互普遍关系[S. Jiricek 等人，Proc。纳特。阿卡德。科学。 123，e2518027123（2026）]。

其次，波包在临界点的动力学由临界动力学指数 $z$ 控制，其特征在于光谱分形维数和晶格维数 [M. Hopjan 和 L. Vidmar，物理学家。莱特牧师。 135, 060401 (2025)]。因此，与 3D Anderson 模型类似，临界动力学指数是次扩散的，其值为 $z=3$。

title: Quantum Localization in Geometric Complex Networks
abstract: Quantum localization, the phenomenon by which wave diffusion is halted, here understood as the superposition of propagating waves, can have many different origins, such as onsite random potentials in Anderson localization. However, some systems exhibit complex geometries and could potentially reproduce similar results without external potentials. In this work, we study how localization of single particle states is affected by the underlying topology of a simple but highly predictive complex network model: the geometric soft configuration model $\mathbb S^1$. By tuning the model's temperature and heterogeneity parameters, we are able to generate different structural patterns and focus on the transition from a small-world to a non-small-world regime. Our study suggests that small-world networks tend to have extended states, which spread the whole system's size, in contrast to non-small-world networks which tend to localize, showing how complex connectivity can play the role assigned to random energetic disorder.
summary: 量子局域化是波扩散停止的现象，在这里被理解为传播波的叠加，可以有许多不同的起源，例如安德森局域化中的现场随机势。然而，一些系统表现出复杂的几何形状，并且可能在没有外部电势的情况下重现类似的结果。在这项工作中，我们研究了简单但高度预测的复杂网络模型的基础拓扑如何影响单粒子状态的定位：几何软配置模型 $\mathbb S^1$。通过调整模型的温度和异质性参数，我们能够生成不同的结构模式，并专注于从小世界到非小世界政权的转变。我们的研究表明，小世界网络往往具有扩展状态，从而扩展了整个系统的规模，与倾向于局部化的非小世界网络相反，这表明复杂的连接如何发挥分配给随机能量无序的作用。

title: Spreading the Damage: How Heterogeneity Delocalizes Fracture in Polymer Networks
abstract: Fracture in polymer networks is strongly influenced by how network architecture and topology organize damage in space. Although these materials can sustain large deformations under homogeneous loading, they often fail in a brittle and flaw-sensitive manner once defects are present. Here we show that network heterogeneity is one key architectural parameter controlling this transition. Using a discrete mesoscale network model that explicitly resolves strand-level prestretch, force transmission, and irreversible bond scission, we demonstrate that heterogeneity in prestretch and strand lengths broadens crack-induced deformation, delocalizes bond rupture, and enlarges the fracture process zone. In polydisperse networks, increasing contour-length disorder broadens the prestretch distribution and systematically increases both toughness and the intrinsic length scale governing flaw sensitivity. Bimodal networks amplify this mechanism further through combined contrasts in prestretch and strand lengths, producing the largest damage zones and the highest toughness among the architectures studied. Inspired by the results, we derive a scaling estimate relating the emergent fracture-active length to the spatial range of crack-induced deformation and the logarithmic spread of strands' remaining stretch to rupture.
summary:
聚合物网络中的断裂很大程度上受到网络体系结构和拓扑结构在空间中组织损伤的方式的影响。尽管这些材料可以在均匀载荷下承受大变形，但一旦存在缺陷，它们通常会以脆性和缺陷敏感的方式失效。在这里，我们表明网络异构性是控制这一转变的一个关键架构参数。使用明确解决线级预拉伸、力传递和不可逆键断裂的离散介观网络模型，我们证明预拉伸和线长度的异质性会扩大裂纹引起的变形，使键断裂离域并扩大断裂过程区。在多分散网络中，增加轮廓长度无序性会拓宽预拉伸分布，并系统地增加韧性和控制缺陷敏感性的内在长度尺度。双峰网络通过预拉伸和股线长度的组合对比进一步放大了这种机制，在所研究的结构中产生最大的损伤区域和最高的韧性。

受这些结果的启发，我们得出了一个缩放估计，将出现的断裂活动长度与裂纹引起的变形的空间范围以及股线剩余拉伸至断裂的对数扩展相关联。

title: An empirical model for deriving information on ion dynamics from $μ$SR data via the conventional Kubo-Toyabe function analysis
abstract:
We present an empirical model that analytically relates the parameters of the extended Kubo-Toyabe (KT) function $G_z^{m EA}(t;\Delta,
u_{m i},Q)$, which describes muon spin relaxation ($\mu$SR) induced by jump diffusion of ions using the Edwards-Anderson parameter $Q$, to those of the conventional KT function $G_z^{m KT}(t;\Delta_{m KT},
u_{m KT})$ that serves as an approximation of $G_z^{m EA}(t)$. The proposed formulae successfully reproduce the anomalous temperature dependences of the linewidth $\Delta_{m KT}(T)$ and the fluctuation rate $
u_{m KT}(T)$ which are artifacts observed upon analyzing $\mu$SR data on ion diffusion using $G_z^{m KT}(t)$. Applying this model to $\Delta_{m KT}$ and $
u_{m KT}$ published in the literature of battery materials yields activation energy $E_{m i}$ and pre-exponential factor $
u_{m i0}$ in the Arrhenius equation for ion diffusion, $
u_{m i}(T)=
u_{m i0} e^{-E_{m i}/kT}$, that are in excellent agreement with those deduced using other techniques, transforming peculiar artifacts into a powerful diagnostic tool.
summary:
我们提出了一个经验模型，将扩展 Kubo-Toyabe (KT) 函数 $G_z^{m EA}(t;\Delta,
u_{m i},Q)$ 的参数与传统 KT 函数 $G_z^{m KT}(t;\Delta_{m KT},
u_{m KT})$ 用作 $G_z^{m EA}(t)$ 的近似值。所提出的公式成功地再现了线宽$\Delta_{m KT}(T)$和波动率$
u_{m KT}(T)$的异常温度依赖性，这是使用$G_z^{m KT}(t)$分析离子扩散的$\mu$SR数据时观察到的伪影。将此模型应用于电池材料文献中发表的$\Delta_{m KT}$和$
u_{m KT}$，可得到离子扩散阿伦尼乌斯方程中的活化能$E_{m i}$和指前因子$
u_{m i0}$，$
u_{m i}(T)=
u_{m i0} e^{-E_{m i}/kT}$，即与使用其他技术推断的结果非常一致，将特殊的工件转化为强大的诊断工具。

title: Deformation-induced spectral softening drives phase separation on non-spherical membranes
abstract: Models of curvature-driven membrane sorting couple composition directly to membrane bending elasticity.
