Here we show that shape deformations can destabilize a homogeneous state without this composition-dependent mechanical coupling. We analyze the eigenspectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on deformed spheres analytically, and verify it numerically. As the deformation amplitude increases, the spectral degeneracy breaks, and the lowest nonzero eigenvalue decreases substantially. Using Cahn-Hilliard dynamics, we show that this eigenvalue softening provides a purely geometric route to phase separation.
summary: 曲率驱动的膜分选模型将成分直接与膜弯曲弹性耦合。在这里，我们表明，在没有这种依赖于成分的机械耦合的情况下，形状变形可能会破坏均匀状态的稳定。我们对变形球上的Laplace-Beltrami算子的特征谱进行了解析分析，并进行了数值验证。随着变形幅度的增加，谱简并性被打破，最低的非零特征值大幅下降。使用 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学，我们表明这种特征值软化提供了一种纯几何途径的相分离。

title: High-mobility spin transport mediated by indirect excitons in a van der Waals heterostructure
abstract: Efficient spin transport with high spin mobility is of both fundamental and practical significance for spintronics. Spin can be transferred by moving particles. However, particle scattering limits spin transfer and prevents high spin mobilities. In this work, we study the kinetics of spin transport mediated by a quantum system of indirect excitons (IXs) in a van der Waals heterostructure composed of atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). This spin transfer mechanism allows for the realization of efficient spin transport characterized by a high spin mobility reaching 10$^5$ cm$^2$/(eV$\cdot$s), which is orders of magnitude higher than that achieved via standard diffusive spin transport in TMD materials. The suppression of IX scattering enables high-mobility spin transport.
summary: 具有高自旋迁移率的高效自旋输运对于自旋电子学具有基础和实际意义。自旋可以通过移动粒子来传递。然而，粒子散射限制了自旋传递并阻碍了高自旋迁移率。在这项工作中，我们研究了由原子薄过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）组成的范德华异质结构中间接激子（IX）量子系统介导的自旋输运动力学。这种自旋转移机制可以实现高效的自旋输运，其特点是自旋迁移率高达 10$^5$ cm$^2$/(eV$\cdot$s)，这比 TMD 材料中通过标准扩散自旋输运实现的高几个数量级。 IX 散射的抑制使得高迁移率自旋输运成为可能。

title: Length-scale dependence of collective time reparameterization in swap dynamics
abstract: Swap Monte Carlo dramatically accelerates the equilibration of deeply supercooled liquids while preserving the equilibrium Boltzmann distribution. Recent work has argued that swap and other accelerated algorithms act by reparameterizing time: different dynamics follow the same slow relaxation process, but with different clocks. Here we test this idea in a continuously polydisperse glass former. We confirm that mean collective overlaps satisfy an approximate time reparameterization, in agreement with earlier results. However, the associated clock depends systematically on the collective probe length and on the relaxation stage. Thus the observed collective collapse does not define a unique, observable-independent material time. Over the numerically accessible $\alpha$-relaxation regime, swap changes not only the rate of relaxation, but also its length-scale dependence. The resulting collective reparameterization is therefore only approximate and does not establish an exact dynamical equivalence between swap and reference relaxation.
summary: 交换蒙特卡罗极大地加速了深度过冷液体的平衡，同时保持平衡玻尔兹曼分布。最近的工作认为，交换和其他加速算法通过重新参数化时间来发挥作用：不同的动态遵循相同的缓慢松弛过程，但具有不同的时钟。在这里，我们在连续多分散玻璃成型机中测试了这个想法。我们确认平均集体重叠满足近似时间重新参数化，与之前的结果一致。然而，相关的时钟系统地取决于集体探针长度和弛豫阶段。因此，观察到的集体崩溃并没有定义一个独特的、独立于可观察的物质时间。在数值上可访问的 $\alpha$ 弛豫机制上，交换不仅改变弛豫速率，还改变其长度尺度依赖性。因此，由此产生的集体重新参数化只是近似的，并没有在交换和参考松弛之间建立精确的动态等价性。

title: Self-Avoidance Governs Re-entrant Coil-Globule Transition of Inertial Active Brownian Ring Polymers
abstract: Active matter systems composed of self-propelled entities exhibit a wide range of out-of-equilibrium phase behaviors and collective dynamics. Assemblies of active particles, e.g., in a linear structure, are particularly interesting, as they exhibit an intriguing interplay between activity and geometrical restrictions due to self-avoidance and entanglements. Using Langevin dynamics simulations of an active Brownian ring polymer with translational and rotational inertia, we uncover an inertia-driven re-entrant coil-globule transition in the absence of any attractive interactions. We show that rotational inertia plays a paramount role, leading, in the globular state, to spontaneous, nonzero, radially outward polarization of the active forces. Self-avoidance and entanglements break the rotational symmetry of active beads and effectively stabilize the globular states. The transition becomes increasingly sharp with increasing rotational inertia, yielding highly compact globular conformations at intermediate activities, whereas at high activity the polymer re-expands into a coil state. Scaling of the radius of gyration reveals crossovers from self-avoiding, phantom-like to compact-globular structures. Further, rotational inertia enhances transport properties, with an intermediate activity-induced Rouse-type bead diffusion and a long-time diffusion coefficient displaying a power-law dependence on the moment of inertia. Our study establishes a purely inertia-induced mechanism for controlling the collapse of active polymers, arising from spontaneous active-force polarization and self-avoidance.
summary:
由自驱动实体组成的活性物质系统表现出广泛的非平衡相行为和集体动力学。活性粒子的组装，例如线性结构，特别有趣，因为它们由于自我回避和纠缠而表现出活性和几何限制之间有趣的相互作用。使用具有平移和旋转惯性的活性布朗环聚合物的朗之万动力学模拟，我们发现了在没有任何吸引相互作用的情况下惯性驱动的重入线圈-球体转变。我们表明，转动惯量起着至关重要的作用，在球状状态下，转动惯量会导致主动力自发的、非零的、径向向外的极化。自回避和纠缠打破了活性珠子的旋转对称性，有效稳定了球状态。随着转动惯量的增加，转变变得越来越尖锐，在中间活性下产生高度紧凑的球状构象，而在高活性下聚合物重新膨胀成线圈状态。

回转半径的缩放揭示了从自回避、幻影状结构到致密球状结构的交叉。此外，旋转惯性增强了传输特性，具有中间活性诱导的劳斯型珠扩散和显示对惯性矩的幂律依赖性的长时间扩散系数。我们的研究建立了一种纯粹的惯性诱导机制，用于控制由自发主动力极化和自我回避引起的活性聚合物的塌陷。

title: Orbital cancellation and reentrant localization in a quasiperiodic trimer ladder
abstract: Uniform orbital detuning can restore spatial extent even as quasiperiodic modulation strengthens. In a trimer ladder with fixed hoppings and orbital modulation signs, increasing detuning and modulation amplitude together drives successive avoided crossings that redistribute orbital weights, suppressing the projected onsite potential in both lower molecular bands while leaving the third strongly modulated. Complete-band participation scaling supports two reentrant high-participation windows, with wave-packet propagation corroborating spatial recovery at representative controls over the studied sizes and times. These diagonal cancellations leave residual interband modulation, which generates a self-energy whose magnitude depends on the molecular level separation. Gaussian quadrature improves convergence of closed-walk determinant estimates used to cross-check energy-resolved attenuation. Comparing the coupled and decoupled ladders under the same finite-size participation criterion shows that restoring the full off-diagonal modulation narrows both sampled windows, with a larger absolute contraction of the second.
summary: 即使准周期调制加强，均匀轨道失谐也可以恢复空间范围。在具有固定跳跃和轨道调制符号的三聚体梯中，增加失谐和调制幅度共同驱动连续避免的交叉，从而重新分配轨道重量，抑制两个较低分子带中的预计现场电势，同时使第三个带强烈调制。完整频带参与缩放支持两个可重入的高参与窗口，波包传播在对所研究的大小和时间进行代表性控制时证实了空间恢复。这些对角线抵消留下残留的带间调制，从而产生自能，其大小取决于分子水平分离。高斯求积改进了用于交叉检查能量分辨衰减的闭路行列式估计的收敛性。在相同的有限大小参与标准下比较耦合和解耦梯子表明，恢复完全非对角调制会缩小两个采样窗口，第二个采样窗口的绝对收缩更大。

title: Wilson-loop formulations of the spin polarization and the spin Chern number
abstract: In this paper, we derive the spin polarization and the spin Chern number in momentum and real spaces in terms of the Wilson loop in each spin sector. For these derivations, the spin matrix in the subspace of occupied or unoccupied states is generalized by the unitary rotation to prevent the spectral gap from closing. In the presence of a finite spin gap, the spin eigenvectors recompose the eigenstates of the Hamiltonian in two spin sectors. A dimensional reduction leads to the charge polarization in each spin sector in terms of the Wilson loop along the effective Brillouin zone (BZ) in one dimension (1D). A linear combination of the charge polarizations defines the spin polarization, which naturally quantifies the spin Chern number in momentum space. It is also shown that the spin Chern number is directly derived from the local Wilson loops on a discrete 2D BZ. The theoretical treatment is further generalized for real space in a supercell framework, which can deal with ordered and disordered systems in a unified manner. In this framework, the spin Chern number in real space is formulated in terms of the Wilson loop around the BZ boundary. These formulations are used to numerically evaluate topological phases in the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model. Numerical results show an equivalence of the spin Chern number and the ${\mathbb{Z}_2}$ index.
summary:
在本文中，我们根据每个自旋扇区中的威尔逊环推导了动量空间和实空间中的自旋极化和自旋陈数。对于这些推导，占据或未占据状态子空间中的自旋矩阵通过酉旋转进行推广，以防止光谱间隙闭合。在存在有限自旋间隙的情况下，自旋特征向量在两个自旋扇区中重构哈密顿量的本征态。尺寸减小导致每个自旋扇区中的电荷极化，根据威尔逊环沿一维 (1D) 有效布里渊区 (BZ) 的变化。电荷极化的线性组合定义了自旋极化，它自然地量化了动量空间中的自旋陈数。还表明，自旋陈数直接从离散 2D BZ 上的局部 Wilson 环导出。该理论处理进一步推广到超晶胞框架下的实空间，可以统一处理有序和无序系统。在此框架中，实空间中的自旋陈数根据 BZ 边界周围的威尔逊环来公式化。

这些公式用于对 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 模型中的拓扑相进行数值评估。数值结果表明自旋陈数和 ${\mathbb{Z}_2}$ 索引是等价的。

title: Symmetry Condition and Mechanism for the Anomalous Hall Effect in Odd-Parity Magnets
abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in unconventional magnets has attracted considerable attention. A giant AHE has recently been observed in the candidate $p$-wave magnet Gd$_3$(Ru$_{1-\delta}$Rh$_{\delta}$)$_4$Al$_{12}$ [Nature 646, 837(2025)], while its theoretical interpretation invokes a spontaneous magnetization to break time-reversal symmetry ($\mathcal{T}$), although the magnetic order itself already breaks $\mathcal{T}$. Consequently, the microscopic origin of the AHE in odd-parity magnets (OPMs) remains an open question. Here we establish the symmetry condition and microscopic mechanism for the AHE in OPMs. Since the OPM order is classified by the spin group whereas the AHE is governed by the magnetic group, the AHE is allowed only when the magnetic point group is ferromagnetic; conversely, it is forbidden whenever the effective time reversal $\mathcal{T}\tau$ (with $\tau$ a fractional translation), which is essential to the realization of the OPM, is preserved. Microscopically, OPMs generically host a hidden Zeeman field (HZF) rooted in this intrinsic $\mathcal{T}$ breaking, and its interplay with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) generates the AHE without any external field. We demonstrate this picture with models on the square, honeycomb, and kagome lattices. In particular, a square-lattice helimagnet with sublattice-resolved SOC maps exactly onto an anisotropic Rashba--Zeeman model, whose Zeeman term is nothing but the HZF and directly yields the AHE. Our results establish the symmetry condition for the AHE in OPMs and identify the HZF--SOC interplay as a general route to realize it.
summary:
非常规磁体中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）引起了人们的广泛关注。最近在候选$p$波磁体Gd$_3$(Ru$_{1-\delta}$Rh$_{\delta}$)$_4$Al$_{12}$ [Nature 646, 837(2025)]中观察到了巨大的AHE，而其理论解释则调用自发磁化来打破时间反转对称性($\mathcal{T}$)，尽管磁序本身已经打破$\mathcal{T}$。因此，奇宇称磁体 (OPM) 中 AHE 的微观起源仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们建立了 OPM 中 AHE 的对称条件和微观机制。由于OPM阶数是由自旋群分类的，而AHE是由磁性群控制的，因此只有当磁点群是铁磁性时才允许AHE；相反，只要保留了对于实现 OPM 至关重要的有效时间反转 $\mathcal{T}\tau$ （其中 $\tau$ 是小数翻译），就禁止这样做。从微观上看，OPM 通常具有一个隐藏的塞曼场 (HZF)，其根植于这种内在的 $\mathcal{T}$ 破坏，并且它与自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 的相互作用会在没有任何外部场的情况下生成 AHE。

我们用正方形、蜂窝状和戈薇格子上的模型来演示这张图片。特别是，具有亚晶格分辨 SOC 的方晶格螺旋磁体精确映射到各向异性 Rashba-Zeeman 模型，其塞曼项只不过是 HZF，并直接产生 AHE。我们的结果建立了 OPM 中 AHE 的对称条件，并将 HZF-SOC 相互作用确定为实现它的一般途径。

title: Universal Boolean Computation in Negatively Coupled Circle Map Lattices
abstract: We investigate the computational capabilities of a one-dimensional lattice of negatively coupled circle maps in its traveling wave regime. We interpret propagating waves as information carriers and exploit their interactions to implement Boolean logic. The logical states are encoded by the propagation direction of the traveling waves, while the presence or absence of a wave at a designated output location represents the logical output. Using controlled wave collisions, we demonstrate the realization of NAND and NOR gates along with other basic gates. Since NAND and NOR operations are functionally complete, the results establish that the traveling wave regime of the negatively coupled circle-map lattice supports universal Boolean computation in principle. The demonstrated logical operations remain valid over a finite range of the coupling strength \epsilon and map parameter \omega, indicating robustness of the computational scheme to parameter variations. Our results therefore demonstrate that computational functionality can emerge from the collective nonlinear dynamics of a coupled map lattice, providing a con- nection between the dynamical properties of traveling wave states and collision based information processing.
summary:
我们研究了负耦合圆图的一维晶格在行波状态下的计算能力。我们将传播波解释为信息载体，并利用它们的相互作用来实现布尔逻辑。逻辑状态由行波的传播方向编码，而指定输出位置处波的存在或不存在代表逻辑输出。使用受控波碰撞，我们演示了 NAND 和 NOR 门以及其他基本门的实现。由于 NAND 和 NOR 操作在功能上是完整的，因此结果表明负耦合圆映射晶格的行波状态原则上支持通用布尔计算。所演示的逻辑运算在耦合强度 epsilon 和映射参数 omega 的有限范围内仍然有效，表明计算方案对参数变化的鲁棒性。

因此，我们的结果表明，计算功能可以从耦合映射晶格的集体非线性动力学中产生，提供行波态的动力学特性和基于碰撞的信息处理之间的联系。

title: Derjaguin-corrected Kelvin equation for finite open slits
abstract: We formulate a Derjaguin-corrected Kelvin equation for phase transitions in finite open slits. In such pores, capillary condensation is modified by the finite wall length because the condensed phase is bounded by two terminal menisci pinned at the slit ends. Starting from the macroscopic generalized Kelvin equation, we introduce a scaling approximation which replaces the implicit edge-contact-angle condition by a closed analytic expression while preserving the exact limiting behaviours. We then incorporate mesoscopic wetting-layer contributions into the finite-slit free-energy balance. The single-wall contribution naturally separates into a planar Derjaguin term and a residual finite-length correction controlled by the competition between the wall length $H$ and the parallel correlation length $\xi_\parallel$. The resulting equation reduces to the standard Derjaguin-Kelvin equation for infinitely long slits and to the macroscopic finite-slit Kelvin equation when adsorbed layers are absent. Explicit forms are derived for long-ranged dispersion forces and for short-ranged forces. The theory is tested using classical density functional theory for finite slits with attractive Lennard-Jones walls and hard walls, corresponding respectively to capillary condensation and its drying analogue, capillary evaporation. The Derjaguin-corrected theory substantially improves on the purely macroscopic prediction, capturing both the correct infinite-slit limit and the observed dependence on wall length. For the short-ranged hard-wall system, the agreement with DFT remains nearly quantitative even for very narrow slits.
summary:
我们针对有限开缝中的相变制定了 Derjaguin 校正的开尔文方程。在此类孔中，毛细管冷凝会受到有限壁长的影响，因为冷凝相受到固定在狭缝末端的两个终端弯液面的限制。从宏观广义开尔文方程开始，我们引入了一种缩放近似，它用闭合解析表达式代替隐式边缘接触角条件，同时保留精确的限制行为。然后，我们将介观润湿层的贡献纳入有限缝自由能平衡中。单壁贡献自然地分为平面 Derjaguin 项和由壁长度 $H$ 和平行相关长度 $\xi_\parallel$ 之间的竞争控制的剩余有限长度校正。对于无限长狭缝，所得方程简化为标准德雅金-开尔文方程；当不存在吸附层时，则简化为宏观有限狭缝开尔文方程。导出了远程分散力和短程力的显式形式。

该理论使用经典密度泛函理论对具有有吸引力的 Lennard-Jones 壁和硬壁的有限狭缝进行了测试，分别对应于毛细管冷凝及其干燥类似物毛细管蒸发。 Derjaguin 校正理论大大改进了纯粹的宏观预测，捕获了正确的无限缝极限和观察到的对壁长的依赖性。对于短程硬壁系统，即使对于非常窄的狭缝，与 DFT 的一致性仍然接近定量。

title: Thermal softening of the yield stress in glasses with different stability
abstract: The yielding of amorphous solids has been extensively studied in the athermal limit, but the influence of thermal fluctuations is much less understood, in particular for glasses of different stability. Using molecular dynamics simulations of a model glass where the swap Monte Carlo algorithm can be employed, we study the yield stress at finite temperature and shear rate, both in steady flow and at shear start-up, over a broad range of glass stability. Thermal fluctuations soften both the dynamic yield stress in steady state and the start-up yield stress. In all cases, the temperature dependence is compatible with the $T^{2/3}$ law expected for thermally activated yielding near a saddle-node instability, with no systematic dependence of the exponent on stability or shear rate. Extrapolations to zero temperature recover the athermal yield stresses. The amplitude of the softening at start-up, by contrast, depends strongly on stability: highly stable glasses are much less sensitive to temperature than poorly annealed ones. A description of yielding at finite temperature must therefore account explicitly for the stability of the glass.
summary: 无定形固体的产生在非热极限下得到了广泛的研究，但热波动的影响却知之甚少，特别是对于不同稳定性的玻璃。通过对模型玻璃进行分子动力学模拟（可以采用交换蒙特卡罗算法），我们研究了在稳定流动和剪切启动时有限温度和剪切速率下的屈服应力，以及广泛的玻璃稳定性。热波动会软化稳态下的动态屈服应力和启动屈服应力。在所有情况下，温度依赖性都与鞍节点不稳定性附近的热激活屈服预期的 $T^{2/3}$ 定律兼容，而指数对稳定性或剪切速率没有系统依赖性。外推至零温度可恢复非热屈服应力。相比之下，启动时软化的幅度在很大程度上取决于稳定性：高度稳定的玻璃比退火不良的玻璃对温度的敏感度要低得多。因此，对有限温度下屈服的描述必须明确考虑玻璃的稳定性。

title: Thermally Enhanced Pseudo-Goldstone Spin Gap in the Isotropic Helimagnet ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$
abstract: In magnetically ordered systems, the spin gap in the magnon spectrum is normally expected to decrease on warming and close at the transition out of the long-range order. The presence of a pseudo-Goldstone gap is commonly associated with nonlinear terms in spin-wave theory. However, its precise origin and detailed properties can vary and remain under debate. Here we show by means of inelastic neutron scattering that the pseudo-Goldstone gap in the Heisenberg helimagnet ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ exhibits an atypical, nonmonotonic temperature dependence: the gap increases over much of the ordered phase before closing near $T_\mathrm{N}$. These results align with recent spin-dynamic simulations based on an effective quartic potential in an isotropic system~[Phys. Rev. B \textbf{113}, L220411 (2026)]. As the pseudo-Goldstone spin gap in ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ is dominated by quantum effects at subkelvin temperatures, its characteristic growth on warming is caused by thermal fluctuations.
summary: 在磁有序系统中，磁振子谱中的自旋间隙通常预计会随着变暖而减小，并在脱离长程有序时关闭。赝戈德斯通带隙的存在通常与自旋波理论中的非线性项相关。然而，其确切的起源和详细的特性可能会有所不同，并且仍然存在争议。在这里，我们通过非弹性中子散射表明，海森堡螺旋磁体 ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ 中的赝戈德斯通能隙表现出非典型的、非单调的温度依赖性：在接近 $T_\mathrm{N}$ 附近闭合之前，能隙在大部分有序相上增加。这些结果与最近基于各向同性系统中有效四次势的自旋动力学模拟相一致~[Phys。修订版 B \textbf{113}，L220411 (2026)]。由于 ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ 中的赝戈德斯通自旋能隙主要由亚开尔文温度下的量子效应主导，因此其随变暖的特征增长是由热波动引起的。

title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
abstract: The martensitic transformations in stoichiometric Ni$_2$MnGa and related Heusler alloys are governed by a delicate interplay between electronic structure, magnetism, and lattice dynamics. While density functional theory (DFT) has successfully mapped the energy landscape of modulated martensites, it remains computationally prohibitive for capturing finite-temperature dynamics across relevant length and time scales. Here, we bridge this gap by constructing DFT-trained machine-learning force-fields (ML-FF) interpolated from ab initio molecular dynamics. We demonstrate that ML-FF trained on DFT data can reproduce key features of Ni$_2$MnGa, including the soft TA$_2$ phonon and a preference for nanotwinned martensites. Using classical molecular dynamics simulations, we explore the impact of adaptive nanotwinning on the austenite-martensite transition, which facilitates the dynamics of both, forward and backward transformation. We demonstrate, that the negative twin boundary energy along the entire transformations path predicted by DFT for $T=0$, supports the formation of ordered modulated martensites at finite temperatures. Our results pave the way for large-scale simulations of magnetic shape memory alloys with near-DFT accuracy.
summary:
化学计量 Ni$_2$MnGa 和相关 Heusler 合金中的马氏体转变受电子结构、磁性和晶格动力学之间微妙的相互作用控制。虽然密度泛函理论（DFT）已经成功地绘制了调制马氏体的能量图，但它在计算上仍然无法捕获相关长度和时间尺度的有限温度动态。在这里，我们通过构建从头开始分子动力学插值的 DFT 训练的机器学习力场 (ML-FF) 来弥补这一差距。我们证明，在 DFT 数据上训练的 ML-FF 可以重现 Ni$_2$MnGa 的关键特征，包括软 TA$_2$ 声子和对纳米孪晶马氏体的偏好。使用经典的分子动力学模拟，我们探索了自适应纳米孪晶对奥氏体-马氏体转变的影响，这促进了向前和向后转变的动力学。我们证明，沿着 DFT 预测的 $T=0$ 整个转变路径的负孪晶边界能支持在有限温度下形成有序调制马氏体。

我们的结果为具有接近 DFT 精度的磁性形状记忆合金的大规模模拟铺平了道路。

title: Emergence of Nonlocal Hydrodynamics in Many-Body Radiative Heat Transport
abstract: We develop a nonlocal hydrodynamic theory of radiative heat transport in many-body systems by coarse graining their microscopic electrodynamic interactions. Long-range radiative exchange naturally generates a spatially nonlocal constitutive relation in which the heat current at a given position depends on temperature gradients over an extended region, while energy conservation retains its local conservative form. Fourier transport emerges as a controlled long-wavelength limit when the interaction kernel has a finite second spatial moment. When this moment fails to converge, spatial nonlocality survives coarse graining and gives rise to non-Fourier transport. The resulting framework establishes a systematic bridge between discrete many-body fluctuational electrodynamics and a continuous description of radiative heat transport.
summary: 我们通过粗粒化微观电动力学相互作用，发展了多体系统中辐射热传输的非局域流体动力学理论。长程辐射交换自然地产生空间非局部本构关系，其中给定位置的热流取决于扩展区域的温度梯度，而能量守恒保留其局部保守形式。当相互作用核具有有限的第二空间矩时，傅立叶传输作为受控的长波长极限出现。当这个矩无法收敛时，空间非定域性会在粗粒化中幸存下来并产生非傅立叶传输。由此产生的框架在离散多体波动电动力学和辐射热传输的连续描述之间建立了一座系统桥梁。

title: Superconductivity from altermagnetic fluctuations: the crucial role of sublattice polarization
abstract: Unconventional superconductivity in correlated systems often appears in the vicinity of a magnetically ordered state. This situation is also relevant for altermagnets, characterized by a nonrelativistic spin-split electronic structure in the presence of Néel order. Many proposed altermagnetic candidates, however, never cross the magnetic instability. We study superconductivity arising from altermagnetic fluctuations in such systems and show that the sublattice polarization (SLP) of the normal-state bands plays a pivotal role in determining the superconducting state. SLP, an inherent property of altermagnetic band structures that persists even without magnetic order, prevents Cooper pairs from forming between different sublattices. This suppresses pairing mediated by the nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic exchange, which favors spin-singlet superconductivity, and leaves longer-range same-sublattice bonds dominant. When the next-nearest-neighbor exchange is ferromagnetic, as expected for frustration-free Néel order, this results in spin-triplet superconductivity. This mechanism is fundamentally different from that in altermagnets with long-range Néel order, where the spin-split Fermi surfaces favor equal-spin pairing. Finally, when longer-range interactions in the disordered phase instead favor singlet pairing, SLP leads to singlet states with characteristic properties distinct from nearest-neighbor pairing states.
summary:
相关系统中的非常规超导性通常出现在磁有序态附近。这种情况也与交流磁体相关，其特征是存在尼尔阶的非相对论自旋分裂电子​​结构。然而，许多提出的变磁候选方案从未跨越磁不稳定性。我们研究了此类系统中交变磁涨落产生的超导性，并表明常态带的亚晶格极化（SLP）在确定超导状态中起着关键作用。 SLP 是交变磁带结构的一种固有特性，即使没有磁序，它也仍然存在，可防止不同亚晶格之间形成库珀对。这抑制了由最近邻反铁磁交换介导的配对，有利于自旋单线超导性，并使长程同亚晶格键占主导地位。当下一个最近邻交换是铁磁性时，正如无挫败尼尔顺序所预期的那样，这会导致自旋三重态超导。

这种机制与长程尼尔序交变磁体的机制有根本的不同，后者的自旋分裂费米面有利于等自旋配对。最后，当无序相中的长程相互作用有利于单线态配对时，SLP 会产生具有与最近邻配对状态不同特征的单线态。

title: Interlayer Registry Controls Polar Topology in Twisted Bilayer h-BN
abstract: Twisting van der Waals bilayers creates a moir'e stacking field with periodically varying local interlayer registry, enabling spatially patterned polarization. However, a systematic understanding of how this registry-controlled polar topology evolves with twist angle, temperature, and mechanical strain is still lacking. Here, using first-principles-trained deep-potential molecular dynamics simulations, we show that spatially varying interlayer registry governs the polarization texture and can be directly tuned by twist and relative layer deformation. As the twist angle decreases, the moir'e polarization texture evolves from compact, nearly circular vortex-like patterns to extended triangular AB/BA domains. This crossover arises from enhanced lattice relaxation at small twist angles, which expands low-energy, oppositely polarized AB/BA regions and confines in-plane polarization mainly to domain boundaries. Despite this reconstruction, the local in-plane winding remains tied to interlayer registry and persists up to 1000 K, indicating robust topology against thermal fluctuations. We further show that the mechanical response is dictated by whether deformation changes the relative registry: homogeneous deformation of both layers produces only weak distortions, whereas layer-selective deformation strongly reconstructs the moiré polarization texture. A mismatch-matrix registry-mapping model is developed to capture this response, explaining deformation-induced changes in vortex radii at larger twist angles and triangular-domain geometry at smaller twist angles. These results identify interlayer registry as the central control parameter for forming and tuning moir'e polar topology in twisted bilayer h-BN.
summary:
扭转范德瓦尔斯双层会产生莫尔堆叠场，并具有周期性变化的局部层间配准，从而实现空间图案化偏振。然而，对于这种由注册表控制的极性拓扑如何随扭转角、温度和机械应变演变的系统性理解仍然缺乏。在这里，使用第一原理训练的深势分子动力学模拟，我们表明空间变化的层间配准控制偏振纹理，并且可以通过扭曲和相对层变形直接调节。随着扭转角减小，莫尔偏振纹理从紧凑、近圆形涡旋状图案演变为扩展的三角形AB/BA域。这种交叉源于小扭转角下增强的晶格弛豫，这扩展了低能量、相反极化的 AB/BA 区域，并将面内极化主要限制在域边界。尽管进行了这种重构，局部面内绕组仍然与层间配准相关，并且持续高达 1000 K，这表明拓扑结构能够抵抗热波动。

我们进一步表明，机械响应取决于变形是否改变相对配准：两层的均匀变形仅产生微弱的扭曲，而层选择性变形强烈地重建莫尔偏振纹理。开发了失配矩阵注册映射模型来捕获这种响应，解释了较大扭转角下变形引起的涡旋半径变化和较小扭转角下的三角域几何形状。这些结果将层间配准确定为形成和调整扭曲双层 h-BN 莫尔条纹极性拓扑的中心控制参数。

title: Real-space obstruction control of the shift current in two-dimensional Quantum Spin Hall insulators
abstract: The search for materials exhibiting a large bulk photovoltaic effect has recently expanded to low-band-gap systems capable of operating in the infrared regime, with potential applications in optoelectronics. Among the microscopic mechanisms contributing to this phenomenon, the shift current is one of the dominant sources of photocurrent generation. Owing to its geometric origin, the shift current is not only determined by the optical transition probability but also by the real-space displacement associated with the optical excitation, making non-centrosymmetric materials with obstructed electronic wave functions particularly promising candidates. In this work, using a tight-binding model of a quantum spin Hall insulator on a triangular lattice, we investigate the nonlinear photocurrent across trivial, quantum spin Hall, and higher-order topological insulating phases. We show that obstructed topological phases exhibit a substantially enhanced shift-current response, despite the similar electronic band structure. We identify the origin of this enhancement in optical transitions between states belonging to distinct Wannier-center sectors, which allow for a large real-space displacement upon photoexcitation and, depending on the topological phase, control the sign of the shift current. Our results extend the search for controllable bulk photovoltaic effects to materials characterized by real-space electronic obstruction and identify indenene, a monolayer of In on SiC(0001), as a promising candidate for realizing this phenomenon.
summary:
对表现出大体积光伏效应的材料的研究最近已扩展到能够在红外区域工作的低带隙系统，并在光电子学中具有潜在的应用。在导致这种现象的微观机制中，移位电流是光电流产生的主要来源之一。由于其几何起源，位移电流不仅由光学跃迁概率决定，还由与光学激发相关的实空间位移决定，这使得具有受阻电子波函数的非中心对称材料特别有前途的候选材料。在这项工作中，我们使用三角晶格上量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的紧束缚模型，研究了平凡、量子自旋霍尔和高阶拓扑绝缘相之间的非线性光电流。我们表明，尽管电子能带结构相似，但受阻拓扑相表现出显着增强的位移电流响应。

我们确定了属于不同万尼尔中心扇区的状态之间光学跃迁增强的起源，这允许在光激发时产生大的真实空间位移，并且根据拓扑相控制移位电流的符号。我们的研究结果将可控体光伏效应的研究扩展到以实空间电子阻碍为特征的材料，并确定茚烯（SiC（0001）上的单层 In）是实现这一现象的有希望的候选者。

title: Activity-Induced Structural and Dynamical Heterogeneity in Colloidal Gels
abstract: Active gels are intrinsically non-equilibrium materials whose structural and dynamical heterogeneity emerges from the interplay of attractive interactions, thermal fluctuations, and self-propulsion. We investigate a model active gel, simulated using large-scale Brownian dynamics simulations, to explore the effects of temperature $T$, active force strength $f_0$, persistence timescale $\tau_p$, and active particle concentration $\rho_a$. We characterize the structure of the evolving gel network through morphological analysis, while dynamical changes are quantified by the relaxation timescale and dynamical heterogeneity (DH). We show that an optimal choice of activity parameters yields a percolating gel network with faster gelation and larger voids and clusters, enhancing mechanical stability. Conversely, the structural relaxation timescale and DH decrease with increasing activity, indicating enhanced particle rearrangements and reduced spatial correlations of mobile and immobile regions. An effective temperature ($T_\text{eff}$) framework for colloidal gels maps structural quantities and relaxation timescales in an active gel onto those of a passive gel. More interestingly, the growth of DH with increasing swim force can also be described by the same effective-temperature framework, in stark contrast to observations in active glasses. Our findings show that, in colloidal gels, temperature and active force compete, giving rise to similar structural ordering and, consequently, similar DH at the same $T_\text{eff}$. These findings highlight the crucial role of structural ordering in governing DH in active colloidal gels, as compared to active glasses.
summary:
活性凝胶本质上是非平衡材料，其结构和动力学异质性源于吸引力相互作用、热波动和自推进的相互作用。我们研究了使用大规模布朗动力学模拟模拟的模型活性凝胶，以探索温度 $T$、主动力强度 $f_0$、持久时间尺度 $\tau_p$ 和活性粒子浓度 $\rho_a$ 的影响。我们通过形态分析来表征不断演化的凝胶网络的结构，同时通过弛豫时间尺度和动态异质性（DH）来量化动态变化。我们表明，活性参数的最佳选择会产生具有更快凝胶化和更大空隙和簇的渗透凝胶网络，从而增强机械稳定性。相反，结构弛豫时间尺度和 DH 随着活性的增加而减少，表明粒子重排增强，移动和固定区域的空间相关性降低。胶体凝胶的有效温度 ($T_\text{eff}$) 框架将活性凝胶中的结构量和弛豫时间尺度映射到被动凝胶的结构量和弛豫时间尺度上。

更有趣的是，随着游泳力的增加，DH 的增长也可以用相同的有效温度框架来描述，这与主动眼镜中的观察结果形成鲜明对比。我们的研究结果表明，在胶体凝胶中，温度和作用力相互竞争，从而产生相似的结构排序，从而在相同的 $T_\text{eff}$ 下产生相似的 DH。这些发现强调了与活性玻璃相比，活性胶体凝胶中结构排序在控制 DH 方面的关键作用。

title: Solubility of poorly soluble species in bulk and nanopores from grand-canonical Wang-Landau sampling
abstract: Poorly soluble species can have mean populations below one in small systems such as nanopores. In this regime, the grand-potential minimum, which identifies the most probable particle number, differs from the ensemble-averaged solute loading. We use grand-canonical Wang-Landau sampling (GCWLS) to calculate the density of states $\Omega(N_\mathrm{A}, N_\mathrm{B})$ for a binary Lennard-Jones mixture of solute B in solvent A, both in bulk and in slit pores. One set of GCWLS simulations gives ensemble averages over a range of chemical potentials, whereas conventional grand-canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulation requires a separate simulation at each state point. Independent GCMC simulations confirm the GCWLS ensemble averages. The solvent number distribution is nearly Gaussian, whereas the dilute solute distribution is skewed and Poisson-like. The most probable solute number therefore lies below the ensemble-averaged loading $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle$ and is zero whenever $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle<1$. Reading the solute loading from the grand-potential minimum underestimates it and can falsely indicate that no solute is present. Defining the oversolubility as $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}=x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{conf}}/x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{bulk}}$, where $x_\mathrm{B}$ is the solute mole fraction, we find $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}\approx12$ in a pore of 3.5 particle diameters width when both wall interactions are repulsive. Adding wall-solute attraction moderately raises it to $\approx13$, whereas wall-solvent attraction lowers it to $\approx3.4$. This comparison shows that the wall-solvent interaction controls most of the enhancement. As the pore widens, $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}$ decreases toward unity. In bulk and in nanopores alike, the solubility of poorly soluble species should be obtained from ensemble averages rather than from grand-potential minima.
summary:
在纳米孔等小系统中，难溶性物质的平均数量可能低于 1。在这种情况下，确定最可能粒子数的大势最小值与整体平均溶质负载不同。我们使用大正则 Wang-Landau 采样 (GCWLS) 来计算溶剂 A 中溶质 B 的二元 Lennard-Jones 混合物的状态密度 $\Omega(N_\mathrm{A}, N_\mathrm{B})$，无论是在本体还是狭缝孔中。一组 GCWLS 模拟给出了一系列化学势的系综平均值，而传统的大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟需要在每个状态点进行单独的模拟。独立 GCMC 模拟证实了 GCWLS 系综平均值。溶剂数分布接近高斯分布，而稀溶质分布呈偏态且呈泊松分布。因此，最可能的溶质数位于整体平均载荷 $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle$ 之下，并且每当 $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle<1$ 时为零。从大电位最小值读取溶质负载会低估它，并且可能错误地表明不存在溶质。

将过溶解度定义为 $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}=x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{conf}}/x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{bulk}}$，其中 $x_\mathrm{B}$ 是溶质摩尔分数，我们发现 $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}\approx12$ 在3.5 当两个壁相互作用都具有排斥力时的颗粒直径宽度。添加壁溶质吸引力将其适度提高到$\approx13$，而壁溶剂吸引力将其降低到$\approx3.4$。该比较表明壁-溶剂相互作用控制了大部分增强。随着孔隙变宽，$\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}$ 趋于一致。在本体和纳米孔中，难溶物质的溶解度应该从整体平均值而不是从大势最小值获得。

title: Nontrivial topological properties from the cooperation of static perturbations and Floquet fields in type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive theoretical study for the topological and anomalous transport properties of type-II SDSMs under three scenarios, i.e., static symmetry-breaking perturbations, periodic Floquet driving by two-frequency orthogonally polarized light (TFOPL), and their cooperative effects in the hybrid scenario. We first show that a static mass $m_z$ opens a bulk gap and drives the system into a Chern insulator with Chern number $C^{\rm per}=\pm 2\,{\rm sgn}(m_z)$. In comparison, TFOPL alone only shifts the positions of Dirac points and cannot open a full gap. Nevertheless, it produces a Berry curvature odd in the $x$-direction, yielding a finite Berry curvature dipole (BCD) along $x$ proportional to the sine of the initial phase, while the $y$-component vanishes. The hybrid scenario, by contrast, exhibits a remarkably rich phenomenology. Specifically, its gap-closure criterion becomes cubic and thus admits up to three real roots when the effective parameter along the $x$-direction is negative, thereby producing multiple light-tunable gap-closing points and a series of topological phase transitions. In particular, the BCD exhibits a double-peak structure with strong enhancement near gap-closing manifolds and synchronized sign reversal of the full vector under external tuning. We further analyze the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC), anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC), and anomalous thermal Hall conductivity (ATHC). The AHC and ATHC exhibit quantized plateaus that serve as signatures of Chern-insulator phases, while the ANC, being a Fermi-surface probe, provides complementary local information and can identify light-induced gaps even when global topological invariants remain unchanged. Taken together, these results offer useful insights into the topological properties of 2D type-II SDSMs and related systems.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们对静态对称破缺扰动、二频正交偏振光（TFOPL）周期性Floquet驱动三种场景下II型SDSM的拓扑和反常输运特性以及它们在混合场景中的协同效应进行了全面的理论研究。我们首先证明静态质量 $m_z$ 打开了一个体积间隙并将系统驱动到陈绝缘体，其陈数为 $C^{\rm per}=\pm 2\,{\rm sgn}(m_z)$。相比之下，单独的 TFOPL 只能移动狄拉克点的位置，并不能打开完整的间隙。然而，它在 $x$ 方向上产生奇数贝里曲率，沿 $x$ 产生与初始相位的正弦成比例的有限贝里曲率偶极子 (BCD)，而 $y$ 分量消失。相比之下，混合场景则展现出极其丰富的现象学。具体来说，当沿$x$方向的有效参数为负时，其间隙闭合准则变为三次，因此最多允许三个实根，从而产生多个光可调间隙闭合点和一系列拓扑相变。

特别是，BCD 表现出双峰结构，在间隙闭合流形附近具有强增强，并且在外部调谐下全矢量的同步符号反转。我们进一步分析了反常霍尔电导率（AHC）、反常能斯特电导率（ANC）和反常热霍尔电导率（ATHC）。 AHC 和 ATHC 表现出量化平台，作为陈绝缘体相的特征，而 ANC 作为费米表面探针，提供互补的局部信息，即使在全局拓扑不变量保持不变的情况下也可以识别光引起的间隙。总而言之，这些结果为了解二维 II 型 SDSM 和相关系统的拓扑特性提供了有用的见解。

title: Topological Chiral Superconductivity from Doping Correlated Charge Transfer Insulator with Orbital Magnetism
abstract: Topological chiral superconductivity has been extensively studied from the perspective of electronic structures in momentum space, while its emergence from real-space processes in strongly interacting systems remains largely unexplored. Here, we study a doped charge-transfer insulator in a strongly repulsive spinless-fermion model with three sublattices and $2\pi$ flux per unit cell. Combining perturbative analysis, exact diagonalization, and density matrix renormalization group simulations, we establish a topological superconducting ground state with $p+ip$ symmetry. In the large charge-transfer gap limit, chiral charge-transfer excitations generate a correlated-hopping process that provides a microscopic mechanism for electron pairing and its chiral structure. The chiral superconductivity persists into the smaller-gap regime, where chiral excitonic two-particle bound state can emerge. Our results establish a concrete real-space route to topological chiral superconductivity upon doping strongly interacting charge-transfer insulators with orbital magnetism.
summary: 拓扑手性超导已经从动量空间中的电子结构的角度进行了广泛的研究，而它在强相互作用系统中的真实空间过程中的出现仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这里，我们研究了具有三个子晶格和每晶胞 $2\pi$ 通量的强排斥无旋费米子模型中的掺杂电荷转移绝缘体。结合微扰分析、精确对角化和密度矩阵重正化群模拟，我们建立了具有 $p+ip$ 对称性的拓扑超导基态。在大电荷转移间隙限制下，手性电荷转移激发产生相关跳跃过程，为电子配对及其手性结构提供微观机制。手性超导性持续到较小能隙区域，其中可以出现手性激子双粒子束缚态。我们的结果建立了通过掺杂具有轨道磁性的强相互作用电荷转移绝缘体来实现拓扑手性超导的具体真实空间路线。

title: Confinement-deconfinement transitions in the dimer-loop models on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices
abstract: Recent work [Kundu, Damle, Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025)] has demonstrated that a class of $S=1$ kagome lattice antiferromagnets with competing anisotropies can exhibit unusual low-temperature behavior that is best described in terms of the statistical mechanics of an interesting interpolation between the fully-packed dimer model and the fully-packed loop model on the bipartite honeycomb lattice. On this and other bipartite lattices in two and three dimension, such fully-packed dimer-loop models generically have two distinct power-law correlated Coulomb phases, both of which admit a low-energy description in terms of a fluctuating divergence-free polarization vector field [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025); arXiv:2510.11607 ]. The transition between these phases corresponds to a confinement transition for the $Z_2$ part of the corresponding $U(1)$ flux [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025); arXiv:2510.11607 ]. Here we demonstrate that a variant of such a topological confinement transition can also exist in dimer-loop models on non-bipartite lattices such as the kagome and triangular lattices although the low-energy description does not feature any conserved $U(1)$ flux. In these non-bipartite dimer-loop models, both phases are short-range correlated liquids, and the topological distinction between them is in terms of a $Z_2$-valued winding number instead of the flux of a divergence-free polarization field. In spite of this key difference, this transition appears to be in the same Ising universality class as the analogous transition of the bipartite dimer-loop models. These kagome and triangular lattice dimer-loop models correspond respectively to the low-energy limit of a class of $S=1$ antiferromagnets with competing anisotropies on the ruby lattice comprising a corner-sharing arrangement of fully-frustrated squares and a lattice of corner-sharing fully-frustrated hexagons.
summary:
最近的工作[Kundu，Damle，Phys。 Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025)] 证明，一类具有竞争各向异性的 $S=1$ kagome 晶格反铁磁体可以表现出不寻常的低温行为，这种行为最好用二分蜂窝晶格上的全填充二聚体模型和全填充环模型之间有趣的插值的统计力学来描述。在二维和三维的该二分晶格和其他二分晶格上，这种完全堆积的二聚体环模型通常具有两个不同的幂律相关库仑相，这两个相都允许根据波动无散度偏振矢量场进行低能量描述[Phys.修订版 X 15, 011018 (2025)； arXiv：2510.11607]。这些阶段之间的转变对应于相应 $U(1)$ 通量的 $Z_2$ 部分的限制转变 [Phys.修订版 X 15, 011018 (2025)； arXiv：2510.11607]。在这里，我们证明这种拓扑限制转变的变体也可以存在于非二分晶格（例如 kagome 和三角晶格）的二聚体环模型中，尽管低能描述不具有任何守恒 $U(1)$ 通量。

在这些非二分二聚体环模型中，两个相都是短程相关液体，它们之间的拓扑区别在于 $Z_2$ 值的缠绕数，而不是无发散偏振场的通量。尽管存在这一关键差异，但这种转变似乎与二分二聚体环模型的类似转变属于相同的伊辛普遍性类别。这些 kagome 和三角晶格二聚体环模型分别对应于红宝石晶格上具有竞争各向异性的一类 $S=1$ 反铁磁体的低能极限，该红宝石晶格包括完全受抑正方形的共享角排列和完全受阻六边形共享角的晶格。

title: Colloid-Colloid Interactions Impact Network Morphology of Confined Colloidal Drying Patterns
abstract: Colloidal suspensions that are confined between two closely spaced plates and left to evaporate slowly form maze-like labyrinth patterns in the final stage of evaporation. The fingers in these patterns form bifurcations and occasionally loops, which we may quantify with a skeletonization method. We compare drying patterns formed with two different salt concentrations in the droplet which changes the screening length and therefore the effective colloid interactions. We find that the junctions generally follow Murray's law for optimal transport networks, and that the typical bifurcation angles peak around 53. Screened droplets additionally show more loopy networks, and is characterized by bands of transversal fingers before merging into a central non-fingering colloidal aggregate. Our observations suggest that colloid-colloid interactions can strongly influence the large-scale topology of the pattern while leaving the local geometry of the individual fingers unchanged.
summary: 胶体悬浮液被限制在两个紧密间隔的板之间并缓慢蒸发，在蒸发的最后阶段形成迷宫般的迷宫图案。这些图案中的手指形成分叉，偶尔形成环，我们可以用骨架化方法对其进行量化。我们比较了液滴中两种不同盐浓度形成的干燥模式，这改变了筛选长度，从而改变了有效的胶体相互作用。我们发现，连接点通常遵循默里定律以获得最佳传输网络，并且典型的分叉角峰值约为 53。筛选的液滴还显示出更多的环状网络，其特征是在合并到中心非指状胶体聚集体之前具有横向指状带。我们的观察表明，胶体-胶体相互作用可以强烈影响图案的大规模拓扑，同时保持各个手指的局部几何形状不变。

title: 1/f frequency-noise reduction in nanomechanical resonators by dissipation dilution
abstract: The frequency noise of a resonant nanomechanical sensor is well understood down to its thermomechanical limit, but the longest useful averaging time is set by a flicker, or $1/f$, frequency-noise floor whose origin has remained unknown. We show that this floor is the thermal noise of the tension. By the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, the tension of a resonator with fixed ends fluctuates by an amount set by the loss angle of its material; for structural damping, these fluctuations produce $1/f$ frequency noise with a flicker coefficient $h_{-1}=E k_{\mathrm{B}} T/(2\pi V\sigma_0^2 Q_{\mathrm{el}})$, with $Q_{\mathrm{el}}$ the intrinsic loss under elongation, that contains no free parameter and is diluted by the tensile stress $\sigma_0$ in the same way as damping is in dissipation dilution. Silicon nitride strings and membranes from 30 to 340~nm thickness follow the predicted volume scaling, the predicted $\sigma_0^{-2}$ dilution across resonators and within stress-engineered strings, and the predicted thickness dependence, which places noise-active two-level systems in the volume and at the surfaces of the resonators, all at the absolute level set by the independently measured intrinsic loss. The same relation accounts for published data between 78 and 296~K; below 78~K, the loss measured at the resonance no longer represents the loss probed by the noise, marking the limit of the structural-damping assumption. Dissipation dilution therefore lowers the $1/f$ floor, and the longest useful integration time of a resonant sensor is set by its prestress, volume, temperature, and intrinsic loss angle.
summary:
谐振纳米机械传感器的频率噪声低至其热机械极限已被很好地理解，但最长的有用平均时间是由闪烁或 $1/f$ 频率噪声本底设定的，其起源仍然未知。我们证明这个层是张力的热噪声。根据波动耗散定理，具有固定端的谐振器的张力波动的量由其材料的损耗角设定；对于结构阻尼，这些波动会产生 $1/f$ 频率噪声，闪烁系数 $h_{-1}=E k_{\mathrm{B}} T/(2\pi V\sigma_0^2 Q_{\mathrm{el}})$，其中 $Q_{\mathrm{el}}$ 是伸长下的固有损耗，不包含自由参数，并以相同的方式被拉伸应力 $\sigma_0$ 稀释因为阻尼是耗散稀释的。

厚度为 30 至 340 nm 的氮化硅弦和膜遵循预测的体积缩放、谐振器之间和应力工程弦内的预测 $\sigma_0^{-2}$ 稀释以及预测的厚度依赖性，将噪声活性两级系统置于谐振器的体积和表面处，所有这些都处于由独立测量的固有损耗设定的绝对水平。 78 和 296~K 之间的已发表数据也具有相同的关系；低于 78~K，在谐振处测得的损耗不再代表噪声探测到的损耗，标志着结构阻尼假设的极限。因此，耗散稀释降低了 $1/f$ 下限，并且谐振传感器的最长有用积分时间由其预应力、体积、温度和固有损耗角决定。

title: Emergent Spinorial Structure in Mesoscopic Irreversible Thermodynamics
abstract: We reconstruct a geometry of thermodynamic coordinates from transport coefficients within a mesoscopic canonical model. Self-adjoint flux observables determine a compatible evolution generator containing symmetric and antisymmetric transport coefficients. When the Hermitian transport tensor is positive, an exact graded first-order factorization reproduces this generator on its scalar sector. Its commutators define a spectral distance whose metric depends only on the symmetric tensor. Gradients of the antisymmetric tensor can change the evolution while leaving the metric unchanged. The construction allows coordinate-dependent coefficients. In the constant Onsager regime, a Clifford representation gives the same distance and an algebra fixed by the transport matrix. Published transport data for a $\mathrm{Bi_2Te_3}$ film give a principal-distance ratio of approximately $2.12$ in normalized coordinates at $ZT\simeq0.68$. We also examine a separate quadratic entropy-production observable and distinguish its discrete spectrum from the spectrum of the evolution generator. The spinorial representation adds no physical spin degrees of freedom.
summary: 我们根据介观规范模型内的传输系数重建热力学坐标的几何形状。自伴通量可观测量确定包含对称和反对称输运系数的兼容演化生成器。当埃尔米特传输张量为正时，精确分级的一阶因式分解会在其标量扇区上重现该生成器。它的换向器定义了一个谱距离，其度量仅取决于对称张量。反对称张量的梯度可以改变演化，同时保持度量不变。该结构允许依赖于坐标的系数。在恒定的 Onsager 体系中，Clifford 表示给出相同的距离和由传输矩阵固定的代数。已发布的 $\mathrm{Bi_2Te_3}$ 薄膜的输运数据在 $ZT\simeq0.68$ 的归一化坐标中给出的主距比约为 $2.12$。我们还检查了一个单独的二次熵产生可观测量，并将其离散谱与演化生成器的谱区分开来。旋量表示不增加物理旋转自由度。

title: Impact of shear and dilational membrane viscosities on capsule shape and dynamics under shear flow: a theoretical study
abstract: In artificial (micro)capsules or cells such as red blood cells for example, the two-dimensional (2D) rheology of the membrane (or the shell) is viscoelastic and not only elastic. The deformation and inclination of such a capsule are theoretically studied under shear and extensional flows. The membrane mechanics is described by the Kelvin-Voigt model: the 2D dissipation with the Boussinesq-Scriven law associated to specific dilational and shear Boussinesq numbers $Bq_d$ and $Bq_d$ respectively while the elastic constitutive law is either Hookean, strain-softening (neoHookean) or strain-hardening (Skalak). The dynamics depends on the elastic capillary number $Ca$, the Poisson ratio (or $C$ in Skalak law), the viscosity ratio $\lambda$, the nonlinearities included in the constitutive law and both boussinesq numbers. Three dynamics are identified in the limit of weak deformations: a tank-treading motion in the limit of small elastic capillary number with a characteristic time depending on $\lambda$, $Bq_s$ and $Bq_d$, an oscillation without any elasticity and a damped oscillation leading to a tank-treading motion in the limit of large Boussinesq numbers. In all cases, both shear and dilational 2D dissipations contribute differently leading to non-trivial results. In the case of a Skalak law with $C=1$, $Bq=Bq_s=Bq_d$ and $Bq>>\lambda$, the deformations in the limits $Ca<<1$, $Bq=O(1)$ and $Ca=O(1)$, $Bq>>1$ determined in the seminal work of \cite{barthes1985role} are recovered.
summary:
例如，在人造（微）胶囊或红细胞等细胞中，膜（或壳）的二维（2D）流变性不仅是弹性，而且是粘弹性的。从理论上研究了这种胶囊在剪切流和拉伸流下的变形和倾斜。膜力学由 Kelvin-Voigt 模型描述：具有 Boussinesq-Scriven 定律的二维耗散分别与特定的膨胀和剪切 Boussinesq 数 $Bq_d$ 和 $Bq_d$ 相关，而弹性本构定律是 Hookean、应变软化 (neoHookean) 或应变硬化 (Skalak)。动力学取决于弹性毛细管数 $Ca$、泊松比（或 Skalak 定律中的 $C$）、粘度比 $\lambda$、本构定律中包含的非线性以及两个布辛涅斯克数。在弱变形极限中确定了三种动力学：在小弹性毛细管数极限下的坦克踩踏运动，其特征时间取决于$\lambda$、$Bq_s$和$Bq_d$，没有任何弹性的振荡和导致大布辛斯克数极限下的坦克踩踏运动的阻尼振荡。

在所有情况下，剪切和膨胀二维耗散都有不同的贡献，从而产生不平凡的结果。在具有 $C=1$、$Bq=Bq_s=Bq_d$ 和 $Bq>>\lambda$ 的 Skalak 定律的情况下，在 \cite{barthes1985role} 的开创性工作中确定的限制 $Ca<<1$、$Bq=O(1)$ 和 $Ca=O(1)$、$Bq>>1$ 中的变形被恢复。

title: Transport Determines Spectral Distance in Mesoscopic Thermodynamics
abstract: We derive a distance between thermodynamic states from a positive Hermitian transport tensor within a mesoscopic canonical model. An exact first-order factorization of the evolution generator gives a commutator norm and the metric $G=2g^{-1}$, where $g$ denotes the symmetric transport tensor. Gradients of the antisymmetric tensor can change the evolution, but they leave this distance unchanged. The construction allows coordinate-dependent coefficients. For constant Onsager coefficients, a Clifford representation gives the same metric. In a two-channel thermoelectric system, the ratio of normalized principal distances is $\sqrt{1+ZT}+\sqrt{ZT}$. Transport coupling thus fixes the anisotropy of this metric. The construction requires neither an independent metric nor a physical spin variable.
summary: 我们从介观正则模型中的正埃尔米特传输张量得出热力学状态之间的距离。进化生成器的精确一阶因式分解给出了换向器范数和度量 $G=2g^{-1}$，其中 $g$ 表示对称传输张量。反对称张量的梯度可以改变演化，但它们使这个距离保持不变。该结构允许依赖于坐标的系数。对于常数 Onsager 系数，Clifford 表示给出相同的度量。在双通道热电系统中，归一化主距离之比为 $\sqrt{1+ZT}+\sqrt{ZT}$。因此，传输耦合固定了该度量的各向异性。该构造既不需要独立的度量，也不需要物理自旋变量。

title: Quantum Ising transition on the Cayley tree: boundary criticality, universality, and an effective Bethe line
abstract: We investigate quantum criticality in the transverse-field Ising model on finite Cayley trees and demonstrate that their extensive boundary fundamentally changes the nature of the quantum phase transition compared with the infinite, boundary-free Bethe lattice. Using tree tensor-network simulations for systems with up to $N=12286$ sites, we identify a boundary-driven continuous transition at $h_x^c\approx1.76$, distinct from the mean-field Bethe-lattice transition at $h_x^c\approx2.23$. We characterize this transition through finite-size scaling of the magnetization and magnetic susceptibility and extract a consistent set of critical exponents. By introducing next-nearest-neighbor interactions, we demonstrate the robustness of the extracted critical exponents, providing numerical argument for the Ising boundary universality class on the Cayley tree. Furthermore, we show that the physics of the boundary-free Bethe lattice can be efficiently recovered on a finite Cayley tree by fine-tuning a local boundary field. The resulting \textit{effective Bethe line}, whose existence is tied to the mean-field nature of the bulk transition, effectively screens the extensive boundary and restores both the critical point and the mean-field critical scaling of the infinite Bethe lattice.
summary:
我们研究了有限凯莱树上横向场伊辛模型的量子临界性，并证明与无限、无边界贝特晶格相比，它们的广泛边界从根本上改变了量子相变的性质。对最多 $N=12286$ 站点的系统使用树张量网络模拟，我们在 $h_x^c\approx1.76$ 处识别出边界驱动的连续转变，与 $h_x^c\approx2.23$ 处的平均场 Bethe 晶格转变不同。我们通过磁化强度和磁化率的有限尺寸缩放来表征这种转变，并提取一组一致的临界指数。通过引入次近邻相互作用，我们证明了提取的临界指数的鲁棒性，为凯莱树上的伊辛边界普遍性类提供了数值论证。此外，我们表明，通过微调局部边界场，可以在有限凯莱树上有效地恢复无边界贝特晶格的物理特性。

由此产生的 \textit{有效贝特线}，其存在与体相变的平均场性质相关，有效地屏蔽了广泛的边界，并恢复了无限贝特晶格的临界点和平均场临界标度。

title: Information Entropy as a Sensitive Diagnostic of Relaxation Dynamics in a Quasiperiodic Mott Insulator
abstract: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics of a bosonic Mott insulator following a sudden quench from a periodic to a quasiperiodic lattice. Using ab initio multiconfigurational (MCTDHB) continuum many-body dynamics, we characterize the evolution through momentum distributions, fragmenta- tion, correlation functions, and information entropy. We find that melting of Mott correlations does not necessarily imply relaxation of the many-body state. In the weakly interacting regime, the initial Mott-like correlation undergo recurrent melting and partial recovery, while the information entropy displays large, intermittent fluctuations within the simulated time window. In contrast, a strongly interacting and fully fragmented Mott insulator retains its characteristic Mott correla- tions, up to partial distortions, while the many-body information entropy approaches a well-defined stationary regime plateau with comparatively small fluctuations. These results indicate that Mott- correlation dynamics and many-body relaxation can be dissociated in this finite system and support the use of information entropy, evaluated in the multiconfigurational representation, as a sensitive complementary diagnostic of nonequilibrium relaxation.
summary:
我们研究了玻色莫特绝缘体从周期晶格突然淬灭到准周期晶格后的非平衡动力学。使用从头开始多构型（MCTDHB）连续多体动力学，我们通过动量分布、碎片、相关函数和信息熵来表征演化。我们发现莫特相关性的融化并不一定意味着多体态的松弛。在弱相互作用状态下，初始的类莫特相关性会经历反复的熔化和部分恢复，而信息熵在模拟的时间窗口内显示出较大的间歇性波动。相比之下，强相互作用和完全碎片化的莫特绝缘体保留其特征莫特相关性，直到部分扭曲，而多体信息熵接近一个明确定义的稳定状态平台，波动相对较小。

这些结果表明，莫特相关动力学和多体弛豫可以在这个有限系统中分离，并支持使用在多构型表示中评估的信息熵作为非平衡弛豫的敏感补充诊断。

title: Trust-Limited Machine-Learning-Accelerated Nudged Elastic Band Calculations for Small-Polaron Hopping in Rutile TiO2
abstract: Nudged elastic band (NEB) calculations of small-polaron hopping are demanding because nuclear motion is coupled to a self-consistent localized electronic state. Near the charge-transfer region, slow self-consistent-field convergence, localization switching, and competing electronic solutions complicate surrogate-assisted optimization. We develop a Gaussian-process-assisted NEB workflow for this regime and demonstrate electron small-polaron hopping in rutile TiO2 using spin-polarized density functional theory with a Hubbard U correction (DFT+U ) with SIESTA. A joint energy-force Gaussian process (GP) with a Matérn covariance model advances the elastic band, while active-atom root-mean-square and maximum-atom displacement limits constrain surrogate motion relative to evaluated configurations. Reaching these limits triggers first-principles sampling without requiring full surrogate convergence. Three independently DFT-verified 96-atom [001] calculations using 11, 13, and 15 images and different surrogate settings and GP parameterizations yield barriers of 0.1645, 0.1637, and 0.1640 eV, respectively, spanning 0.793 meV. In the 15-image calculation, repeated central-image sampling activates a separately calibrated local GP during surrogate optimization. Final full-band DFT verification gives a maximum projected NEB force of 0.0346 eV/Å. A 324-atom calculation yields a lower barrier of 0.1302 eV, indicating supercell sensitivity and demonstrating feasibility at larger GP observation dimension. The workflow combines controlled surrogate extrapolation, targeted charge-transfer-region interpolation, and independent DFT verification to obtain polaron migration pathways, emphasizing reproducible barriers and full-band force convergence.
summary:
小极化子跳跃的微移弹性带 (NEB) 计算要求很高，因为核运动与自洽的局域电子态耦合。在电荷转移区域附近，缓慢的自洽场收敛、局域化切换和竞争性电子解决方案使替代辅助优化变得复杂。我们为此方案开发了高斯过程辅助 NEB 工作流程，并使用自旋极化密度泛函理论以及 SIESTA 的 Hubbard U 校正 (DFT+U ) 演示了金红石 TiO2 中的电子小极化子跳跃。联合能量-力高斯过程 (GP) 与 Matérn 协方差模型推进了弹性带，而活性原子均方根和最大原子位移限制则约束相对于评估配置的替代运动。达到这些限制会触发第一原理采样，而不需要完全代理收敛。使用 11、13 和 15 个图像以及不同的替代设置和 GP 参数化进行的三个独立 DFT 验证的 96 原子 [001] 计算分别产生 0.1645、0.1637 和 0.1640 eV 的势垒，跨越 0.793 meV。

在 15 个图像计算中，重复的中心图像采样会在代理优化期间激活单独校准的局部 GP。最终的全频带 DFT 验证得出最大预计 NEB 力为 0.0346 eV/Å。 324 个原子的计算产生了 0.1302 eV 的较低势垒，表明了超胞敏感性并证明了在更大 GP 观察维度下的可行性。该工作流程结合了受控代理外推、目标电荷转移区域插值和独立的 DFT 验证，以获得极化子迁移路径，强调可重复的障碍和全带力收敛。

title: Mutual linearity from classical response theory
abstract: We unify known mutual-linearity relations for Markov jump processes and chemical reaction networks within a common framework based on classical finite-response theory. In a Markov jump process, an exact finite-response identity shows that all stationary probability changes share a common factor when the rates of one edge change. Eliminating this factor gives the relations between probabilities, observables, and currents, even far from equilibrium. We also explain how the same argument applies when one coefficient of a linear system changes and recovers the known relations in Laplace space and between stationary complex activities in chemical reaction networks.
summary: 我们将马尔可夫跳跃过程和化学反应网络的已知互线性关系统一在基于经典有限响应理论的通用框架内。在马尔可夫跳跃过程中，精确的有限响应恒等式表明，当一个边的速率发生变化时，所有平稳概率变化都共享一个公共因子。消除这个因素会给出概率、可观测值和电流之间的关系，甚至远离平衡。我们还解释了当线性系统的一个系数发生变化并恢复拉普拉斯空间中以及化学反应网络中的稳态复杂活动之间的已知关系时，如何应用相同的论点。

title: First-fracture kinetics in periodic chains: from free-energy landscapes and dynamical recrossing to absolute rates
abstract: The nearly collinear configuration of highly stretched polymer chains before fracture motivates one-dimensional models. At fixed extension, stretching one bond redistributes length among the others, coupling rupture to the whole chain. In this work, I develop a framework for fracture-healing rates in periodic Morse chains, combining deterministic theories, equilibrium simulations and a quasi-deterministic approach using equilibrium fluxes and barrier-top trajectories. Constrained-partition calculations closely reproduce simulated populations and intact-state tensions. An intact-reservoir potential of mean force (PMF) supplies the first-fracture surface probability, while recrossing corrects the attempt flux without a rate-fitted prefactor. Independent rate tests identify an operational chain-length boundary for accurate two-state kinetics; failed-return durations decrease relative to population relaxation as chains grow. Kramers-Grote-Hynes (KGH), nonlinear reactive-flux and equilibrium rates show excellent agreement in this regime. KGH predicts rates away from coexistence and a chain-dependent local activation length dominated by the barrier response. Rates decrease approximately exponentially before declining more gently for longer chains: barrier growth dominates, additional fracture sites partly compensate, and transmission varies more weakly. Beyond coexistence, long chains can fracture practically irreversibly because healing becomes too rare to observe. Projected committor crossings, where the configuration-averaged probability of reaching the fractured core first is one half, lie near site-PMF maxima, although configurations at equal bond length retain different fracture probabilities. Multiple fractures remain negligible near coexistence through at least $N=50$. The framework could supply state-dependent rates to mesoscopic fracture models of polymer networks.
summary:
断裂前高度拉伸的聚合物链几乎共线的构型激发了一维模型。在固定延伸下，拉伸一个键会重新分配其他键的长度，从而将断裂耦合到整个链。在这项工作中，我开发了一个周期性莫尔斯链骨折愈合率的框架，结合了确定性理论、平衡模拟和使用平衡通量和势垒顶轨迹的准确定性方法。约束分区计算密切再现了模拟种群和完整状态的紧张局势。平均力 (PMF) 的完整储层潜力提供了第一裂缝表面概率，而重穿越则在没有速率拟合前因子的情况下校正了尝试通量。独立的速率测试确定了精确的二态动力学的操作链长度边界；随着链的增长，失败返回的持续时间相对于人口松弛而减少。 Kramers-Grote-Hynes (KGH)、非线性无功通量和平衡速率在此状态下表现出极好的一致性。 KGH 预测远离共存的速率和由屏障响应主导的链依赖性局部激活长度。

速率大约呈指数下降，然后对于较长的链下降更为温和：势垒增长占主导地位，额外的断裂位点部分补偿，传输变化更弱。除了共存之外，长链实际上可能会不可逆转地断裂，因为愈合变得很难观察到。预计的主交叉，其中首先到达断裂核心的构型平均概率是二分之一，位于位点 PMF 最大值附近，尽管相同键长的构型保留了不同的断裂概率。至少在 $N=50$ 期间，多处骨折在共存附近仍然可以忽略不计。该框架可以为聚合物网络的细观断裂模型提供状态相关的速率。

title: High-Efficiency Field-Free Superconducting Diodes in Mo$_2$N/FePt Bilayers
abstract: Near-ideal, field-free superconducting diode behavior is demonstrated in room-temperature-grown Mo$_2$N/FePt bilayers. The response is consistent with remanent FePt stripe domains producing polarity-dependent thresholds for flux entry and vortex motion. Micromagnetic simulations reveal a periodic stray-field modulation across the stripes and asymmetric field enhancement near their ends at the bridge edges. One current polarity remains nearly dissipationless up to a sizable fraction of the estimated depairing current, whereas the opposite polarity develops dissipation at much lower current, yielding diode efficiencies up to approximately 85% in the thinner bilayer. The nonreciprocity can be continuously tuned by the in-plane magnetic preparation angle and reversibly switched by reverse-field excursions through the hysteretic reversal of the FePt layer. These results support edge-controlled flux entry and vortex motion as a route to high-efficiency superconducting diodes.
summary: 室温生长的 Mo$_2$N/FePt 双层展示了近乎理想的无场超导二极管行为。该响应与剩余 FePt 条纹域一致，产生通量进入和涡流运动的极性相关阈值。微磁模拟揭示了条纹上的周期性杂散场调制以及桥边缘附近条纹端部附近的不对称场增强。一种电流极性在达到估计脱配对电流的相当大一部分时几乎保持无耗散，而相反极性在低得多的电流下产生耗散，在较薄的双层中产生高达约 85% 的二极管效率。非互易性可以通过面内磁制备角连续调节，并通过 FePt 层的磁滞反转通过反向场偏移可逆地切换。这些结果支持边缘控制的磁通进入和涡流运动作为高效超导二极管的途径。

title: Microscopic Theory of the Acoustic Faraday Effect in Spin-Orbit Coupled Magnets
abstract: The acoustic Faraday effect probes phonon Hall viscosity through the rotation of transverse acoustic polarization, conventionally interpreted in terms of circular birefringence. We show that magnetic order breaking rotational symmetry generates anisotropic phonon responses and elliptically polarized eigenmodes, so that Faraday rotation cannot be attributed to Hall viscosity alone. To elucidate their microscopic origin and consequences, we derive spin-phonon couplings from a generic $J$-$K$-$\Gamma$-$\Gamma'$ model with interlayer coupling, identifying transverse strain couplings for propagation along the $c$-axis arising from the interplay of Kitaev $(K)$ and $\Gamma$ interactions, along with strain-induced $g$-tensor contributions. Incorporating these couplings into our theory for the Kitaev spin-liquid candidate $\alpha$-RuCl$_3$, we find that symmetry breaking modifies the Faraday response, revealing a Hall viscosity approximately twice the value inferred assuming rotational symmetry. Our results establish a microscopic framework beyond circular birefringence, refining the connection between acoustic Faraday rotation and phonon Hall viscosity in symmetry-broken spin-orbit-coupled magnets.
summary:
声法拉第效应通过横向声偏振的旋转来探测声子霍尔粘度，通常用圆双折射来解释。我们证明，打破旋转对称性的磁序会产生各向异性声子响应和椭圆偏振本征模式，因此法拉第旋转不能仅归因于霍尔粘度。为了阐明它们的微观起源和后果，我们从具有层间耦合的通用 $J$-$K$-$\Gamma$-$\Gamma'$ 模型推导出自旋声子耦合，识别由 Kitaev $(K)$ 和 $\Gamma$ 相互作用产生的沿 $c$ 轴传播的横向应变耦合，以及应变引起的 $g$ 张量贡献。将这些耦合结合到我们的基塔耶夫自旋液体候选 $\alpha$-RuCl$_3$ 理论中，我们发现对称破缺改变了法拉第响应，揭示了霍尔粘度大约是假设旋转对称推断值的两倍。

我们的研究结果建立了超越圆形双折射的微观框架，完善了对称破缺自旋轨道耦合磁体中声法拉第旋转与声子霍尔粘度之间的联系。

title: Capturing Coordination Core Topology in Metal--Organic Frameworks Using Persistent Mayer Homology
abstract: Local coordination cores are critically important in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and polyoxometalates (POMs), as they govern the fundamental chemical and structural properties of these materials. Existing methods, including element-resolved persistent homology (ERPH), have limited ability to translate local coordination cores into quantitative, scalable, and interpretable information. Here, we introduce persistent Mayer homology (PMH) to enable the detection of the geometric variability invisible by classical topology. By focusing on coordination cores formed by periodic metal-centered heavy-atom, carbon, and donor channels, PMH distinguishes different arrangements of the local coordination environment, linker framework, and potential coordinating atoms. We examine explainable PMH of orders $N=3$ and $N=5$ and separately combine each with ERPH, which characterizes the multiscale organization of chemically defined element groups across the extended framework, to predict eight nitrogen- and oxygen-related adsorption and self-diffusion properties. The resulting coordination-core PMH representations consistently improve predictive performance over ERPH alone, with the third-order Mayer representation providing the strongest overall performance. These results demonstrate that the inner coordination configurations captured by PMH contain essential structural information that is not fully represented by conventional element-resolved topological descriptors. This finding provides a quantitative interpretable topological framework for understanding local coordination environments and may facilitate the rational design of MOFs and POM-based materials.
summary:
局部配位核在金属有机框架（MOF）和多金属氧酸盐（POM）中至关重要，因为它们控制着这些材料的基本化学和结构特性。现有方法，包括元素解析持久同源性（ERPH），将局部协调核心转化为定量、可扩展和可解释信息的能力有限。在这里，我们引入了持久梅耶同源性（PMH），以能够检测经典拓扑不可见的几何变异性。通过关注由周期性金属中心重原子、碳和供体通道形成的配位核心，PMH 区分了局部配位环境、连接框架和潜在配位原子的不同排列。我们检查了 $N=3$ 和 $N=5$ 阶的可解释 PMH，并将每个阶数分别与 ERPH 结合起来，ERPH 表征了扩展框架中化学定义的元素组的多尺度组织，以预测八种与氮和氧相关的吸附和自扩散特性。

由此产生的协调核心 PMH 表示比单独的 ERPH 持续提高预测性能，其中三阶 Mayer 表示提供了最强的整体性能。这些结果表明，PMH 捕获的内部配位配置包含传统元素解析拓扑描述符无法完全表示的基本结构信息。这一发现为理解局部协调环境提供了一个定量可解释的拓扑框架，并可能有助于 MOF 和 POM 材料的合理设计。

title: Symmetry-constrained coexistence of charge-three and charge-one Weyl points in nonmagnetic crystals
abstract: High-charge Weyl semimetals (WSMs), particularly those hosting charge-three Weyl point (C-3 WPs), have attracted considerable interest owing to their unconventional topological properties and enhanced boundary phenomena. However, ideal C-3 WSMs remain rare, and the symmetry-constrained coexistence of charge-three and charge-one Weyl point (C-1 WPs) in nonmagnetic crystals remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate a representative eight-node Weyl configuration, consisting of two C-3 WPs and six C-1 WPs with opposite chirality, corresponding to two identical $\{3,-1,-1,-1\}$ irreducible Weyl molecules. By combining topological charge conservation with space-group symmetry analysis, we systematically classify all 230 space groups and identify 12 and 23 candidate groups without and with spin--orbit coupling (SOC), respectively. First-principles calculations without SOC reveal that the boron allotropes TBR-B$_{48}$ and chiral OBD-B$_{48}$ realize this configuration, hosting hourglass-type and non-hourglass-type C-3 WPs, respectively. Surface-state calculations reveal six Fermi-arc branches at the shared projection of the charge-three pair and three at each individual projection. Reversing the structural chirality of OBD-B$_{48}$ reverses the signs of all Weyl charges, establishing a direct correspondence between crystal and momentum-space chirality. Furthermore, breaking the protecting $C_6$ symmetry in TBR-B$_{48}$ splits each C-3 WP into three C-1 WPs and reconstructs the surface Fermi arcs. Our work establishes symmetry-based guidelines for designing and searching for nonmagnetic WSMs hosting charge-three and charge-one Weyl-point coexistence.
summary:
高电荷韦尔半金属（WSM），特别是那些具有电荷三韦尔点（C-3 WP）的半金属，由于其非常规的拓扑特性和增强的边界现象而引起了人们的极大兴趣。然而，理想的 C-3 WSM 仍然很少见，非磁性晶体中三电荷和一电荷韦尔点 (C-1 WP) 的对称约束共存在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们研究了具有代表性的八节点Weyl构型，由两个具有相反手性的C-3 WP和六个C-1 WP组成，对应于两个相同的$\{3,-1,-1,-1\}$不可约Weyl分子。通过将拓扑电荷守恒与空间群对称性分析相结合，我们对所有 230 个空间群进行了系统分类，并分别识别出 12 个和 23 个不带自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 和带自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 的候选空间群。没有 SOC 的第一性原理计算表明，硼同素异形体 TBR-B$_{48}$ 和手性 OBD-B$_{48}$ 实现了这种配置，分别承载沙漏型和非沙漏型 C-3 WP。表面态计算揭示了电荷三对共享投影处的六个费米弧分支，以及每个单独投影处的三个费米弧分支。

反转 OBD-B$_{48}$ 的结构手性会反转所有外尔电荷的符号，从而在晶体和动量空间手性之间建立直接对应关系。此外，打破TBR-B$_{48}$中的保护性$C_6$对称性将每个C-3 WP分成三个C-1 WP并重建表面费米弧。我们的工作建立了基于对称性的指导原则，用于设计和搜索电荷三和电荷一韦尔点共存的非磁性 WSM。

title: H$_2$-Like Units and Pressure-Tunable High-$T_\mathrm{c}$ Superconductivity in NaH$_6$
abstract: Hydrogen-rich materials offer a route to high-temperature conventional superconductivity, but often require extreme pressures. Here we report a first-principles study of NaH$_6$, identified in our large-scale hydride search and independently predicted in a subsequent high-throughput study. Several phases compete, with $R\bar{3}m$ and $Pm\bar{3}m$ dominant over broad pressure ranges. The $R\bar{3}m$ phase remains dynamically stable down to 10 GPa, where its calculated $T_\mathrm{c}$ is 34 K, rising to 99 K at 50 GPa. Cubic $Pm\bar{3}m$ becomes thermodynamically competitive at higher pressures and reaches a calculated $T_\mathrm{c}$ of 230 K at 50 GPa, decreasing only weakly upon further compression. Molecular dynamics and phonon-renormalization calculations support structural persistence over the sampled timescale and indicate relatively small anharmonic effects. Despite their high $T_\mathrm{c}$, both phases contain elongated H$_2$-like units, often considered unfavorable for high-$T_\mathrm{c}$ hydrides. Mode-resolved electron-phonon coupling links Raman-active hydrogen vibrations to superconductivity. In $R\bar{3}m$, the linewidths of these modes increase with the pressure-induced tilt of H$_2$ units relative to the threefold axis, alongside the rise in $T_\mathrm{c}$. A minimal symmetry-based model of the vibration-induced second-moment tensor of the hydrogen sublattice shows that these trends are consistent with a significant contribution from response components perpendicular to the threefold axis. NaH$_6$ thus represents an unusual molecular-like hydride in which hydrogen-sublattice reorganization may enable high-$T_\mathrm{c}$ superconductivity at comparatively moderate pressures.
summary:
富氢材料提供了实现高温常规超导性的途径，但通常需要极高的压力。在这里，我们报告了 NaH$_6$ 的第一性原理研究，该研究在我们的大规模氢化物搜索中得到确定，并在随后的高通量研究中独立预测。多个相相互竞争，$R\bar{3}m$ 和 $Pm\bar{3}m$ 在广泛的压力范围内占主导地位。 $R\bar{3}m$ 相在低至 10 GPa 的压力下仍保持动态稳定，计算出的 $T_\mathrm{c}$ 为 34 K，在 50 GPa 时升至 99 K。立方 $Pm\bar{3}m$ 在较高压力下变得具有热力学竞争力，并在 50 GPa 下达到计算的 $T_\mathrm{c}$ 230 K，在进一步压缩时仅微弱下降。分子动力学和声子重整化计算支持采样时间尺度上的结构持久性，并表明相对较小的非谐效应。尽管它们的$T_\mathrm{c}$很高，但两个相都含有细长的H$_2$类单元，通常被认为不利于高$T_\mathrm{c}$氢化物。模式分辨电子声子耦合将拉曼活性氢振动与超导性联系起来。

在 $R\bar{3}m$ 中，这些模式的线宽随着 H$_2$ 单位相对于三重轴的压力引起的倾斜而增加，同时 $T_\mathrm{c}$ 也随之增加。氢亚晶格振动引起的二阶矩张量的基于最小对称的模型表明，这些趋势与垂直于三重轴的响应分量的显着贡献一致。因此，NaH$_6$ 代表了一种不寻常的类分子氢化物，其中氢亚晶格重组可以在相对适中的压力下实现高$T_\mathrm{c}$ 超导性。

title: Spatial Engineering of Topological Quantum Matter with Structured Light
abstract: Structured light provides a powerful means of controlling matter while itself exhibiting nontrivial spatial topology. Here, we show that these spatial structures can be harnessed to locally engineer the topological properties of matter. In a paradigmatic example of a topological insulator with Dirac surface states driven by an optical skyrmion beam, we show that structured light spatially tailors the effective Hamiltonian, yielding position-dependent topological gaps and Dirac velocities. The resulting gap modulation can create topological and trivial regions separated by optically defined interfaces, without introducing material boundaries or chemical modifications. We further show that the geometry of these interfaces can be controlled through the spatial structure of the light, in particular its orbital angular momentum. Our results establish structured light as a route to dynamically pattern topological phases and open a broader perspective on the interplay between topology in light and matter, including the possibility of transferring topological characteristics between the two.
summary: 结构光提供了一种控制物质的强大手段，同时它本身也表现出非凡的空间拓扑。在这里，我们表明可以利用这些空间结构来局部设计物质的拓扑特性。在由光学斯格明子光束驱动的具有狄拉克表面态的拓扑绝缘体的典型示例中，我们表明结构光在空间上定制有效的哈密顿量，产生位置相关的拓扑间隙和狄拉克速度。由此产生的间隙调制可以创建由光学定义的界面分隔的拓扑和琐碎区域，而无需引入材料边界或化学修饰。我们进一步表明，这些界面的几何形状可以通过光的空间结构，特别是其轨道角动量来控制。我们的结果将结构光确立为动态图案化拓扑相的途径，并为光和物质拓扑之间的相互作用开辟了更广阔的视角，包括在两者之间转移拓扑特征的可能性。

title: Berry curvature from plane-wave mixing: A three-band model with emergent symmetries
abstract: Two-dimensional materials can host topological phases stabilized either by an intrinsic moiré potential or topological crystallization. Crucial to the topology of these phases is the interplay between the (self-consistently generated) potential and the spinor structure, which imbues the band-projected potential with momentum-dependence. Truncating this potential at linear-order in momentum, we obtain a three-band model that captures the low-energy band structure and Berry curvature of such topological bands. We analytically find that the Berry curvature strongly depends on momentum-dependence of the potential. Furthermore, we identify that the model can be tuned to have emergent symmetries, including $U(1)$ and anti-unitary symmetries. Emergent-symmetry breaking perturbations drive the system to regimes hosting topological flat bands, quadratic band touchings, and multiple Dirac cones. We recover many of these features when studying an un-truncated model of a $\lambda$-jellium spinor inside of a periodic potential. Our results reveal a rich interplay of spinor structure and a potential in determining the topology of the ground state.
summary: 二维材料可以具有通过固有莫尔势或拓扑结晶稳定的拓扑相。这些相的拓扑结构至关重要的是（自洽生成的）势与旋量结构之间的相互作用，这使能带投影势具有动量依赖性。以线性阶动量截断该势，我们获得了一个三能带模型，该模型捕获了此类拓扑能带的低能带结构和贝里曲率。我们分析发现贝里曲率强烈依赖于势的动量依赖性。此外，我们发现该模型可以调整为具有紧急对称性，包括 $U(1)$ 和反酉对称性。突现对称性破缺扰动将系统驱动至拓扑平坦能带、二次能带接触和多个狄拉克锥的状态。在研究周期性势内的 $\lambda$-jellium 旋量的未截断模型时，我们恢复了许多这些特征。我们的结果揭示了旋量结构的丰富相互作用以及确定基态拓扑的潜力。

title: Phase-Coherent Spin and Lattice Modulations in a Y-type Hexaferrite
abstract: Spin-driven multiferroics owe their electric polarization to lattice distortions that follow the magnetic order, yet in incommensurate magnets symmetry normally forbids such a distortion at the fundamental magnetic wavevector, and the distortions themselves are rarely observed. Here we use half-polarized neutron scattering to show that the Y-type hexaferrite Ba$_{0.4}$Sr$_{1.6}$Mg$_2$Fe$_{12}$O$_{22}$ hosts, in its saturated high-field state, a magnetic modulation and a longitudinal lattice modulation at one and the same wavevector, locked in phase. The signature is a large nuclear-magnetic interference asymmetry, $r$ ~ 0.8, of the same sign at the two conjugate satellites and persisting to 275 K. The zone contrast and the field dependence of the satellite indicate an internal, field-induced longitudinal distortion. The modulated state coexists with the transverse-conical magnetoelectric phase and outlives it, revealing a fundamental-wavevector spin-lattice coupling in a magnetic field regime previously regarded as a simple ferrimagnet.
summary: 自旋驱动的多铁性材料的电极化归因于遵循磁序的晶格畸变，但在不相称的磁体中，对称性通常禁止基本磁波矢量的这种畸变，并且畸变本身很少被观察到。在这里，我们使用半极化中子散射来表明，Y 型六方铁氧体 Ba$_{0.4}$Sr$_{1.6}$Mg$_2$Fe$_{12}$O$_{22}$ 在其饱和高场状态下，在一个相同的波矢量上进行磁调制和纵向晶格调制，并锁定相位。其特征是较大的核磁干扰不对称性，$r$ ~ 0.8，在两颗共轭卫星上具有相同的符号，并持续到 275 K。区域对比度和卫星的场依赖性表明存在内部场引起的纵向畸变。调制态与横向圆锥磁电相共存并比它寿命更长，揭示了先前被视为简单亚铁磁体的磁场状态中的基波矢量自旋晶格耦合。

title: Quantum skyrmion molecule: two quantum skyrmions bound by coherent magnon exchange
abstract: Quantum skyrmions in frustrated spin-$1/2$ magnets are bound states of a few flipped spins in a ferromagnetic background. Using exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group calculations for the $J_1$--$J_2$ triangular-lattice model with easy-axis anisotropy $K$, we ask what happens when two such objects are brought together. The binding energy per flipped spin of a single skyrmion has a minimum at $\Nf^{*}=7$ for $K=0.02$--$0.04$, and skyrmions smaller than $\Nf^{*}$ do not exist as pairs: at any distance they coalesce into a single larger object, and pinning wells cannot prevent it. Two skyrmions of natural size, by contrast, form a bound molecule without pinning or external field, with binding energy $U\simeq-0.007J_1$ at $K=0.03$--$0.04$ and an equilibrium separation of $5.5$ lattice spacings that does not depend on $K$ or on the size of the simulation domain; at $K=0.02$, where the single skyrmion is itself marginally bound, the pair is unbound within our resolution. The two constituents keep their identity ($7+7$ flipped spins) and are coupled by a coherent exchange of magnons, visible as number fluctuations between the two halves of the domain in excess of those of two independent skyrmions and as in-plane spin correlations between the two skyrmion walls that reach $0.16$ across the gap. These correlations follow the vortex pattern of the two textures and lock their relative helicity, the quantum counterpart of the helicity-dependent interaction of classical skyrmions. We discuss the molecule as a self-assembled two-qubit element for skyrmion helicity qubits in a single layer.
summary:
受挫自旋 $1/2$ 磁体中的量子斯格明子是铁磁背景中一些翻转自旋的束缚态。对具有易轴各向异性 $K$ 的 $J_1$--$J_2$ 三角晶格模型使用精确对角化和密度矩阵重正化群计算，我们询问当两个这样的物体放在一起时会发生什么。对于 $K=0.02$--$0.04$，单个斯格明子每次翻转自旋的结合能最小值为 $\Nf^{*}=7$，并且小于 $\Nf^{*}$ 的斯格明子不会成对存在：在任何距离，它们都会合并成一个较大的物体，钉扎井无法阻止它。相比之下，两个自然大小的斯格明子形成一个没有钉扎或外场的结合分子，结合能 $U\simeq-0.007J_1$ 在 $K=0.03$--$0.04$ 处，平衡分离为 $5.5$ 晶格间距，不依赖于 $K$ 或模拟域的大小；在 $K=0.02$ 处，单个斯格明子本身是边缘束缚的，在我们的分辨率内，该对是未束缚的。

这两个成分保持其同一性（$7+7$翻转自旋），并通过磁振子的连贯交换耦合，可以看出，域的两半之间的数量波动超过了两个独立的斯格明子的数量波动，并且两个斯格明子墙之间的面内自旋相关性在间隙中达到了$0.16$。这些相关性遵循两种纹理的涡旋模式，并锁定它们的相对螺旋度，即经典斯格明子螺旋度相关相互作用的量子对应物。我们将该分子作为单层斯格明子螺旋量子位的自组装双量子位元件进行讨论。

title: Can Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials Capture Small Polarons? A Geometry-Based Benchmark in Transition-Metal Oxides
abstract: Small polarons, formed when excess electrons become localized through lattice distortions, play a critical role in charge transport, catalysis, and degradation processes in transition-metal (TM) oxides. Whether universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs), which lack explicit electronic degrees of freedom, can describe them remains unclear. Here, we investigate H-induced electron localization across a range of TM oxides using a geometric descriptor based on TM-O bond-length expansion (Z-score) to identify polaronic distortions. We find that uMLIPs exhibit varying degrees of electron localization, from delocalized states to metastable small polarons, with their behavior strongly dependent on the training data and treatment of electronic correlations. In particular, the absence of Hubbard U corrections for specific TM cations in the training data leads to electron delocalization, in contrast to DFT+U predictions. Although some uMLIPs reproduce polaron hopping barriers during coupled proton-polaron transfer, all of them fail to stabilize spatially separated polaron-donor configurations, instead favoring localization near the H dopant.
summary: 当多余的电子通过晶格畸变局部化时形成的小极化子在过渡金属（TM）氧化物的电荷传输、催化和降解过程中发挥着关键作用。缺乏明确电子自由度的通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）是否可以描述它们仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用基于 TM-O 键长扩展（Z 分数）的几何描述符来研究 H 诱导的电子在一系列 TM 氧化物中的局域化，以识别极化子畸变。我们发现 uMLIP 表现出不同程度的电子局域化，从离域态到亚稳态小极化子，其行为强烈依赖于训练数据和电子相关性的处理。特别是，与 DFT+U 预测相反，训练数据中缺乏对特定 TM 阳离子的 Hubbard U 校正会导致电子离域。尽管一些 uMLIP 在耦合质子-极化子转移过程中再现了极化子跳跃势垒，但它们都无法稳定空间分离的极化子-供体构型，而是有利于 H 掺杂剂附近的局域化。

title: Meso-scale modeling of cohesive cavitation in polymer networks
abstract: Cavitation influences the failure of elastomers and soft adhesives, but connecting its microscopic initiation to subsequent cavity growth remains challenging. Here, we develop a discrete mesoscale framework that combines finitely extensible, breakable strands with local van der Waals interactions to examine how cohesion and network heterogeneity transform distributed dilation into localized damage. In the simulations, local cohesive instability produces a network-scale precursor whose subsequent expansion is coupled to strand stretching and rupture. Cohesive strength and intrinsic defect size govern the critical hydrostatic tension, while cohesion also controls the number and spatial distribution of cavities. Under confined loading, decreasing the layer thickness promotes multiple cavities and distributed strand rupture, extending the load-bearing response and increasing the critical work density of rupture. An energetic interpretation based on the thickness dependence of the crack-driving force connects these observations to competition between additional cavity nucleation and propagation of existing damage. The results link local cohesive instability to the collective evolution of cavities and rupture in disordered polymer networks.
summary:
气蚀会影响弹性体和软粘合剂的失效，但将其微观引发与随后的空腔生长联系起来仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一个离散的介观框架，将有限可扩展、可断裂的链与局部范德华相互作用相结合，以研究内聚力和网络异质性如何将分布式扩张转化为局部损伤。在模拟中，局部内聚不稳定性产生网络规模的前体，其随后的膨胀与链拉伸和断裂耦合。内聚强度和内在缺陷尺寸决定临界静水张力，而内聚力还控制空腔的数量和空间分布。在受限载荷下，减小层厚度会促进多腔和分布式股线断裂，延长承载响应并增加断裂的临界功密度。基于裂纹驱动力厚度依赖性的能量解释将这些观察结果与额外空腔成核和现有损伤传播之间的竞争联系起来。

结果将局部内聚不稳定性与无序聚合物网络中空腔和破裂的集体演化联系起来。

title: Collision Cascade Morphology and Defect Nucleation in Pure Tungsten and an Equimolar Refractory W-Ta-Cr-V Alloy
abstract: Collision cascades and defect-formation mechanisms in pure W and the WTaCrV refractory high-entropy alloy were investigated using molecular dynamics simulations over primary knock-on atom (PKA) energies of 0.1-100 keV. Machine-learning tabulated Gaussian approximation potentials (tabGAP), complemented by short-range Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark (ZBL) interactions, were employed. Analysis of the heat spike lifetime, affected region, atomic relocations and surviving defects reveals an importance of subcascade formation and presence of light elements in the alloy. Cascade splitting into subcascades contributes to the distribution of the PKA energy over a larger region in the material, nucleating less dislocations and smaller voids - latter being present only in W and absent in WTaCrV. Since cascade splitting is more frequently observed in WTaCrV, the alloy shows better resistance to primary irradiation damage compared to pure W. Apart from cascade splitting, analysis of interstitials shows that Cr and to lesser extent V, being lighter and smaller elements, accommodate the damage in form of point defects, contributing to the mitigation of formation of the dislocation loops.
summary: 使用 0.1-100 keV 初级碰撞原子 (PKA) 能量的分子动力学模拟研究了纯 W 和 WTaCrV 难熔高熵合金中的碰撞级联和缺陷形成机制。采用机器学习表格高斯逼近势 (tabGAP)，并辅以短程 Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark (ZBL) 相互作用。对热尖峰寿命、受影响区域、原子重定位和残留缺陷的分析揭示了合金中子级联形成和轻元素存在的重要性。级联分裂成子级联有助于将 PKA 能量分布在材料中更大的区域，从而成核更少的位错和更小的空隙 - 后者仅存在于 W 中而在 WTaCrV 中不存在。由于在 WTaCrV 中更频繁地观察到级联分裂，因此与纯 W 相比，该合金表现出更好的抗初级辐照损伤能力。除了级联分裂之外，间隙分析表明，Cr 和较小程度的 V 作为较轻和较小的元素，以点缺陷的形式容纳损伤，有助于减轻位错环的形成。

title: Electric Edelstein Effect in Two Dimensions
abstract: We propose the electric Edelstein effect (EEE) in two-dimensional (2D) systems, where crossed out-of-plane and in-plane electric fields generate a spin polarization. The gate field converts the Edelstein response from a material-fixed spin polarization into a gate-tunable one.
