A symmetry analysis over all magnetic layer point groups shows that the EEE is allowed in a wide range of magnetic and nonmagnetic systems, including ferromagnets, antiferromagnets, and altermagnets. The EEE plays two distinct roles: it generates spin polarization where the linear Edelstein effect (EE) is symmetry-forbidden, as in centrosymmetric materials; and it adds a new gate-tunable component, generally non-collinear with the conventional one, where the EE is already present. The two fields then act as independent knobs and raise the control dimension of the spin polarization from one to two. Our microscopic theory traces the EEE to band-geometric quantities, which are strongly enhanced near small band gaps. First-principles calculations predict pronounced effects in the centrosymmetric ferromagnet MnSe2, where the linear EE is symmetry-forbidden. In the nonmagnet SnSe where the EE and EEE coexist, the two knobs cover an extended region of the spin sphere. Our findings establish the EEE as a symmetry-guided, gate-tunable route to electrical spin manipulation and open avenues for multistate spintronics in 2D quantum materials.
summary:
我们提出了二维（2D）系统中的电埃德尔斯坦效应（EEE），其中交叉的面外和面内电场产生自旋极化。栅极场将埃德尔斯坦响应从材料固定的自旋极化转换为栅极可调的响应。对所有磁性层点组的对称性分析表明，EEE 可以在多种磁性和非磁性系统中使用，包括铁磁体、反铁磁体和交变磁体。 EEE 起着两个不同的作用：它产生自旋极化，其中线性埃德尔斯坦效应 (EE) 是对称禁止的，如在中心对称材料中；它还添加了一个新的栅极可调组件，通常与已经存在 EE 的传统组件不共线。然后，这两个场充当独立的旋钮，并将自旋极化的控制维度从一提高到二。我们的微观理论将 EEE 追溯到能带几何量，这些几何量在小带隙附近强烈增强。第一性原理计算预测了中心对称铁磁体 MnSe2 中的显着效应，其中线性 EE 是对称禁止的。

在 EE 和 EEE 共存的非磁性 SnSe 中，两个旋钮覆盖了自旋球体的延伸区域。我们的研究结果将 EEE 确立为一种对称引导、门可调的电自旋操纵途径，并为二维量子材料中的多态自旋电子学开辟了道路。

title: A Parameter-Free Reference Hamiltonian for Tight-Binding Vanadium Oxides
abstract: Density-functional tight binding has yet to yield a transferable description of vanadium oxides; for the standard second-order construction and the tested cells, we demonstrate that two of its approximations deviate by electron volts and offset each other in the band-index centroid separation between the V 3d and O 2p bands: the neutral two-centre reference omits electron-volt environmental terms, whereas the Mulliken charge model assigns the compact V 3d shell less than half of the self-consistent potential shift observed in PBE. Instead, we build a tight-binding model where the reference Hamiltonian derives from superposed neutral atoms, the full PBE exchange-correlation potential and frozen-core orthogonality, without adjustable terms, and where the orbital-resolved charge response employs three screening factors obtained from PBE linear response and an unscreened Coulomb range. Against the primary PAW reference, the reference energy at fixed geometry and the stated numerical settings matches the plane-wave Harris-Foulkes energy differences of VO2, exhibiting signed deviations of +2.6 meV/atom for M1 relative to rutile (an energy difference of 92 meV/atom) and +6.2 and -5.2 meV/atom under 3% volume compression and expansion; meanwhile, the charge response captures 21 of 22 fitted and all 8 held-out matched PBE responses within tolerance, providing the V 3d shell with nearly the same self-consistent shift as PBE (-3.89 versus -3.92 eV in rutile). The convexity of the spinless model at fixed geometry prevents it from spontaneously differentiating symmetry-equivalent sites under the symmetries respected by its implemented operators and sampling, so within this model such differentiation in the Magnéli phases must arise from electron-lattice coupling or an explicit spin or correlation term.
summary:
密度泛函紧密结合尚未产生钒氧化物的可转移描述；对于标准二阶结构和测试的电池，我们证明了它的两个近似值偏离了电子伏特，并且在 V 3d 和 O 2p 带之间的能带指数质心分离中相互抵消：中性双中心参考忽略了电子伏特环境项，而 Mulliken 电荷模型将紧凑的 V 3d 壳指定为小于 PBE 中观察到的自洽电势偏移的一半。相反，我们建立了一个紧束缚模型，其中参考哈密顿量源自叠加的中性原子、完整的 PBE 交换相关势和冻结核心正交性，没有可调项，并且轨道解析的电荷响应采用从 PBE 线性响应和未筛选的库仑范围获得的三个筛选因子。

相对于主要的 PAW 参考，固定几何形状和规定的数值设置下的参考能量与 VO2 的平面波 Harris-Foulkes 能量差相匹配，M1 相对于金红石（能量差为 92 meV/原子）显示出 +2.6 meV/原子的符号偏差，在 3% 体积压缩和膨胀下显示出 +6.2 和 -5.2 meV/原子的符号偏差；同时，电荷响应捕获了 22 个拟合中的 21 个，并且所有 8 个保持匹配的 PBE 响应在公差范围内，为 V 3d 壳提供了与 PBE 几乎相同的自洽偏移（金红石中为 -3.89 eV 与 -3.92 eV）。无自旋模型在固定几何形状下的凸性阻止其在其实现的算子和采样所遵循的对称性下自发区分对称等效位点，因此在该模型中，Magnéli 相中的这种区分必须来自电子晶格耦合或显式自旋或相关项。

title: Skin phase transition of a skyrmion in a ferromagnetic superfluid
abstract: Compared with a scalar Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC), a spinor BEC supports richer phenomena because of its internal spin degrees of freedom, including topological solitons such as domain walls or skyrmions. Here, we theoretically reveal three distinct axisymmetric soliton structures formed as a circular domain wall in a spin-1 BEC, connected within fixed winding numbers. We refer to these structures as the broken-axisymmetry (BA)-skin, antiferromagnetic (AF)-skin and normal-core phases. Their occurrence is controlled by the two dimensionless parameters in the absence of linear Zeeman coefficient $p=0$: $q/\mu$, the ratio of the quadratic Zeeman coefficient to the chemical potential, and $c_s/c_n$, the ratio of spin interaction to the density interaction. The BA-skin and AF-skin phases exhibit local easy-plane magnetic order and local easy-plane spin-nematic order, respectively, while the normal-core phase is similar to a doubly quantized vortex analogous to that of a scalar BEC with a density depletion at the center. We obtain semi-analytical estimates of selected transition boundaries separating these phases by analyzing the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equation and also numerically confirm them by solving the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. We estimate the skyrmion radius using a hydrostatic approximation and compare the result with numerical solutions. We envision our results on skyrmions in a spin-1 BEC can trigger further investigation on novel soliton structures in a magnetic superfluid.
summary:
与标量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚 (BEC) 相比，自旋 BEC 由于其内部自旋自由度而支持更丰富的现象，包括拓扑孤子，例如畴壁或斯格明子。在这里，我们从理论上揭示了三种不同的轴对称孤子结构，它们形成为 spin-1 BEC 中的圆形畴壁，并在固定的绕数内连接。我们将这些结构称为破轴对称（BA）表皮、反铁磁（AF）表皮和正常核心相。在没有线性塞曼系数$p=0$的情况下，它们的出现由两个无量纲参数控制：$q/\mu$，二次塞曼系数与化学势的比率，以及$c_s/c_n$，自旋相互作用与密度相互作用的比率。 BA-表皮和AF-表皮相分别表现出局部易平面磁序和局部易平面自旋向列序，而法向核心相类似于双量子化涡旋，类似于中心密度耗尽的标量BEC。

我们通过分析 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程获得了分离这些相的选定过渡边界的半解析估计，并通过求解 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程对它们进行了数值确认。我们使用流体静力近似估计斯格明子半径，并将结果与​​数值解进行比较。我们设想我们对 spin-1 BEC 中斯格明子的研究结果可以引发对磁性超流体中新型孤子结构的进一步研究。

title: Proof of the exact correlation-length exponent $ν= \frac{\sqrt[3]{2}}{2}$ and algebraic relations for $β$ and $γ$ in the 3D Ising model
abstract: Based on our previous results regarding critical exponent estimates for the 3D Ising model and scaling relations [1], we have proven that the exact value of the correlation-length exponent is $\frac{\sqrt[3]{2}}{2}$. This is in very close agreement with the most precise numerical estimates currently available. Using a group theoretical approach and some propositions of constructive geometry, we derived an exact construction of algebraic expressions for the critical exponents $\gamma$ and $\beta$. We proved that these expressions depend solely on the exact value of $\nu\,$.
summary: 根据我们之前关于 3D Ising 模型和尺度关系的临界指数估计的结果 [1]，我们已经证明相关长度指数的精确值为 $\frac{\sqrt[3]{2}}{2}$。这与目前可用的最精确的数值估计非常吻合。使用群论方法和一些构造几何命题，我们导出了关键指数 $\gamma$ 和 $\beta$ 的代数表达式的精确构造。我们证明这些表达式仅取决于 $\nu\,$ 的精确值。

title: ARES: a plane-wave density-functional-theory code in Rust
abstract: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, {\Gamma}-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. The code's distinguishing engineering choice is its validation apparatus. Every numerical component is checked against Quantum ESPRESSO driven from the same physical and numerical inputs, and the comparison is organized as numbered fixtures kept in the repository whose reference data is regenerated by a script instead of being captured once. On six materials spanning a semiconductor, three metals and two two-dimensional systems, band energies within one electronvolt of the Fermi level agree with the reference to a median below 0.4 meV. The pseudopotentials the code reads are validated against all-electron reference data as well: the median delta factor is 0.696 meV/atom over all 65 paired elements. Restrictions are stated with the capabilities: two functionals, no spin-polarized or spin-orbit path, a stress implementation with an explicit scope, and no accelerator execution.
summary:
ARES（吉林大学的从头开始原子材料建模软件）是完全用 Rust 编写的平面波密度泛函理论 (DFT) 代码，作为分层的 22 箱工作区。它支持范数守恒赝势和投影增强波 (PAW) 方法，具有局域密度近似 (LDA) 和 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) 泛函、仅 {\Gamma} 和显式 k 点采样、涂抹和混合、力、应力、松弛、能带结构、态密度 (DOS) 和色散校正；执行是串行的或 MPI 分布在 k 点池、频带组和平面波行上。该代码的独特工程选择是其验证装置。每个数字组件都会根据相同的物理和数字输入驱动的 Quantum ESPRESSO 进行检查，比较被组织为保存在存储库中的编号固定装置，其参考数据由脚本重新生成，而不是捕获一次。在跨越半导体、三种金属和两个二维系统的六种材料上，费米能级一电子伏内的能带能量与低于 0.4 meV 的中值参考一致。

代码读取的赝势也根据全电子参考数据进行了验证：所有 65 个配对元素的中值 delta 因子为 0.696 meV/原子。功能限制包括：两个泛函、无自旋极化或自旋轨道路径、具有明确范围的应力实现以及无加速器执行。

title: Conformal soft modes at elastic instabilities
abstract: In case a crystal is close to a continuous elastic phase transition, pronounced critical fluctuations emerge. We show that on the level of linear elasticity theory the displacement vector for these critical modes obeys a condition reminiscent of the conformal Killing equation. For an isostructural instability, four critical modes arise corresponding to one dilation and three special conformal transformations. At crystal symmetry-breaking instabilities, the critical fluctuations include a continuum of modes even for crystals with finite size. For certain cases, these comprise the conformal transformations associated with two-dimensional Minkowski space. These results have implications for critical elastic phenomena as well as for extremal mechanical metamaterials.
summary: 如果晶体接近连续弹性相变，就会出现明显的临界波动。我们证明，在线弹性理论的层面上，这些临界模式的位移矢量遵循一个让人想起保形 Killing 方程的条件。对于同构不稳定性，会出现四种临界模式，对应于一种膨胀和三种特殊的共形变换。在晶体对称破缺不稳定性下，临界涨落包括连续模式，即使对于有限尺寸的晶体也是如此。对于某些情况，这些包括与二维 Minkowski 空间相关的共形变换。这些结果对临界弹性现象以及极值机械超材料具有影响。

title: Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials
abstract: Energetic materials involve multiple interactions, making reliable machine-learning potentials (MLPs) difficult to construct without extensive datasets. Here, we enhance the ability of the neural network interatomic potential (NNAP) to describe molecular systems using sphmulti, a refined spherical-harmonic basis set that combines extra radial basis with element-specific chemical weighting in each radial channel. We further integrate hyperactive learning, farthest-point sampling, and iterative sufficiency criteria with knowledge-guided key events, enabling the NNAP to retain essential information for describing the material system. For 3,3'-diamino-4,4'-azoxyfurazan, the resulting NNAP is trained on only 13,680 configurations yet captures key properties, including the isomerization barrier, pyrolysis activation energy, and shock Hugoniot behavior. NNAP-driven molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that pyrolysis proceeds through furazan-ring opening followed by chain reactions, whereas shock loading induces anisotropic hydrogen transfer driven by interlayer structural deformations. This work enables efficient and reliable MLPs for energetic materials.
summary: 含能材料涉及多种相互作用，如果没有大量数据集，就很难构建可靠的机器学习潜力 (MLP)。在这里，我们增强了神经网络原子间势（NNAP）使用 sphmulti 描述分子系统的能力，sphmulti 是一种精炼的球谐基组，它将额外的径向基与每个径向通道中元素特定的化学权重相结合。我们进一步将超活跃学习、最远点采样和迭代充分性标准与知识引导的关键事件相结合，使 NNAP 能够保留描述材料系统的基本信息。对于 3,3'-二氨基-4,4'-偶氮呋喃，生成的 NNAP 仅在 13,680 个构型上进行训练，但捕获了关键特性，包括异构化势垒、热解活化能和冲击 Hugoniot 行为。 NNAP 驱动的分子动力学模拟进一步揭示，热解通过呋喃环开环进行，随后发生链式反应，而冲击载荷则诱导层间结构变形驱动的各向异性氢转移。这项工作为含能材料实现了高效、可靠的 MLP。

title: Organisation and aggregation of calcium carbonate ions in water via molecular simulation
abstract: Crystallisation of calcium carbonate (CaCO$_3$) in aqueous solutions is essential for carbon dioxide sequestration and the sustainable production of calcium carbonate materials, which are widely used in industry and increasingly explored for novel applications. While crystallisation is often analysed within the framework of classical nucleation theory, CaCO$_3$ and other ionic crystals often form through amorphous precursor phases, motivating the need for alternative descriptions. In this work, we investigate the relationship between the formation of the first CaCO$_3$ coordination sphere, a fundamental unit of local ordering, and ionic aggregation using two complementary simulation approaches: on-the-fly probability-enhanced sampling (OPES) and asynchronous and infinite-swap replica exchange transition interface sampling ($\infty$RETIS). OPES was used to explore free-energy landscapes, whereas $\infty$RETIS was used to determine reaction kinetics. We studied systems at two levels of supersaturation, between which the formation of the first coordination sphere exhibited distinct kinetic behaviour. These differences were found to be linked to concentration-dependent ionic aggregation. At lower concentration, aggregation remains limited, whereas higher concentration promotes extensive spinodal-like aggregation. For both concentrations, the first coordination sphere forms within the pre-formed clusters through one of two distinct pathways: either within a cluster close to the minimum size required for its formation, or within larger amorphous aggregates whose size and structure depend on concentration. The coexistence of these pathways at both levels of supersaturation reveals the multifaceted nature of early-stage CaCO$_3$ crystallisation and highlights the importance of differentiating ionic aggregation and organisation.
summary:
碳酸钙 (CaCO$_3$) 在水溶液中的结晶对于二氧化碳封存和碳酸钙材料的可持续生产至关重要，碳酸钙材料在工业中广泛使用，并且越来越多地探索新的应用。虽然结晶通常在经典成核理论的框架内进行分析，但 CaCO$_3$ 和其他离子晶体通常通过无定形前体相形成，从而激发了对替代描述的需求。在这项工作中，我们使用两种互补的模拟方法研究了第一个 CaCO$_3$ 配位球（局部排序的基本单位）的形成与离子聚集之间的关系：即时概率增强采样（OPES）和异步和无限交换副本交换过渡接口采样（$\infty$RETIS）。 OPES 用于探索自由能景观，而 $\infty$RETIS 用于确定反应动力学。我们研究了两个过饱和水平的系统，在这两个水平之间，第一个配位球的形成表现出不同的动力学行为。

发现这些差异与浓度依赖性离子聚集有关。在较低浓度下，聚集仍然有限，而较高浓度则促进广泛的旋节线状聚集。对于这两种浓度，第一个配位球通过两种不同途径之一在预形成的团簇内形成：或者在接近其形成所需的最小尺寸的团簇内，或者在其尺寸和结构取决于浓度的较大无定形聚集体内。这些途径在两个过饱和水平的共存揭示了早期 CaCO$_3$ 结晶的多方面性质，并强调了区分离子聚集和组织的重要性。

title: Local-resolvent formulation and assessment of linear-scaling Kohn-Sham calculations
abstract: Kohn-Sham density-functional theory is expensive because it needs orbitals that extend over the whole system. For insulators this can be avoided by using only the diagonal of the one-electron resolvent, $g(\mathbf{r},z)=\langle\mathbf{r}|(z-\hat h)^{-1}|\mathbf{r}\rangle$, at a few complex energies $z$. We call the scheme local-resolvent density-functional theory (LRes-DFT). The density and the band energy are linear in $g$, so neither orbitals nor a kinetic-energy functional are needed. The complex energies are $M$ equally spaced points on a circle that encloses the occupied levels, offset by half a spacing so that no point lies on the real axis. Summing the resolvent over them is equivalent to occupying each level with $1/(1+u^M)$, where $u$ is the level's energy measured from the circle's center in units of its radius. This is a smooth step that is near 1 inside the circle and near 0 outside, and it stays between 0 and 1 for every $M$. If the circle moves with the chemical potential, forces at fixed electron number are exact. Gauss-Legendre and Zolotarev rules need fewer points when the gap is small. In three dimensions we use eigenpairs of small windows around each molecule instead of resolvents. This is divide-and-conquer (DC) with a different occupation function, and it is as accurate as DC with Fermi-Dirac occupations. For H$_2$ molecular crystals of up to 1024 electrons it agrees with Kohn-Sham to $2.5\times10^{-7}$ Ha per electron. On one core it is slower than dense diagonalization below about 500 electrons and 3.5 times faster at 1024 electrons. It loses accuracy for disordered or compressed systems and for diffuse basis functions.
summary:
Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论的成本很高，因为它需要延伸到整个系统的轨道。对于绝缘体，可以通过仅使用单电子解析剂的对角线来避免，$g(\mathbf{r},z)=\langle\mathbf{r}|(z-\hat h)^{-1}|\mathbf{r}\rangle$，在一些复能量$z$处。我们将该方案称为局部分辨密度泛函理论 (LRes-DFT)。密度和能带能量以 $g$ 为单位呈线性关系，因此既不需要轨道也不需要动能泛函。复能量是包围占据能级的圆上的 $M$ 等距点，偏移半个间距，以便没有点位于实轴上。对它们求和相当于用 $1/(1+u^M)$ 占据每个能级，其中 $u$ 是从圆心以半径为单位测量的能级能量。这是一个平滑的步骤，圆内接近 1，外部接近 0，并且每 $M$ 都保持在 0 和 1 之间。如果圆随着化学势移动，则固定电子数处的力是精确的。当差距较小时，Gauss-Legendre 和 Zolotarev 规则需要的点数较少。

在三维空间中，我们使用每个分子周围小窗口的特征对而不是解析剂。这是具有不同占领函数的分治法（DC），并且与具有费米-狄拉克占领的 DC 一样准确。对于最多 1024 个电子的 H$_2$ 分子晶体，它与 Kohn-Sham 一致，每个电子 $2.5\times10^{-7}$ Ha。在一个核心上，它比大约 500 个电子以下的密集对角化慢，而在 1024 个电子时快 3.5 倍。它会失去无序或压缩系统以及扩散基函数的准确性。

title: Non-Hermitian Statistical Geometry
abstract: Particle exchange in two dimensions gives rise to quantum statistics beyond the boson-fermion dichotomy, with central roles in fractional quantum Hall physics, topological quantum computation, and strongly correlated quantum matter. In conventional topological phases, microscopic exchange geometry is compressed into rigid braid and fusion data. We develop a theory of non-Hermitian statistical geometry in which relaxing Hermiticity softens these exchange data into a larger complex space of spectral and relative-geometric degrees of freedom. For two adjacent braid generators, a single projective exchange spectrum is insufficient: their relative eigenline geometry supplies an additional gauge-invariant modulus. On the generic irreducible two-channel branch, braid consistency locks these coordinates through an exact spectrum-geometry relation. Using Riesz projectors and Kato transport, we realize this geometry in a five-arm Kitaev-Majorana network and test spectral and relative-geometric responses in an independent two-dimensional four-vortex Kitaev model. Finite-time dynamics tests the exchange operation, microscopic fusion sewing tests its composition across fusion descriptions, and matched-spectrum controls isolate the role of relative geometry. Nonzero projective Kato curvature shows that braid-consistent, fusion-coherent exchange can depend on the control path. Non-Hermiticity thus exposes exchange geometry, braid consistency re-locks it, fusion coherence further constrains it, and projective flatness determines when geometric exchange becomes intrinsically topological.
summary:
二维粒子交换产生了超越玻色子-费米子二分法的量子统计，在分数量子霍尔物理、拓扑量子计算和强相关量子物质中发挥着核心作用。在传统的拓扑阶段，微观交换几何形状被压缩为刚性编织和融合数据。我们发展了一种非厄米统计几何理论，其中放松厄米性将这些交换数据软化到更大的光谱和相对几何自由度的复杂空间中。对于两个相邻的编织发生器，单个投影交换谱是不够的：它们的相对本征线几何形状提供了额外的规范不变模量。在通用的不可约双通道分支上，编织一致性通过精确的谱几何关系锁定这些坐标。使用 Riesz 投影仪和 Kato 传输，我们在五臂 Kitaev-Majorana 网络中实现了这种几何形状，并在独立的二维四涡旋 Kitaev 模型中测试光谱和相对几何响应。

有限时间动力学测试交换操作，微观融合缝合测试其跨融合描述的组成，匹配谱控制隔离相对几何的作用。非零投影加藤曲率表明，辫状一致、融合相干交换可能取决于控制路径。因此，非厄米性暴露了交换几何，编织一致性重新锁定它，融合相干性进一步限制它，而投影平坦度决定几何交换何时本质上是拓扑的。

title: Orientation-Resolved Nanoindentation of Single Crystal Ti-15Mo: Inverted Elastic Anisotropy and Yield-Onset Behavior Beyond Simple CRSS Predictions
abstract: Ti-15Mo (wt%) is a well-established $\beta$-stabilized alloy whose mechanical response is strongly governed by phase stability and deformation mechanisms that operate at the single-grain scale. Because these intragranular mechanisms are intrinsically anisotropic, understanding the orientation dependence of the elastic and plastic response is critical to the texture-engineered processing of wrought components. Here, we quantify the nanomechanical anisotropy of single-crystal Ti-15Mo by combining EBSD with nanoindentation to correlate hardness, indentation modulus, strain rate sensitivity, and indentation yield response with the crystallographic surface normal near $\langle111\rangle,\langle124\rangle,\langle011\rangle,\langle023\rangle$, and $\langle013\rangle$ directions. While the modulus anisotropy is small (~10%), contrary to the prediction for a cubic crystal with A>1, orientations near $\langle111\rangle$ exhibit the lowest moduli. Yield onset is likewise softest near $\langle111\rangle$ and spans 41%, while hardness spans only 6.6% and follows neither the modulus nor the yield ordering. The alloy also exhibits yield behavior not captured by the simple CRSS/Schmid-factor models evaluated here. Strain-rate-jump tests yield V*=18-31b$^3$, consistent with kink-pair-nucleation-controlled plasticity; based on V*, the orientations separate into two groups suggestive of glide-dominated versus twin/transformation-participating response. We reveal an inversion of the elastic anisotropy expected for a homogeneous cubic $\beta$-phase and an orientation-dependent yield-onset response that is not reproduced by the simple Schmid-factor models examined here. Retained athermal $\omega$ is proposed as the contributor because $\beta\rightarrow\omega$ collapse occurs on {111}$_\beta$ planes and may provide anelastic compliance through the reversible $\omega\rightarrow\beta$ transformation.
summary:
Ti-15Mo (wt%) 是一种成熟的 $\beta$ 稳定合金，其机械响应很大程度上受单晶尺度上运行的相稳定性和变形机制的影响。由于这些晶内机制本质上是各向异性的，因此了解弹性和塑性响应的方向依赖性对于锻造部件的纹理工程加工至关重要。在这里，我们通过将 EBSD 与纳米压痕相结合，将硬度、压痕模量、应变率灵敏度和压痕屈服响应与 $\langle111\rangle、\langle124\rangle、\langle011\rangle、\langle023\rangle$ 附近的晶体表面法线相关联，量化单晶 Ti-15Mo 的纳米力学各向异性，并$\langle013\rangle$ 方向。虽然模量各向异性很小 (~10%)，但与 A>1 的立方晶体的预测相反，$\langle111\rangle$ 附近的取向表现出最低的模量。屈服起始点在 $\langle111\rangle$ 附近同样最软，跨度为 41%，而硬度跨度仅为 6.6%，并且既不遵循模量也不遵循屈服排序。

该合金还表现出此处评估的简单 CRSS/Schmid 因子模型未捕获的屈服行为。应变率跳跃测试得出 V*=18-31b$^3$，与扭结对成核控制的塑性一致；基于 V*，方向分为两组，表明滑行主导反应与孪生/转化参与反应。我们揭示了均匀立方 $\beta$ 相预期的弹性各向异性的反演以及依赖于方向的屈服起始响应，而此处检查的简单施密德因子模型并未重现该响应。保留的非热 $\omega$ 被提议作为贡献者，因为 $\beta\rightarrow\omega$ 塌陷发生在 {111}$_\beta$ 平面上，并且可以通过可逆的 $\omega\rightarrow\beta$ 变换提供迟弹性顺应性。

title: Quantitative Impact of Occupation Smearing Methods on Conventional Superconductivity: from Electronic Structure through Lattice Dynamics to Electron-Phonon Coupling
abstract: In first-principles calculations of metallic systems, the discrete electronic mesh in the Brillouin zone necessitates a smearing function and its width (e.g., the widely used 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton scheme) to enforce continuity of energy and occupation at the Fermi surface. However, the quantitative impact of such empirical parameters on phonon-mediated superconductivity has long been overlooked, leading to their habitual selection by mere convention. Here, using hexahydride CsH6 as a benchmark, we systematically investigate the magnitude and propagation mechanism of smearing-induced errors against the parameter-free optimized tetrahedron method. Long-tailed smearing delocalizes the occupation window, causing substantial Fermi-level shifts, flattening of the density of states, and hardening phonon modes, thereby weakening electron-phonon coupling. Conversely, short-tailed smearing suffers from insufficient sampling, producing density-of-states oscillations and enhanced Fermi-surface nesting; via amplified electronic screening and Peierls instabilities, this softens acoustic modes and generates imaginary frequencies, causing CsH6 to be dynamically unstable and discarded. However, the optimized tetrahedron method reveals that CsH6 is dynamically stable under ambient pressure with a remarkable superconducting transition temperature of 121 K. To prevent subjective empirical parameters from obscuring theoretically promising high-temperature superconductors, we derive a simple scaling relation for the smearing width, applicable to different smearing functions, from the free-electron-gas model, offering an objective, precise, and efficient protocol for parameter selection in high-throughput screening.
summary:
在金属系统的第一性原理计算中，布里渊区的离散电子网格需要涂抹函数及其宽度（例如广泛使用的 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton 方案），以增强费米表面能量和占据的连续性。然而，这些经验参数对声子介导的超导性的定量影响长期以来一直被忽视，导致人们习惯性地根据惯例选择它们。在这里，我们以六氢化CsH6为基准，系统地研究了无参数优化四面体方法中涂抹引起的误差的大小和传播机制。长尾弥散使占据窗口离域，导致显着的费米能级位移、态密度变平以及声子模式硬化，从而削弱电子-声子耦合。相反，短尾涂抹会受到采样不足的影响，产生态密度振荡并增强费米面嵌套；通过放大的电子屏蔽和 Peierls 不稳定性，这会软化声学模式并产生虚频率，导致 CsH6 动态不稳定并被丢弃。

然而，优化的四面体方法表明，CsH6在环境压力下是动态稳定的，具有121 K的显着超导转变温度。为了防止主观经验参数模糊理论上有前途的高温超导体，我们从自由电子气模型中推导出适用于不同涂抹函数的简单涂抹宽度缩放关系，为高通量筛选中的参数选择提供了客观、精确和高效的方案。

title: Zeeman spin quantum geometry and intrinsic gyrotropic spin current
abstract: We uncover an intrinsic gyrotropic spin current (IGSC) driven solely by an oscillating magnetic field, arising from the spin version of Zeeman quantum geometry. Using the density matrix formalism, we derive the IGSC in the low-frequency clean limit, in terms of the Zeeman spin quantum metric and the Zeeman spin Berry curvature. The effect is studied in a minimal Rashba-Dresselhaus model that also supports intrinsic gyrotropic charge currents from the Zeeman Berry curvature. The spin and charge currents exhibit a $\pi/2$ phase shift and are found to be perpendicular to each other for certain parameter ranges. This not only enables spin current detection but also opens pure spin current channels for energy-efficient spintronics. We further observe that these currents switch directions between longitudinal and transverse relative to the applied field, depending on the relative strength of Rashba and Dresselhaus interactions.
summary: 我们发现了仅由振荡磁场驱动的本征回旋自旋电流（IGSC），该电流源自塞曼量子几何的自旋版本。使用密度矩阵形式，我们根据塞曼自旋量子度量和塞曼自旋贝里曲率推导了低频清洁极限下的 IGSC。在最小的 Rashba-Dresselhaus 模型中研究了该效应，该模型还支持来自塞曼贝里曲率的固有回旋电荷电流。自旋电流和电荷电流表现出 $\pi/2$ 相移，并且发现在某些参数范围内彼此垂直。这不仅能够实现自旋电流检测，而且还为节能自旋电子学打开纯自旋电流通道。我们进一步观察到，这些电流在相对于施加场的纵向和横向之间切换方向，具体取决于 Rashba 和 Dresselhaus 相互作用的相对强度。

title: Molecular-Dynamics Verification of Effective Gravity under Heat Conduction
abstract: We test the effective-gravity prediction of global thermodynamics using standard molecular dynamics of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones fluid. Under weak heat conduction with the lower boundary hotter than the upper boundary, the transition between liquid below gas and liquid above gas shifts from zero to finite downward gravity. Using independently measured equilibrium saturation pressures, we calculate the shift predicted by global thermodynamics and find agreement with the observed transition shift. The transition occurs at zero effective gravity, where the hydrostatic pressure difference balances the saturation-pressure difference between the two boundaries. The hysteresis response under heat conduction also agrees with the equilibrium response when plotted against effective gravity. These results establish the predictive power of global thermodynamics for nonequilibrium structure formation.
summary: 我们使用二维伦纳德-琼斯流体的标准分子动力学来测试全局热力学的有效重力预测。在下边界比上边界热的弱热传导下，气体下方的液体与气体上方的液体之间的过渡从零转向有限的向下重力。使用独立测量的平衡饱和压力，我们计算了全局热力学预测的位移，并发现与观察到的转变位移一致。这种转变发生在零有效重力下，其中静水压力差平衡了两个边界之间的饱和压力差。当针对有效重力绘制时，热传导下的滞后响应也与平衡响应一致。这些结果确立了整体热力学对非平衡结构形成的预测能力。

title: A Topological Spin on Racetrack Memory
abstract: Magnetic racetrack memory requires localized carriers that combine rapid motion, resistance to perturbations and a detectable signal. Here we show how a 360° domain wall in a hollow ferromagnetic tube combines these properties within a single continuous magnetic shell. Two successive magnetization reversals form a bound object whose surrounding domains point in the same direction. Analytical energetics and micromagnetic simulations establish its finite separation, recovery from tested perturbations and current driven transport without microscopic Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction or a maintaining field. The texture's winding resists unwinding while radial rotation carries an energy cost, providing a specific control over stability. Relative rotation of the constituent spins accounts quantitatively for additional displacement during current onset. The wall supports motion at hundreds of metres per second, with transient velocities approaching one kilometre per second at stronger drive. A prepared seven-bit pattern retains its carriers and local readout contrast after pulsed transport and recovery. Curved-track and differential-current tests identify radial stiffness and drive uniformity as controls for intact motion. These results establish a physical basis for fast, locally distinguishable tubular magnetic bits and identify a continuous switching pathway that can be targeted by tailored excitation.
summary:
磁性赛道存储器需要结合快速运动、抗扰动和可检测信号的局部载体。在这里，我们展示了空心铁磁管中的 360° 磁畴壁如何将这些特性结合在单个连续磁壳中。两个连续的磁化反转形成一个束缚物体，其周围的磁畴指向同一方向。分析能量学和微磁模拟建立了其有限分离、从测试扰动中恢复和电流驱动的输运，无需微观 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用或维持场。纹理的缠绕会阻碍展开，而径向旋转会产生能量成本，从而提供对稳定性的特定控制。组成自旋的相对旋转定量地解释了电流开始期间的额外位移。墙壁支持每秒数百米的运动，在更强的驱动下瞬态速度接近每秒一公里。准备好的七位模式在脉冲传输和恢复后保留其载体和局部读出对比度。

曲线轨道和差动电流测试确定径向刚度和驱动均匀性作为完整运动的控制。这些结果为快速、局部可区分的管状磁性钻头奠定了物理基础，并确定了可以通过定制激励来定位的连续切换路径。

title: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
abstract: Deep neural networks that predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonians from material structures offer a route to efficient electronic-structure calculations. However, extending localized atomic-orbital (AO) Hamiltonian learning to plane-wave (PW) calculations with hybrid functionals requires a compact AO representation that preserves the effects of nonlocal operators. Here we propose a projectability-guided construction of nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians from a small, selected set of PW eigenstates and eigenvalues. High-projectability states are retained, and selected higher-energy states complete the AO subspace, avoiding an empirical shift and its arbitrary contribution to the learning targets. Because the construction uses PW eigenstates and eigenvalues, it incorporates nonlocal contributions present in the reference calculation without explicitly reconstructing their AO matrix elements. Benchmarks for MoS2 and sodium phases show accurate reproduction of PW bands with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction. The resulting PBE and HSE Hamiltonians can be learned by equivariant neural networks, connecting PW reference calculations with electronic-structure prediction. This approach broadens the range of PW DFT calculations available for AO Hamiltonian learning and enables compact, accurate training targets for developing more widely applicable electronic-structure models.
summary:
从材料结构预测密度泛函理论 (DFT) 哈密顿量的深度神经网络提供了高效电子结构计算的途径。然而，将定域原子轨道 (AO) 哈密顿学习扩展到具有混合泛函的平面波 (PW) 计算需要一个紧凑的 AO 表示，以保留非定域算子的影响。在这里，我们提出了一种从一小部分选定的 PW 本征态和特征值中构建非正交 AO 哈密顿量的可投影性引导构造。保留高可投射性状态，并选择更高能量的状态来完成 AO 子空间，避免经验转变及其对学习目标的任意贡献。由于该构造使用 PW 特征状态和特征值，因此它合并了参考计算中存在的非局部贡献，而无需显式重建其 AO 矩阵元素。 MoS2 和钠相的基准显示，使用比真实空间重建更小的 AO 基数可以准确再现 PW 能带。

由此产生的 PBE 和 HSE 哈密顿量可以通过等变神经网络来学习，将 PW 参考计算与电子结构预测联系起来。这种方法扩大了可用于 AO 哈密顿学习的 PW DFT 计算范围，并实现紧凑、准确的训练目标，以开发更广泛适用的电子结构模型。

title: Altermagnetic Ground States on the Ammann--Beenker Tiling
abstract: We identify exact altermagnetic ground states of a classical Heisenberg model on a quasicrystal. Considering the Ammann--Beenker tiling as an example, we determine the ground states by exploiting the parity structure of its parent four-dimensional hypercubic lattice. The ground state hosts coplanar altermagnetic order characterized by the preserved spin-group symmetry $[C_{2x}\parallel C_{8z}]$. Without translational symmetry, the momentum-space spin splitting that usually identifies altermagnets is not directly accessible. We instead couple the spins to itinerant electrons and show spin-resolved transport with $g$-wave symmetry, confirming the altermagnetic nature in a nonperiodic system. Our results establish a geometric route to altermagnetic order in quasicrystals, connecting exact magnetic ground states to their spin-resolved transport signatures.
summary: 我们确定了准晶体上经典海森堡模型的精确交变磁基态。以 Ammann-Beenker 平铺为例，我们通过利用其父四维超立方晶格的宇称结构来确定基态。基态具有共面交变磁序，其特征是保留自旋群对称性$[C_{2x}\parallel C_{8z}]$。如果没有平移对称性，通常识别交流磁体的动量空间自旋分裂就无法直接获得。相反，我们将自旋与流动电子耦合，并显示具有 $g$ 波对称性的自旋解析输运，证实了非周期系统中的交变磁性质。我们的结果建立了准晶体中交变磁序的几何路线，将精确的磁基态与其自旋解析的输运特征联系起来。

title: Phases of a rotating Bose-Einstein condensate trapped in a hard-wall potential
abstract: We investigate the rotational properties of a zero-temperature Bose-Einstein condensed gas, which is confined in a hard-wall potential. For weak interactions the gas carries its angular momentum via vortices of multiple quantization. As the coupling increases and for sufficiently slow rotational frequencies of the trap, the multiply-quantized vortex states become unstable against a mixed state. For stronger couplings, as the angular frequency of the trap increases, there is a transition from a vortex lattice, to a vortex lattice with a hole at the trap center, and finally to a giant vortex. For weak effective attractive interactions we still have vortices of multiple quantization. These states become unstable towards states which break the axial symmetry of the problem and resemble center-of-mass excitation, as the coupling becomes more negative. Finally, for even more attractive forces, the system becomes unstable against collapse.
summary: 我们研究了被限制在硬壁势中的零温玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚气体的旋转特性。对于弱相互作用，气体通过多重量子化涡流携带其角动量。随着耦合的增加以及陷阱的旋转频率足够慢，多量化涡旋状态相对于混合状态变得不稳定。对于更强的耦合，随着陷阱角频率的增加，会出现从涡旋晶格到陷阱中心有孔的涡旋晶格的过渡，最后到巨型涡旋。对于弱的有效吸引相互作用，我们仍然存在多重量子化的漩涡。随着耦合变得更加负，这些状态对于破坏问题的轴对称性并类似于质心激励的状态变得不稳定。最后，对于更大的吸引力，系统变得不稳定，无法崩溃。

title: A Transferable Machine-Learned Potential Enabling Large-Scale Copper-Carbon Simulations from Equilibrium to Extreme Conditions
abstract: Cu-C materials and interfaces are central to diamond thermal management, metallization, graphene growth and carbon-coating technologies, but atomistic simulations across these applications require a potential that describes metallic Cu, diverse carbon bonding, heterogeneous Cu-C interactions and close atomic encounters. Here we develop NEP-CuC, a transferable neuroevolution potential trained on a dataset of 2,727 uniformly relabelled configurations selected from a heterogeneous Cu-C candidate pool. Disagreement within an ensemble of five independently trained models provides an internal indicator of model sensitivity. A Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark (ZBL) correction describes short-range nuclear repulsion, while a runtime D3(BJ) correction supplements dispersion-sensitive calculations. Tests on source-derived held-out and independent external datasets, together with structural, elastic, defect, interfacial, vibrational and finite-temperature transport benchmarks, establish broad but property-dependent physical fidelity across elemental Cu, diverse carbon environments and heterogeneous Cu-C configurations. Large-scale simulations of amorphous-carbon formation and orientation-dependent shock compression of Cu further test transferability under strongly non-equilibrium conditions. For Cu/diamond interfaces, the same potential describes deposition, annealing and tensile response: preparation history leaves persistent differences in interphase structure, while the mean peak nominal tensile stress at 500 K decreases from $12.35\pm0.71$ to $6.65\pm0.98$ GPa as the incident Cu energy during the initial deposition stage increases from 1 to 50 eV. NEP-CuC provides an atomistic framework for linking processing, interfacial structure and physical response across Cu-C systems, with direct relevance to Cu/diamond thermal-management interfaces, diamond metallization and non-equilibrium Cu-C processing.
summary:
Cu-C 材料和界面是金刚石热管理、金属化、石墨烯生长和碳涂层技术的核心，但这些应用的原子模拟需要描述金属 Cu、多种碳键合、异质 Cu-C 相互作用和紧密原子接触的势。在这里，我们开发了 NEP-CuC，一种可转移的神经进化潜能，在从异质 Cu-C 候选池中选择的 2,727 个统一重新标记配置的数据集上进行训练。五个独立训练的模型集合中的分歧提供了模型敏感性的内部指标。 Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark (ZBL) 校正描述了短程核斥力，而运行时 D3(BJ) 校正补充了色散敏感计算。对源自来源的保留和独立外部数据集的测试，以及结构、弹性、缺陷、界面、振动和有限温度传输基准，在元素铜、不同碳环境和异质铜-碳配置中建立了广泛但依赖于属性的物理保真度。

对无定形碳形成和铜的方向相关冲击压缩的大规模模拟进一步测试了强非平衡条件下的可转移性。对于铜/金刚石界面，相同的电势描述了沉积、退火和拉伸响应：制备历史在相间结构中留下了持续的差异，而随着初始沉积阶段的入射铜能量从 1 增加到 50 eV，500 K 时的平均峰值标称拉伸应力从 $12.35\pm0.71$ 降低到 $6.65\pm0.98$ GPa。 NEP-CuC 提供了一个原子框架，用于连接 Cu-C 系统的加工、界面结构和物理响应，与 Cu/金刚石热管理界面、金刚石金属化和非平衡 Cu-C 加工直接相关。

title: Exact Microscopic One-Body Reduction in the Symmetric Exclusion Process
abstract: The symmetric exclusion process (SEP) is a paradigmatic model of interacting particle transport. Its current--density correlations are governed by an infinite many-body hierarchy of equations. Only recently, this hierarchy was found to collapse at large scales onto a single closed equation. Is this remarkable simplification created by coarse graining, or does it reflect a deeper property already present in the microscopic dynamics? Here we show that the second scenario is realized. At arbitrary time on the lattice, the entire hierarchy collapses onto a single linear equation which is exactly equivalent to a persistence problem for a single auxiliary random walker. Thus an interacting many-body problem reduces exactly to a genuine one-body problem before any scaling limit is taken. This reduction determines the complete finite-time correlation profile, including during nonequilibrium relaxation. More broadly, the microscopic operator uncovered here opens a route to more general correlation functions in the SEP, and may point to a general organizing principle for nonequilibrium interacting particle systems.
summary: 对称排斥过程（SEP）是相互作用粒子输运的范例模型。它的电流-密度相关性由无限多体方程层次控制。直到最近，人们才发现这种层次结构在大规模上崩溃成一个封闭的方程。这种显着的简化是由粗粒化造成的，还是反映了微观动力学中已经存在的更深层次的属性？这里我们展示了第二种情况的实现。在晶格上的任意时间，整个层次结构崩溃为单个线性方程，这与单个辅助随机游走器的持久性问题完全相同。因此，在采取任何缩放限制之前，相互作用的多体问题完全简化为真正的单体问题。这种减少决定了完整的有限时间相关曲线，包括非平衡弛豫期间。更广泛地说，这里发现的微观算子为 SEP 中更一般的相关函数开辟了一条途径，并可能指出非平衡相互作用粒子系统的一般组织原理。

title: Plasmon modes in triple-point semimetal, its quadratic cousin, and Hopf semimetal
abstract: We study collective charge excitations in pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetals within the random-phase approximation, considering both the linearised model with a flat-band and its quadratic-corrected counterpart. We analyse their density response, Drude weights, screening, plasmon dispersion and damping, particle-hole continua, and Friedel oscillations from the long-wavelength to the arbitrary-momentum regime. The quadratic correction renders the flat-band dispersive and endows it with a Fermi surface, thereby affecting the overall response. Comparisons with Weyl and Hopf semimetals reveal how bandstructure and quantum geometry jointly govern collective charge dynamics. While the Drude weights are determined by the Fermi surface and band-velocities, interband screening, plasmon dispersion, and Friedel oscillations reflect the quantum geometry of the eigenstates.
summary: 我们研究了随机相位近似内赝自旋 1 三点半金属中的集体电荷激发，同时考虑了具有平带的线性化模型及其二次校正模型。我们分析了它们的密度响应、德鲁德权重、筛选、等离激元色散和阻尼、粒子孔连续体以及从长波长到任意动量范围的弗里德尔振荡。二次校正使平带色散并赋予其费米面，从而影响整体响应。与韦尔和霍普夫半金属的比较揭示了能带结构和量子几何如何共同控制集体电荷动力学。虽然德鲁德权重由费米表面和带速决定，但带间屏蔽、等离激元色散和弗里德尔振荡反映了本征态的量子几何结构。

title: Momentum conservation for ab initio calculations with pseudopotentials via a phase space electronic structure formulation
abstract: We demonstrate how to build a robust phase space electronic Hamiltonian $\hat{H}_\text{PS}(\boldsymbol{R},\boldsymbol{P})$ that depends on nuclear position $\boldsymbol{R}$ and nuclear momentum $\boldsymbol{P}$ in the presence of ionic pseudopotentials. In particular, we show that in order to account for the non-local component of a pseudopotential while also conserving linear and angular momentum, one is forced to introduce a non-local one-electron operator $\hat{\boldsymbol{\Gamma}}^\text{nl}$ that couples electronic and nuclear momenta together. To test the validity of our ansatz, we derive a generalized form of Nafie's exact equality (which relates electronic momentum and electronic position) so as to include the presence of pseudopotentials. We then benchmark our proposed phase space electronic structure theory against this generalized Nafie-like result for a diverse set of diatomic molecules spanning a wide range of elements. We find excellent agreement across this ab initio test set, highlighting the strength of our method in capturing meaningful electronic momentum beyond the Born-Oppenheimer framework.
summary: 我们演示了如何构建鲁棒的相空间电子哈密顿量 $\hat{H}_\text{PS}(\boldsymbol{R},\boldsymbol{P})$，该哈密顿量取决于离子赝势存在下的核位置 $\boldsymbol{R}$ 和核动量 $\boldsymbol{P}$。特别地，我们表明，为了解释赝势的非局域分量，同时又保持线性和角动量，人们被迫引入一种非局域单电子算子 $\hat{\boldsymbol{\Gamma}}^\text{nl}$ 将电子和核动量耦合在一起。为了测试我们的 ansatz 的有效性，我们推导了 Nafie 精确等式的广义形式（它涉及电子动量和电子位置），以便包括赝势的存在。然后，我们将我们提出的相空间电子结构理论与跨越多种元素的多种双原子分子的广义 Nafie 式结果进行基准比较。我们在这个从头开始的测试集中发现了极好的一致性，突显了我们的方法在捕获超出玻恩-奥本海默框架的有意义的电子动量方面的优势。

title: Extending the mean first-passage-time formalism to the reconstruction of high free-energy barriers: A top-start approach
abstract: Rare events, such as crystal nucleation in mildly supercooled liquids, are characterized by waiting times that can be much longer than the timescale of the underlying microscopic dynamics. The mean first-passage time (MFPT) formalism [J. Wedekind and D. Reguera, J. Phys. Chem. B 112, 11060 (2008)] provides a route to reconstruct one-dimensional free-energy profiles from the MFPT and steady-state distribution measured along a reaction coordinate, but conventional implementations become inefficient for sufficiently high barriers because spontaneous crossings are rarely observed. We introduce a "top-start" extension that initiates trajectories near the barrier top and reconstructs the free-energy profile from their subsequent evolution away from the barrier toward lower-free-energy regions. We establish the equivalence between the top-start and two-region constructions using a Markov-chain transition-matrix formulation. We validate the method using one-dimensional random-walk simulations across low, medium, and high free-energy barriers, with transition-matrix calculations providing an exact benchmark for the corresponding discretized models. The top-start reconstruction remains accurate in the high-barrier regime where conventional MFPT sampling becomes prohibitively inefficient.
summary:
罕见事件，例如轻度过冷液体中的晶体成核，其特征是等待时间可能比底层微观动力学的时间尺度长得多。平均首次通过时间（MFPT）形式主义[J。 Wedekind 和 D. Reguera，J. Phys。化学。 B 112, 11060 (2008)] 提供了一种根据 MFPT 和沿反应坐标测量的稳态分布重建一维自由能分布的途径，但传统的实现对于足够高的势垒而言效率较低，因为很少观察到自发跨越。我们引入了“顶部启动”扩展，该扩展在势垒顶部附近启动轨迹，并根据其随后从势垒向低自由能区域的演化来重建自由能剖面。我们使用马尔可夫链转移矩阵公式建立了顶起始结构和两区域结构之间的等价性。我们使用跨越低、中、高自由能势垒的一维随机游走模拟来验证该方法，并通过过渡矩阵计算为相应的离散模型提供精确的基准。

在传统 MFPT 采样变得极其低效的高势垒状态下，最高起始重建仍然准确。

title: Superexchange coupling between a dilute Gd3+ probe and orphan spins in a valence-bond glass
abstract: The valence-bond-glass state of the 4d^1 double perovskite Ba2YMoO6 combines Mo^5+ singlets with residual paramagnetic "orphan" spins whose coupling is hard to reach with bulk probes. We probe them by electron paramagnetic resonance of a dilute Gd^3+ ion on the Y^3+ site via broadband coplanar-waveguide transmission at 5 K. The isostructural nonmagnetic niobate Ba2YNbO6, doped with the same Gd^3+ probe, is a fixed-lattice control. The Gd^3+ linewidth nearly doubles in the magnetic host. Dipolar coupling to the sparse orphans is nearly an order of magnitude too weak; the excess is instead reproduced by a transferred f-d superexchange of J ~ 0.2 K, so the width is a static measure of orphan-spin coupling. The half-field (Delta m_S = +/-2) satellite collapses in the magnetic host, a dynamical dephasing channel, while the unchanged g-factor marks a zero-mean random internal field. Together the two channels probe the coupling and dynamics of valence-bond-glass orphan spins.
summary: 4d^1 双钙钛矿 Ba2YMoO6 的价键玻璃态将 Mo^5+ 单线态与残余顺磁“孤儿”自旋相结合，其耦合很难用体探针实现。我们通过 5 K 宽带共面波导传输，通过 Y^3+ 位点上稀 Gd^3+ 离子的电子顺磁共振来探测它们。掺杂有相同 Gd^3+ 探针的同结构非磁性铌酸盐 Ba2YNbO6 是一种固定晶格对照。 Gd^3+ 线宽在磁性主体中几乎加倍。与稀疏孤子的偶极耦合几乎太弱了一个数量级；多余的部分由 J ~ 0.2 K 的转移 f-d 超交换来再现，因此宽度是孤儿自旋耦合的静态测量。半场 (Delta m_S = +/-2) 卫星在磁宿主（动态相移通道）中塌陷，而不变的 g 因子则标志着零均值随机内部场。这两个通道一起探测价键玻璃孤儿自旋的耦合和动力学。

title: Emergent Loop Geometry in Gauge-Equivariant Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Gauge-equivariant graph neural networks generate ordered products of gauge links through local message passing, but the geometry of these internal structures is not captured by the receptive field alone. We investigate the statistical ensemble of closed lattice walks generated by recursive node- and edge-feature operations, independently of network training. Analytical and numerical results reveal a separation between rapid growth of contour length and much slower spatial expansion: deeper compositions generate increasingly long paths through repeated traversal of relatively compact regions. Loop expansions of fermionic observables provide a physical interpretation of this hierarchy, showing how spatial locality remains compatible with high-order dependence on nearby gauge fields. These findings identify complementary roles of network depth in extending spatial reach and enriching the representations constructed within that reach, providing a geometrical perspective on learning lattice gauge observables.
summary: 规范等变图神经网络通过局部消息传递生成规范链接的有序积，但这些内部结构的几何形状并不能单独由感受野捕获。我们研究了由递归节点和边缘特征操作生成的闭合格子行走的统计集合，独立于网络训练。分析和数值结果揭示了轮廓长度的快速增长和更慢的空间扩展之间的分离：更深的构图通过重复遍历相对紧凑的区域生成越来越长的路径。费米子可观测量的循环展开提供了这种层次结构的物理解释，显示了空间局域性如何与附近规范场的高阶依赖性保持兼容。这些发现确定了网络深度在扩展空间范围和丰富在该范围内构建的表示方面的互补作用，为学习晶格规范可观测量提供了几何视角。

title: A hierarchy of exact lower bounds on the Laughlin spectral gap
abstract: We develop a bootstrap approach to deriving lower bounds on the spectral gap of the first Haldane pseudopotential Hamiltonian on the sphere with $N_\Phi$ flux quanta for arbitrary $N_\Phi$, including in the thermodynamic limit $N_\Phi \to \infty$. Our approach can in principle be generalized to pseudopotentials describing other model wavefunctions such as the Moore-Read state or Read-Rezayi sequence. Our approach is based on Knabe's observation that if $H$ is a Hamiltonian with ground state energy $0$ then the spectral gap is at least $\epsilon > 0$ if and only if $H^2 \succeq \epsilon H$. To show this inequality, we split $H^2$ into two parts, one that can be analytically bounded and another that can be bounded using a finite semidefinite program (SDP). Crucially, the size of this program is determined only by cutoff parameters, and the program depends on $N_\Phi$ only parametrically, allowing us to obtain numerically exact (up to solver precision) lower bounds on the gap. In order to turn these numerical bounds into mathematically rigorous bounds, we introduce an algorithm that can produce nearly-optimal exact feasible points for large rational SDPs. We additionally provide an algorithm that establishes the rank stability of the semidefinite program in the limit $N_\Phi \to \infty$ which is needed to certify the bound in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond establishing the Laughlin gap and revealing a potential method for deriving spectral gap lower bounds for other pseudopotentials, our work provides a general method for turning numerical semidefinite programming bounds into rigorous mathematical proofs, which may have wide applicability.
summary:
我们开发了一种自举方法，用于推导球体上第一个 Haldane 赝势哈密顿量的谱间隙下界，其中任意 $N_\Phi$ 具有 $N_\Phi$ 通量量子，包括热力学极限 $N_\Phi \to \infty$。我们的方法原则上可以推广到描述其他模型波函数的赝势，例如 Moore-Read 状态或 Read-Rezayi 序列。我们的方法基于 Knabe 的观察，即如果 $H$ 是基态能量 $0$ 的哈密顿量，则谱间隙至少为 $\epsilon > 0$ 当且仅当 $H^2 \succeq \epsilon H$ 时。为了证明这种不等式，我们将 $H^2$ 分成两部分，一部分可以分析有界，另一部分可以使用有限半定程序 (SDP) 有界。至关重要的是，该程序的大小仅由截止参数决定，并且该程序仅在参数上取决于 $N_\Phi$，这使我们能够获得数值上精确的间隙下限（达到求解器精度）。为了将这些数值界限转化为数学上严格的界限，我们引入了一种算法，可以为大型有理 SDP 生成近乎最优的精确可行点。

我们还提供了一种算法，可在极限 $N_\Phi \to \infty$ 内建立半定程序的秩稳定性，这是证明热力学极限中的界限所必需的。除了建立劳克林间隙并揭示一种推导其他赝势的谱间隙下界的潜在方法之外，我们的工作还提供了一种将数值半定规划界限转化为严格的数学证明的通用方法，该方法可能具有广泛的适用性。

title: Semiclassical state on algebra of observables for de Sitter space and time reversal symmetry
abstract: In de Sitter static patch holography, coupling bulk quantum fields to an observer's dynamical clock yields a type II$_1$ von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{M}_+$ of gauge-invariant observables. However, the unique tracial state on this algebra fails to reproduce semiclassical bulk correlation functions. We resolve this issue by introducing a family of heavy-clock states, representing an observer reference frame with heavy inertia. We prove that in the heavy-clock limit, $n$-point correlation functions of gauge-invariant dressed observables reproduce the bulk quantum field correlation functions on de Sitter spacetime. Furthermore, we investigate a generalized observer Hamiltonian $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ that incorporates both forward-running ($\pi\geq 0$) and backward-running ($\pi <0$) clocks. The resulting von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{M}$ of gauge-invariant observables remains a type~II$_1$ factor and is isomorphic to $\mathcal{M}_+\otimes M_2(\mathbb{C})$, where $M_2(\mathbb{C})$ is the algebra of $2\times2$ complex matrices transforming between the two clock orientations. Time-reversal symmetry is implemented in this setting as an anti-unitary operator that exchanges the two clock orientations, yielding a type~II$_1$ von Neumann algebra $\mathcal{F}$ of gauge-invariant, time-reversal-invariant observables. We generalize the heavy-clock state construction to both $\mathcal{M}$ and $\mathcal{F}$, showing that $n$-point correlation functions calculated in heavy-clock states match the corresponding semiclassical bulk correlation functions. Finally, by coupling Einstein gravity to the Brown--Kuchař dust field, we derive the observer Hamiltonian $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ from a perturbative reduction along the observer's worldline in the $G \to 0$ limit. This provides a field-theoretic foundation for the observer model developed in this work.
summary:
在德西特静态贴片全息术中，将体量子场耦合到观察者的动态时钟会产生 II$_1$ 冯诺依曼代数 $\mathcal{M}_+$ 规范不变可观测量。然而，该代数的独特迹态无法重现半经典体相关函数。我们通过引入一系列重时钟状态来解决这个问题，代表具有重惯性的观察者参考系。我们证明，在重时钟限制下，规范不变的修饰可观测量的 $n$ 点相关函数再现了德西特时空上的体量子场相关函数。此外，我们研究了广义观察者哈密顿量 $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ ，它包含前向运行 ($\pi\geq 0$) 和后向运行 ($\pi <0$) 时钟。由此产生的规范不变可观测量的冯·诺依曼代数 $\mathcal{M}$ 仍然是一个 type~II$_1$ 因子，并且与 $\mathcal{M}_+\otimes M_2(\mathbb{C})$ 同构，其中 $M_2(\mathbb{C})$ 是 $2\times2$ 复数矩阵在两个时钟方向之间变换的代数。

时间反转对称性在此设置中实现为反酉算子，交换两个时钟方向，产生规范不变、时间反转不变可观测量的 type~II$_1$ 冯诺依曼代数 $\mathcal{F}$。我们将重时钟状态构造推广到 $\mathcal{M}$ 和 $\mathcal{F}$，表明在重时钟状态下计算的 $n$ 点相关函数与相应的半经典体相关函数相匹配。最后，通过将爱因斯坦引力耦合到布朗-库查什尘埃场，我们从沿观察者世界线在 $G \to 0$ 极限的微扰减少中推导出观察者哈密顿量 $\widehat{H}_{\rm obs}=|\widehat{\pi}|$ 。这为这项工作中开发的观察者模型提供了场论基础。

title: Defect conformal field theories with free-in-the-bulk fermions
abstract: We study codimension-two conformal defects for massless fermions that are free in a four-dimensional bulk, but interact on a two-dimensional defect. The bulk Dirac equation strongly constrains defect conformal field theory data: it fixes the dimensions of operators in the bulk-defect operator product expansion and, for bulk-defect-defect three-point functions, enforces a double-twist relation when only one member of a shadow pair is allowed by unitarity. The lowest modes of monodromy defects provide an important exception, since both shadow partners can be unitary and their three-point functions are instead related by a shadow transform. We illustrate these structures with defect interactions, including an exactly tractable bilinear flow and Gross-Neveu-type quartic couplings. At a perturbative mixed fixed point, we find an explicit interacting example in which the double-twist condition is violated and the two shadow channels combine to give a regular bulk-defect-defect correlation function.
summary: 我们研究无质量费米子的余维二共形缺陷，这些费米子在四维体中是自由的，但在二维缺陷上相互作用。体狄拉克方程强烈约束缺陷共形场论数据：它固定体缺陷算子乘积展开中算子的维数，并且对于体缺陷-缺陷三点函数，当酉性仅允许影子对的一个成员时，强制执行双扭转关系。单一性缺陷的最低模式提供了一个重要的例外，因为两个影子伙伴都可以是幺正的，并且它们的三点函数而是通过影子变换相关联。我们用缺陷相互作用来说明这些结构，包括精确可处理的双线性流和 Gross-Neveu 型四次耦合。在扰动混合不动点，我们找到了一个显式交互示例，其中违反了双扭曲条件，并且两个阴影通道组合起来给出了常规的体缺陷缺陷相关函数。

title: The dimensional reduction of the spin-3 and spin-4 partially broken Fronsdal models
abstract: Here we perform a Kaluza-Klein dimensional reduction from $D+1$ to $D$ dimensions of a partially broken Fronsdal model for spin-3 and spin-4. The reduced models describe massive spin-3 and spin-4 particles without extra propagating modes. They differ from Singh-Hagen models by quadratic terms which vanish on shell, similarly to their higher dimensional massless parents. A covariant description of the reduced models in terms of gauge invariant field combinations naturally leads to higher derivative models, contrary to lower spin cases ($s\le 2$). For both $s=3$ and $s=4$ we have a rather peculiar massless limit. Although their particle content corresponds to the $\pm j$ helicities with $j=0,1, \cdots s$, as expected, they appear intertwined in a non trivial way preventing diagonalization through any local field redefinition.
summary: 在这里，我们对自旋 3 和自旋 4 的部分破坏的 Fronsdal 模型执行 Kaluza-Klein 维度从 $D+1$ 降维到 $D$ 维度。简化模型描述了大量的自旋 3 和自旋 4 粒子，没有额外的传播模式。它们与辛格-哈根模型的不同之处在于二次项在壳上消失，类似于它们的高维无质量父模型。根据规范不变场组合对简化模型进行协变描述自然会产生更高的导数模型，这与较低自旋情况相反 ($s\le 2$)。对于 $s=3$ 和 $s=4$ 来说，我们有一个相当奇特的无质量极限。尽管它们的粒子含量对应于 $j=0,1, \cdots s$ 的 $\pm j$ 螺旋度，正如预期的那样，它们似乎以一种不平凡的方式交织在一起，防止通过任何局部场重新定义进行对角化。

title: Three-dimensional vacua of $G_2$ flux compactifications
abstract: We study supersymmetric vacua of three-dimensional $\mathcal N=1$ effective theories from type IIA, type IIB/type I, and heterotic compactifications on $G_2$-structure spaces. Superpotential homogeneity and the physical scalar metric yield universal vacuum relations and axion stabilization constraints without specifying the full moduli-space metric. We express AdS$_3$ scalar masses through $\Delta$, the scaling dimension of the corresponding operator in the dual two-dimensional conformal field theory. In massive type IIA AdS$_3$ vacua, we derive the bound $\Delta_{\max}\geq(20+4\sqrt{67})/7\approx 7.5$ and an exact dimension $\Delta_b=6$ for $B_2$ axions on the torsion-free branch. Type IIB type I and heterotic AdS$_3$ vacua contain a universal volume-dilaton mode with $\Delta_{\phi s}=4$. On the singlet-torsion type IIB branch, we also obtain the volume-dilaton mode with $\Delta_{\phi s}=20/7$ and $\Delta_b=16/7$. Every supersymmetric Minkowski vacuum in the retained classical closed-string theories possesses an exact volume-dilaton flat direction. We characterize physical large-flux limits after tadpole constraints and axionic identifications, and identify torsion obstructions to isotropic scale separation.
summary:
我们研究了来自IIA型、IIB/I型以及$G_2$结构空间上的杂变紧化的三维$\mathcal N=1$有效理论的超对称真空。超势均匀性和物理标量度量产生通用真空关系和轴子稳定约束，而无需指定完整的模空间度量。我们通过对偶二维共形场论中相应算子的缩放维数$\Delta$来表达AdS$_3$标量质量。在大规模 IIA AdS$_3$ 真空中，我们推导出无扭转分支上 $B_2$ 轴子的边界 $\Delta_{\max}\geq(20+4\sqrt{67})/7\approx 7.5$ 和精确尺寸 $\Delta_b=6$。 IIB 型 I 型和异质 AdS$_3$ vacua 包含通用体积膨胀模式，$\Delta_{\phi s}=4$。在单重扭转型IIB分支上，我们还获得了$\Delta_{\phi s}=20/7$和$\Delta_b=16/7$的体积膨胀模式。保留的经典闭弦理论中的每个超对称闵可夫斯基真空都具有精确的体积膨胀平面方向。

我们在蝌蚪约束和轴子识别后表征了物理大通量限制，并识别了各向同性尺度分离的扭转障碍。

title: One-loop QED effective action at finite temperature and density beyond HTL limit
abstract: We develop a framework for computing the nonlocal one-loop effective action in scalar and spinor QED at finite temperature and chemical potential in arbitrary even spacetime dimensions. Based on the heat kernel expansion to quadratic order in background fields, the framework reduces the effective action form factors to a common fundamental kernel. By resumming the external-momentum expansion, we obtain explicit closed-form expressions for the massless form factors in terms of polylogarithms and their derivatives with respect to the order. The same method determines the coefficients of the small-mass expansion to arbitrary order. The resulting expressions retain the full dependence on external Euclidean momentum, temperature, and chemical potential, without invoking the soft-momentum approximation. We also derive the corresponding photon polarization operators and evaluate their static limits, obtaining the Debye screening masses and electromagnetic susceptibilities.
summary: 我们开发了一个框架，用于计算任意甚至时空维度的有限温度和化学势下标量和旋量 QED 中的非局域单环有效作用。该框架基于背景场中热核展开到二次阶，将有效作用形式因子简化为公共基本核。通过恢复外部动量展开，我们获得了无质量形状因子的多对数及其阶导数的显式封闭式表达式。同样的方法可以确定小质量膨胀到任意阶的系数。所得表达式保留了对外部欧几里德动量、温度和化学势的完全依赖，而不调用软动量近似。我们还推导了相应的光子偏振算子并评估了它们的静态极限，获得了德拜屏蔽质量和电磁磁化率。

title: Characteristic Modes of Non-minimally Coupled Thick Branes
abstract: Characteristic modes provide important information about the intrinsic properties and dynamical response of gravitational systems. In this work, we investigate characteristic modes of thick branes with a non-minimally coupled bulk scalar field. Two representative thick brane solutions are considered, corresponding to a single-kink scalar configuration and a deformed kink configuration with internal structure, respectively. By analyzing the tensor perturbation equations, we first examine the localization of the graviton zero mode in the two brane models. For both brane models, the graviton zero mode is localized on the brane. No pronounced resonant Kaluza--Klein (KK) modes are found for the single-kink brane at $\xi=1/7$. For the deformed brane, we investigate the resonant KK modes at $\xi=0.99$, finding that increasing the deformation parameter $k$ leads to more resonant modes and a longer-lived first resonance. We then calculate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of both brane models independently in the frequency and time domains. The quasinormal frequencies (QNFs) obtained by the independent methods agree well for the low overtones. The masses and decay rates of the resonant KK modes agree closely with the real parts and the magnitudes of the imaginary parts of the corresponding QNFs, respectively.
summary:
特征模式提供了有关引力系统的固有属性和动态响应的重要信息。在这项工作中，我们研究了具有非最小耦合体标量场的厚膜的特征模式。考虑了两种代表性的厚膜解决方案，分别对应于单扭结标量配置和具有内部结构的变形扭结配置。通过分析张量摄动方程，我们首先检查两个膜模型中引力子零模式的局域化。对于两种膜模型，引力子零模式都位于膜上。对于 $\xi=1/7$ 处的单扭结膜，没有发现明显的共振 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 模式。对于变形膜，我们研究了 $\xi=0.99$ 处的共振 KK 模式，发现增加变形参数 $k$ 会导致更多的共振模式和寿命更长的第一共振。然后，我们在频域和时域中独立计算两个膜模型的拟正规模式（QNM）。通过独立方法获得的准正常频率（QNF）与低频泛音非常吻合。

谐振 KK 模式的质量和衰减率分别与相应 QNF 的实部和虚部的大小非常一致。

title: Haagerup conformal field theory at central charge eight
abstract: We construct a chiral algebra $U$ of central charge eight inside the lattice vertex operator algebra $V_{E_6\oplus A_2}$. It is generated by two commuting affine $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ current algebras at levels $1$ and $39$, the stress tensor of the lattice theory, and a single weight-two field built from three lattice exponentials. We announce that $U$ is strongly rational and completely unitary, and that $Rep(U)$ is equivalent, as a unitary ribbon category, to the Drinfeld center $Z(\mathcal{H}_3)$ of the Haagerup fusion category $\mathcal{H}_3$. Its characters are the $\gamma=0$ Evans--Gannon vector. From $U$ we obtain a diagonal full CFT, and also a holomorphic $E_8$ extension on which $\mathcal{H}_3$ acts by topological defects.
summary: 我们在晶格顶点算子代数 $V_{E_6\oplus A_2}$ 内构造一个中心电荷为 8 的手性代数 $U$。它由 $1$ 和 $39$ 级别的两个交换仿射 $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ 当前代数、晶格理论的应力张量以及由三个晶格指数构建的单个权重二场生成。我们宣布 $U$ 是强理性且完全酉的，并且 $Rep(U)$ 作为酉带状范畴相当于 Haagerup 融合范畴 $\mathcal{H}_3$ 的 Drinfeld 中心 $Z(\mathcal{H}_3)$。其特征是 $\gamma=0$ Evans--Gannon 向量。从$U$我们得到一个对角全CFT，以及一个全纯$E_8$扩展，其中$\mathcal{H}_3$通过拓扑缺陷起作用。

title: PINNs for N=2* holography
abstract: Can a holographic theory be reconstructed from its equation of state? We investigate this question using physics-informed neural networks in the bosonic-mass sector of the Pilch--Warner model. We first validate the PINN approach against an analytic solution encoding the leading high-temperature corrections to the conformal equation of state. We then reconstruct nonlinear black-brane geometries and the scalar potential using thermodynamics, ultraviolet asymptotics, Ward identities, and horizon regularity. Independent solutions of the bulk Einstein-scalar equations demonstrate that accurately reproducing thermodynamics with a trained PINN does not guarantee an accurate reconstruction of the scalar potential. High-precision knowledge of the high-temperature equation of state constrains nonlinear interactions in the bulk scalar potential. Fixing the cubic coupling to its exact PW value, motivated by this high-temperature extraction, reduces the maximum sampled error in the reconstructed scalar self-interactions by a factor of $\sim 15$ compared with constraining only the bulk scalar mass. Adding knowledge of the bulk viscosity of the gauge theory plasma further reduces this error by an additional factor of $\sim 13$, with independent forward solutions reproducing the bulk viscosity within $0.09\%$.
summary:
全息理论可以从其状态方程重建吗？我们使用 Pilch-Warner 模型的玻色子质量部分中的物理信息神经网络来研究这个问题。我们首先针对对共形状态方程编码主要高温校正的解析解验证 PINN 方法。然后，我们利用热力学、紫外渐近学、沃德恒等式和视界正则性重建非线性黑膜几何形状和标量势。大量爱因斯坦标量方程的独立解表明，使用经过训练的 PINN 准确再现热力学并不能保证标量势的准确重建。高温状态方程的高精度知识限制了体标量势中的非线性相互作用。在这种高温提取的推动下，将三次耦合固定为其精确的 PW 值，与仅约束体标量质量相比，可将重构标量自相互作用中的最大采样误差降低 $\sim 15$ 倍。

添加规范理论等离子体的体积粘度的知识，可以通过额外的因子 $\sim 13$ 进一步减少该误差，并且独立的正向解可在 $0.09\%$ 内再现体积粘度。

title: Bondi Four-Momentum Balance in Quantum NSF Classical matching, DKL supermomentum, and quantum energy redistribution
abstract: We derive Bondi four-momentum balance between past and future null infinity in the radiative phase space of the null-surface formulation (NSF). Weyl matching at spatial infinity, together with vanishing endpoint News, gives antipodal continuity of the Bondi mass aspect. Its translation projection is independent of the infrared shear term and transforms as a Lorentz four-vector. Bondi evolution relates the incoming and outgoing News fluxes to the timelike endpoint momenta; in the Dominguez--Kozameh--Ludvigsen radiative sector these momenta vanish and the fluxes are equal. On a common radiative Fock domain, unitary conjugation transports the flux observables. Adopting their classical balance as an additional quantum condition yields exclusive four-momentum conservation. We also calculate the outgoing energy expectation without imposing that condition. For an incoming energy eigenstate, the second-generator commutator vanishes diagonally, leaving a second-order coefficient determined by the cubic generator. Direct canonical contractions isolate the contribution connected to all four external legs. For the equal-energy center-of-mass preparation, axial rotational covariance forces the angularly integrated exchange coefficient to vanish under the finite helicity-projection prescription of Part~I. The connected energy defect therefore vanishes through second order. The full expectation (including spectators) and higher-order balance remain open.
summary:
我们在零面公式（NSF）的辐射相空间中推导出过去和未来零无穷大之间的邦迪四动量平衡。空间无限处的外尔匹配与消失的端点新闻一起给出了邦迪质量方面的对映连续性。其平移投影与红外剪切项无关，并变换为洛伦兹四向量。 Bondi 演化将传入和传出的新闻流与类时端点动量联系起来；在 Dominguez-Kozameh-Ludvigsen 辐射区中，这些动量消失并且通量相等。在共同的辐射福克域上，酉共轭传输通量可观测量。采用它们的经典平衡作为附加量子条件产生了独特的四动量守恒。我们还计算了输出能量期望而不施加该条件。对于传入的能量本征态，第二发生器换向器对角消失，留下由三次发生器确定的二阶系数。直接规范收缩隔离了与所有四个外部腿相关的贡献。

对于等能量质心制备，轴向旋转协方差迫使角积分交换系数在第 I 部分的有限螺旋度投影规定下消失。因此，相连的能量缺陷通过二阶消失。完整的期望（包括观众）和高阶平衡仍然开放。

title: A critical coupling for the magnetic instability of holographic SU(2) plasmas
abstract: We show that gravity can remove the linear magnetic instability of a holographic plasma with an $SU(2)$ global symmetry. In the probe limit, charged vector bosons become tachyonic in their lowest Landau level above a critical field and condense into a vortex lattice. In Einstein-$SU(2)$ Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_5$ we include the backreaction of the field exactly, expanding only in the condensate around the D'Hoker-Kraus magnetic brane. The critical field diverges as the coupling $\alpha = \kappa^2/\hat g^2$ approaches $\alpha_\star = 2/3$, above which the normal phase has no linear charged instability at any field or temperature: we show this at zero temperature and establish it numerically at finite temperature. At zero temperature the field cancels from the mass of the lowest Landau level in the brane's AdS$_3 \times \mathbb{R}^2$ throat, and the instability is a violation of the throat's Breitenlohner-Freedman bound. The onset temperature vanishes at $\alpha_\star$ with an essential singularity of Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless type. For two-derivative Einstein-Yang-Mills duals in $d = 4$, 5 and 6 dimensions the normal phase has a charged instability if and only if $C_J/C_T < 8/(d^2(d+1))$, one tenth in $d = 4$. Above $\alpha_L = 0.372$ the gravitational attraction between vortices makes the uniform lattice unstable and the transition first order, so $B_c$ is only a spinodal; whether a condensed phase survives above $\alpha_\star$ is left open.
summary:
我们证明重力可以消除具有 $SU(2)$ 全局对称性的全息等离子体的线性磁不稳定性。在探测极限中，带电矢量玻色子在临界场之上的最低朗道能级中变成快子，并凝结成涡晶格。在 AdS$_5$ 中的 Einstein-$SU(2)$ Yang-Mills 理论中，我们精确地包括了场的反作用，仅在 D'Hoker-Kraus 磁膜周围的凝聚态中膨胀。当耦合 $\alpha = \kappa^2/\hat g^2$ 接近 $\alpha_\star = 2/3$ 时，临界场发散，高于该值，正相在任何场或温度下都没有线性带电不稳定性：我们在零温度下显示这一点，并在有限温度下以数值方式建立它。在零温度下，场抵消了膜 AdS$_3 \times \mathbb{R}^2$ 喉部最低朗道能级的质量，并且不稳定性违反了喉部的 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界。起始温度在 $\alpha_\star$ 处消失，具有 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 类型的本质奇点。

对于 $d = 4$、5 和 6 维的二阶导数 Einstein-Yang-Mills 对偶，当且仅当 $C_J/C_T < 8/(d^2(d+1))$（$d = 4$ 中的十分之一）时，正态相具有带电不稳定性。在$\alpha_L = 0.372$以上，涡旋之间的引力使均匀晶格不稳定，并且跃迁为一阶，因此$B_c$只是旋节线；凝聚相是否存在于$\alpha_\star$之上是开放的。

title: Charged Deformation of a Hairy Black Brane: Perturbative Solution and Thermodynamics
abstract: We study electrically charged black branes in four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell-scalar theory with Maxwell coupling $Z(\phi)=e^{3\phi/\sqrt7}$, whose potential has an AdS$_4$ fixed point only in the infrared. For nonzero hair parameter $\alpha$ the scalar grows logarithmically at large radius and the geometry is not asymptotically AdS, so the holographic dictionary is a working assumption. With the scale-invariant multi-trace boundary condition of the neutral branes, giving conformal thermodynamics, we work to second order in the charge, obtaining the Maxwell field and susceptibility in closed form, plus the thermodynamics, condensate, incoherent conductivity and cumulant ratio $T^2\chi_4/\chi_2=6c(\alpha)<0$ for all $\alpha$ considered. Independent perturbative computations and first-law closed forms agree within $4\times10^{-6}$; nonlinear solutions reproduce second-order results to $1.2\times10^{-5}$ and $c$ to $6\times10^{-4}$. They are locally thermodynamically stable where constructed, and the pressure is analytic in $(\mu_Q/T)^2$ near zero density. No regular extremal horizon exists at finite scalar value, and $\rho/s<\sqrt{21}/(2\pi)$ exactly. The extremal limit is an AdS$_2\times\mathbb R^2$ throat where the scalar grows as $\ln\ln(1/u)$ in the AdS$_2$ radial coordinate $u$; the bound is saturated there, and extremal values are approached as powers of $1/\ln(\mu_Q/T)$. With a Dirichlet condition on the scalar source, the same solutions describe a non-conformal theory with scale $\Lambda$, whose charged branes exist only below $T_{\max}(\mu_Q)$, which falls from $0.194\Lambda$ at zero density to zero at $\mu_Q=0.506\Lambda$. This boundary is a diffusive instability where the charge susceptibility diverges at nonzero density, and the bulk viscosity violates Buchel's bound at all densities. Quasinormal modes with the normalizable large-radius condition reproduce its hydrodynamics.
summary:
我们在四维爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦标量理论中研究带电黑膜，麦克斯韦耦合 $Z(\phi)=e^{3\phi/\sqrt7}$，其电势仅在红外区域具有 AdS$_4$ 固定点。对于非零头发参数 $\alpha$，标量在大半径处以对数方式增长，并且几何形状不是渐近 AdS，因此全息字典是一个可行的假设。利用中性膜的尺度不变多迹边界条件，给出共形热力学，我们对电荷进行二阶处理，获得封闭形式的麦克斯韦场和磁化率，加上热力学、凝聚态、非相干电导率和累积比 $T^2\chi_4/\chi_2=6c(\alpha)<0$（​​对于所有考虑的 $\alpha$）。独立微扰计算和第一定律闭合形式在 $4\times10^{-6}$ 范围内一致；非线性解将二阶结果再现为 $1.2\times10^{-5}$，将 $c$ 再现为 $6\times10^{-4}$。它们在构造时具有局部热力学稳定，并且压力在接近零密度的 $(\mu_Q/T)^2$ 中解析。在有限标量值处不存在规则的极值范围，并且 $\rho/s<\sqrt{21}/(2\pi)$ 准确地说。

极值极限是 AdS$_2\times\mathbb R^2$ 喉部，其中标量在 AdS$_2$ 径向坐标 $u$ 中按 $\ln\ln(1/u)$ 增长；边界在那里饱和，极值接近 $1/\ln(\mu_Q/T)$ 的幂。对于标量源上的狄利克雷条件，相同的解描述了尺度为$\Lambda$的非共形理论，其带电膜仅存在于$T_{\max}(\mu_Q)$以下，从零密度处的$0.194\Lambda$下降到$\mu_Q=0.506\Lambda$处的零。该边界是扩散不稳定性，其中电荷磁化率在非零密度下发散，并且体积粘度在所有密度下都违反布切尔界限。具有可归一化大半径条件的拟正规模式再现了其流体动力学。

title: Holographic theory of non-invertible gravitational anomalies
abstract: We review a many-body formulation of gravitational anomalies as obstructions to realizing the complete low-energy data by a local {\it bosonic} lattice quantum system of the same dimension. In this formulation, an anomalous theory can be realized at the boundary of a gapped {\it bosonic} lattice bulk, whose topological order gives a one-to-one classification of the anomaly. An invertible bulk reproduces conventional anomaly inflow; a bulk with non-trivial topological excitations yields a non-invertible generalization. To describe the holographic theory of anomalies, we explain the distinction between uniquely defined topological order and many versions of topological quantum field theory and discuss the boundary-to-bulk map. As an application of the holographic theory of anomalies, we describe morphisms between local quantum theories (such as quantum field theories). These morphisms are built from a bulk domain wall and an invertible boundary junction, which give rise to a sandwich picture. Chiral boson/fermion theory, Laughlin edges, and boundaries of $\mathbb{Z}_2$ higher gauge theory with bosonic or fermionic point-like excitations illustrate the different kinds of information about non-invertible anomalies contained in transport coefficients, superselection sectors, and condensation data. In particular, a fermionic theory can be viewed as a theory with a particular non-invertible gravitational anomaly. Those examples also reveal that {\it symmetry $\sim$ gravitational anomaly $\sim$ topological order in one higher dimension}.
summary:
我们回顾了引力异常的多体公式，作为通过相同维度的局部玻色子晶格量子系统实现完整低能数据的障碍。在这个公式中，异常理论可以在有间隙的玻色子晶格体的边界处实现，其拓扑顺序给出了异常的一对一分类。可逆的体积再现了传统的异常流入；大量具有非平凡拓扑激发的体产生不可逆的概括。为了描述异常的全息理论，我们解释了唯一定义的拓扑序与拓扑量子场论的许多版本之间的区别，并讨论了边界到体图。作为异常全息理论的应用，我们描述局域量子理论（例如量子场论）之间的态射。这些态射是由块域壁和可逆边界连接构建的，从而产生了三明治图片。

手性玻色子/费米子理论、劳克林边和带有玻色子或费米子点状激励的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 高规范理论的边界说明了输运系数、超选择扇区和凝结数据中包含的不可逆异常的不同类型的信息。特别地，费米子理论可以被视为具有特定的不可逆重力异常的理论。这些例子还揭示了{\it 对称性 $\sim$ 引力异常 $\sim$ 在更高维度上的拓扑顺序}。

title: Rank polarization and dynamical autonomy in a projective rotor model
abstract: We study how a higher-rank classical collective order parameter can select one dominant projective eigenline and, in a $p=2$ realization, support a dynamically autonomous low-energy director sector. In a fully connected projective-rotor model, the collective second moment is a positive semidefinite tensor $T$ of fixed trace. Conventional projective ordering drives its effective rank toward one, selecting a single dominant eigenline. Rank polarization alone, however, does not determine dynamical autonomy: extrinsic-curvature criteria depend on the chosen state-space metric, and the equilibrium tensor does not determine the transverse free-energy Hessian. A two-harmonic model makes this logical independence explicit by producing families with identical $T$ and $r_{\rm eff}$ but different transverse quadratic forms. We then construct rotationally invariant locking interactions that leave a prescribed ordered tensor exactly fixed while increasing every non-Goldstone restoring coefficient as $\Theta(\lambda)$ within a globally controlled stable regime. For a phenomenological inertial realization with a finite positive kinetic matrix, the lowest transverse normal-mode frequency grows as $\Theta(\lambda^{1/2})$; more generally, the low-frequency transverse susceptibility is suppressed as $O(\lambda^{-1})$, including in overdamped dynamics. The construction therefore proves that spectral selection and infrared transverse suppression are independent data. For $p>2$ the selected eigenline has a $(p-1)$-dimensional director manifold; the one-dimensional Goldstone sector used in the dynamical construction is specific to $p=2$. Promoting the selected internal eigenline to a physical clock requires additional soldering and integrability structure.
summary:
我们研究更高阶的经典集体序参数如何选择一个主导射影本征线，并在 $p=2$ 实现中支持动态自主的低能量导向扇区。在全连接射影转子模型中，集体二阶矩是固定迹的正半定张量 $T$。传统的投影排序将其有效排名推向 1，选择单个主导特征线。然而，单独的等级极化并不能确定动力学自主性：外在曲率标准取决于所选的状态空间度量，并且平衡张量不能确定横向自由能 Hessian 矩阵。双谐波模型通过产生具有相同 $T$ 和 $r_{\rm eff}$ 但横向二次形式不同的族，使这种逻辑独立性变得明确。然后，我们构造旋转不变的锁定相互作用，使规定的有序张量完全固定，同时在全局控制的稳定状态下将每个非戈德斯通恢复系数增加为 $\Theta(\lambda)$。

对于具有有限正运动矩阵的唯象惯性实现，最低横向简正模频率增长为 $\Theta(\lambda^{1/2})$；更一般地，低频横向磁化率被抑制为 $O(\lambda^{-1})$，包括在过阻尼动力学中。因此，该结构证明光谱选择和红外横向抑制是独立的数据。对于 $p>2$，所选特征线具有 $(p-1)$ 维导向流形；动态构造中使用的一维 Goldstone 扇区特定于 $p=2$。将选定的内部特征线提升为物理时钟需要额外的焊接和可集成结构。

title: Phase transitions and quasinormal modes of Euler-Heisenberg-dilaton AdS black holes
abstract: In this paper, we study phase transitions and scalar quasinormal modes(QNMs) of magnetically charged Euler--Heisenberg-dilaton AdS black holes in the extended phase space. We classify the horizon structures for all three signs of the EH coupling and derive the extended first law when the pressure and coupling are varied. For negative coupling, the physical branch exhibits a Van der Waals-like small/large black-hole transition. Using the improved asymptotic iteration method, we find two separated QNM trajectories below the critical pressure, whereas they merge into one continuous curve at the critical point. The GHS limit and the positive couplings considered here do not produce a finite-radius critical point.
summary: 在本文中，我们研究了扩展相空间中带磁欧拉-海森堡膨胀AdS黑洞的相变和标量准正规模（QNM）。我们对 EH 耦合的所有三个符号的层位结构进行分类，并推导出压力和耦合变化时的扩展第一定律。对于负耦合，物理分支表现出类似范德华的小/大黑洞转变。使用改进的渐近迭代方法，我们发现在临界压力以下两条分离的 QNM 轨迹，而它们在临界点处合并成一条连续曲线。这里考虑的 GHS 限制和正耦合不会产生有限半径临界点。

title: Aspects of $\mathcal{N}=2$ SUSY gauge theories and applications to Quantum Field Theory and Gravity
abstract: This thesis investigates the application of techniques developed in supersymmetric gauge theories to physical problems in Quantum Field Theory and Gravity, focusing on the Seiberg-Witten (SW) curve and its quantum version. After reviewing the essential concepts of Supersymmetry and the derivation of the SW curve, we explore its applications in both fields. In Quantum Field Theory, we investigate the emergence of Argyres-Douglas theories in the moduli space of supersymmetric models, focusing on extremal correlators. We analyze a conformal model to compute their instanton corrections, finding agreement with predictions from Effective Field Theory, and discuss the implications for analogous observables in Argyres-Douglas theories. In Gravity, we exploit the quantum SW curve and its relation to differential equations describing physical systems. We establish the linear stability of Topological Stars, arising in the fuzzball proposal, under massive charged scalar perturbations. We also investigate charge superradiance in configurations with a horizon and derive a novel hypergeometric representation of the confluent Heun function, relevant to gravitational-wave propagation in the Schwarzschild background. This result yields a new resummed expression for waveform tail contributions, in excellent agreement with numerical data. Finally, beyond the SW formalism, we develop a Machine Learning algorithm based on Hamiltonian Neural Networks to reproduce the geodesics of a neutral particle in a fuzzball geometry. For critical trajectories, our method outperforms standard numerical integrators in both efficiency and accuracy.
summary:
本论文研究了超对称规范理论开发的技术在量子场论和引力物理问题中的应用，重点关注塞伯格-维滕（SW）曲线及其量子版本。在回顾了超对称性的基本概念和 SW 曲线的推导之后，我们探讨了它在这两个领域的应用。在量子场论中，我们研究了超对称模型模空间中阿盖尔-道格拉斯理论的出现，重点关注极值相关器。我们分析了一个共形模型来计算它们的瞬子校正，发现与有效场论的预测一致，并讨论了阿吉尔斯-道格拉斯理论中类似可观测值的含义。在《引力》中，我们利用了量子 SW 曲线及其与描述物理系统的微分方程的关系。我们建立了模糊球提议中在大规模带电标量扰动下出现的拓扑星的线性稳定性。

我们还研究了视界构型中的电荷超辐射，并推导了合流 Heun 函数的一种新颖的超几何表示，与史瓦西背景中的引力波传播相关。该结果产生了波形尾部贡献的新恢复表达式，与数值数据非常一致。最后，除了 SW 形式主义之外，我们还开发了一种基于哈密顿神经网络的机器学习算法，以重现模糊球几何中中性粒子的测地线。对于关键轨迹，我们的方法在效率和准确性方面都优于标准数值积分器。

title: New topological phase transitions in $κ$-deformed $ϕ^4$ lattice models
abstract: This paper explores topological phase transitions in the momentum space of the $\kappa$-deformed $\phi^4$ lattice model within the mean-field approximation. We show that the double-well structure of the momentum space gives rise to degenerate momentum states at high energies and that this change is marked by a phase transition. We investigate this transition using both numerical and analytical methods, with the analytical approach based primarily on singularity theory. Our numerical analysis shows that the energy at which the topological phase transition occurs is related to the noncommutative parameter by the simple power law $E \sim 1/\alpha^{4}$. By mapping the constant-energy-level surface to the $A_{3}$ singularity, we obtain the same result analytically. We also present results unique to noncommutative systems, showing that the fraction of particles in degenerate momentum states has a nonzero commutative limit. As a nonperturbative effect, this result provides a testable prediction for the existence of noncommutative spacetime.
summary: 本文探讨了平均场近似内 $\kappa$ 变形 $\phi^4$ 晶格模型动量空间中的拓扑相变。我们表明，动量空间的双阱结构会在高能量下产生简并动量态，并且这种变化以相变为标志。我们使用数值和分析方法研究这种转变，分析方法主要基于奇点理论。我们的数值分析表明，拓扑相变发生的能量通过简单的幂律 $E \sim 1/\alpha^{4}$ 与非交换参数相关。通过将恒定能级表面映射到$A_{3}$奇点，我们得到了相同的分析结果。我们还提出了非交换系统特有的结果，表明处于简并动量态的粒子比例具有非零交换极限。作为非微扰效应，该结果为非交换时空的存在提供了可检验的预测。

title: Higher Dressing and Shift-Invariance in 4D Topological BF Theory
abstract: A characteristic feature of topological field theories is the absence of local propagating degrees of freedom. In four-dimensional BF theory with cosmological term, we make this feature manifest by exactly reducing the finite non-Abelian shift symmetry. We do so by identifying a higher dressing field, a 1-form compensating the shift, allowing to build from first principles the composite shift-invariant field $\boldsymbol{B}=B-\lambda^{-1}F$. In terms of this dressed field, the dynamics becomes algebraic and sets $\boldsymbol{B}=0$, directly exposing the absence of local propagating degrees of freedom. This provides the first explicit instance of the higher-form Dressing Field Method.
summary: 拓扑场论的一个特征是缺乏局部传播自由度。在带有宇宙项的四维BF理论中，我们通过精确约化有限非阿贝尔移位对称性来体现这一特征。我们通过识别更高的修整场（1-形式补偿移位）来实现这一点，从而允许从第一原理构建复合移位不变场 $\boldsymbol{B}=B-\lambda^{-1}F$。就这个修饰场而言，动力学变得代数并设置 $\boldsymbol{B}=0$，直接暴露了局部传播自由度的缺失。这提供了更高级形式的 Dressing Field Method 的第一个显式实例。

title: Area metric gravity à la Plebanski: connection, curvature and dynamics
abstract: Area metrics arise as effective description at intermediate scales in a number of approaches to quantum gravity, including string theory, holography and loop quantum gravity. Recently, it has been shown that area metric actions can be derived from the modified Plebanski framework on the linearized level. Surprisingly these actions avoid extra poles in the propagator for the effective length dynamics, and hence constitute interesting deformations of linearized Einstein gravity. To be able to study whether this property persist for the full theory, we construct here non-linear area metric dynamics from modified Plebanski actions. We provide the geometric tools for area metrics that do not rely on perturbation theory and allow a systematic construction and study of general non-linear area metric actions: an algorithm that extracts a length metric from an area metric and a connection on two-forms that is uniquely determined by the area metric, together with its curvature and curvature invariants. We derive area metric actions from modified Plebanski actions in first and second order versions. We also find that area metric actions can be reformulated as Poincare gauge theories. We determine the effective length metric action, which on a flat background describes a graviton and a massive spin-two field with parity-violating couplings set by the Barbero--Immirzi parameter. Additionally we discuss cosmological backgrounds and the role of the matter coupling, which together open the way to cosmological applications.
summary:
面积度量是许多量子引力方法（包括弦理论、全息术和圈量子引力）中中间尺度的有效描述。最近，研究表明面积度量作用可以从线性化水平上改进的 Plebanski 框架中导出。令人惊讶的是，这些行为避免了传播器中有效长度动力学的额外极点，因此构成了线性爱因斯坦引力的有趣变形。为了能够研究这个性质是否在整个理论中持续存在，我们在这里根据修改后的普莱班斯基动作构建了非线性面积度量动力学。我们提供了不依赖于摄动理论的面积度量几何工具，并允许系统地构建和研究一般非线性面积度量行为：一种从面积度量中提取长度度量的算法，以及由面积度量及其曲率和曲率不变量唯一确定的两种形式上的连接。我们从一阶和二阶版本中修改后的 Plebanski 动作导出面积度量动作。我们还发现面积度量作用可以重新表述为庞加莱规范理论。

我们确定了有效长度度量作用，它在平坦的背景上描述了引力子和具有由 Barbero-Immirzi 参数设置的宇称破坏耦合的巨大自旋二场。此外，我们还讨论了宇宙学背景和物质耦合的作用，它们共同为宇宙学应用开辟了道路。

title: From Lyapunov Growth to Weak Quantum Chaos
