abstract: Local out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) measure the growth of initially small commutators. For bounded local operators, this growth ends when the local commutator becomes of order one, but in an extended system the region over which it is large can continue to expand. We study this spatial proliferation using three related observables: the local squared commutator $C_r(t)$, its spatial sum $\bar C(t) = \sum_r C_r(t)$, and the symmetrically regularised connected dOTOC $D(t)$ of two extensive observables. We show that Lieb--Robinson locality gives $\bar C(t) \lesssim t^d$. We then prove that, in a Gibbs state with uniform exponential clustering, the full dOTOC obeys the same bound, $D(t) \lesssim t^d$, improving our earlier suboptimal $t^{3d}$ bound. We illustrate these results in two quantum many-body systems: a Brownian coupled-cluster model and a finite-temperature SYK chain. In both cases, an exact disorder symmetry relates $D(t)$ to $\bar C(t)$ and allows us to follow the same extensive observable from the pre-scrambling Lyapunov regime into the post-scrambling growth associated with an expanding saturated region. This late-time power-law growth is the concrete realisation of the weak quantum chaos introduced in our earlier work.
summary:
局部乱序相关器 (OTOC) 测量最初较小的换向器的增长。对于有界本地算子，当本地换向器变为一阶时，这种增长就会结束，但在扩展系统中，其较大的区域可以继续扩展。我们使用三个相关的可观测量来研究这种空间扩散：局部平方换向器 $C_r(t)$、其空间和 $\bar C(t) = \sum_r C_r(t)$ 以及两个广泛可观测量的对称正则连接 dOTOC $D(t)$。我们证明 Lieb--Robinson 局部性给出 $\bar C(t) \lesssim t^d$。然后我们证明，在具有均匀指数聚类的吉布斯状态下，完整的 dOTOC 遵循相同的界限 $D(t) \lesssim t^d$，从而改善了我们之前的次优 $t^{3d}$ 界限。我们在两个量子多体系统中说明了这些结果：布朗耦合簇模型和有限温度 SYK 链。在这两种情况下，精确的无序对称性将 $D(t)$ 与 $\bar C(t)$ 相关联，并允许我们从扰乱前的李雅普诺夫体系到与扩展饱和区域相关的扰乱后增长中遵循相同的广泛可观察结果。

这种晚期幂律增长是我们早期工作中引入的弱量子混沌的具体实现。

title: Microscopic entropy of regular BTZ black holes in 3d Lovelock gravity at all orders
abstract: We give a microscopic derivation of the semi-classical entropy of the black holes of 3d Lovelock gravity with an infinite tower of regularized Lovelock corrections, which include the regular BTZ black holes found recently. Working in the mini-superspace formalism, we show that the reduced action and its boundary term can be obtained in closed form at all orders in terms of the generating function of the couplings. Assuming the ground state is described by the soliton obtained from the static black hole by a double Wick rotation, we compute the soliton mass and reproduce the semi-classical entropy from the Cardy formula without central charges for arbitrary couplings. We then extend the mini-superspace to stationary configurations, compute the mass and the angular momentum of the rotating black holes obtained by a boost, and verify the Cardy formula in the presence of rotation.
summary: 我们给出了 3d Lovelock 引力黑洞的半经典熵的微观推导，以及无限的正则化 Lovelock 修正塔，其中包括最近发现的规则 BTZ 黑洞。在微型超空间形式主义中，我们表明，根据耦合的生成函数，可以在所有阶上以封闭形式获得约化作用及其边界项。假设基态是由通过双威克旋转从静态黑洞获得的孤子来描述的，我们计算孤子质量并从卡迪公式再现半经典熵，而无需任意耦合的中心电荷。然后，我们将迷你超空间扩展到静止配置，计算通过增强获得的旋转黑洞的质量和角动量，并在旋转存在的情况下验证卡迪公式。

title: Random wave chaos on momentum-fractionated microstate geometries
abstract: We study the role of momentum fractionation in the development of chaos on smooth 3-charge supergravity solutions of D1-D5 theory, specifically momentum-fractionated superstrata. We probe the chaos through the dynamics of null geodesics and waves. On fractionated backgrounds, both geodesics and waves show uniformly strong chaos (large chaotic sea and near-perfect agreement with the Berry random wave hypothesis). In contrast, geodesics and waves on single-mode (non-fractionated) superstrata are closer to separability (although still chaotic). We discuss a possibility that such dichotomy can be related to the expectation that monotone BPS states are less chaotic than fortuitous ones. Finally, we explain why our chaos probes are meaningful for microstate geometries even though they become trivial in the black hole limit.
summary: 我们研究了动量分馏在 D1-D5 理论的光滑 3 电荷超重力解（特别是动量分馏上层）的混沌发展中的作用。我们通过零测地线和波浪的动力学来探索混沌。在分割背景上，测地线和波浪都表现出一致的强混沌（大混乱的海洋和与贝里随机波假说近乎完美的一致）。相比之下，单模（非分割）上地层上的测地线和波更接近可分离性（尽管仍然是混沌的）。我们讨论了一种可能性，即这种二分法可能与单调 BPS 状态比偶然状态更混乱的期望有关。最后，我们解释了为什么我们的混沌探测器对微观状态几何有意义，尽管它们在黑洞极限中变得微不足道。

title: Symmetric Dual Breather Modes as a Dynamic Origin of Tiny Particle Masses
abstract: Spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) is conventionally understood through static vacuum selection in low-energy approximations. However, the nonperturbative dynamical pathways connecting symmetric configurations to asymmetric states remain an open question. In this paper, we propose an operator-theoretic framework that characterizes $Z_{2}$ symmetry breaking in scalar field theory through spectral branching. Specifically, we identify an effective invariant manifold of the nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation termed the "symmetric dual breather mode," whose phase-space geometry is traced using a $t$-dependent finite-dimensional representation. Our analysis demonstrates that static SSB represents merely a small-amplitude limit ($A \ll \phi_{v1}$). As the amplitude increases into the heteroclinic regime ($A > \phi_{v1}$), the field dynamically overflows the central barrier, yielding a vanishing time-averaged order parameter ($\langle \phi \rangle = 0$) and driving a geometric curvature cancellation ($\langle V''(\phi) \rangle_{t} \to 0$). Governed by a universal scaling function $\mathfrak{F}(y)$, the logarithmic period divergence near the heteroclinic boundary naturally generates sub-eV effective mass scales without fine-tuning bare parameters. Furthermore, this dynamic barrier overflow naturally favors Majorana-like self-conjugate states over Dirac-type states. Additionally, nonlinear phase interference along the heteroclinic channel induces asymmetric phase-space contraction, decoupling the right-handed mode and dynamically giving rise to the left-handed Weyl equation. These results bridge nonperturbative wave dynamics, topological mass suppression, chiral selection, and the dynamic origin of active neutrino masses.
summary:
自发对称破缺（SSB）通常是通过低能近似中的静态真空选择来理解的。然而，连接对称构型和不对称状态的非微扰动力学路径仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一个算子理论框架，该框架通过谱分支来表征标量场论中的 $Z_{2}$ 对称性破缺。具体来说，我们确定了非线性 Klein-Gordon 方程的有效不变流形，称为“对称双呼吸模式”，其相空间几何形状是使用依赖于 $t$ 的有限维表示来追踪的。我们的分析表明，静态 SSB 仅代表小幅度限制 ($A \ll \phi_{v1}$)。随着振幅增加到异宿状态 ($A > \phi_{v1}$)，场动态地溢出中心势垒，产生消失的时间平均序参数 ($\langle \phi \rangle = 0$) 并驱动几何曲率抵消 ($\langle V''(\phi) \rangle_{t} \to 0$)。

在通用标度函数 $\mathfrak{F}(y)$ 的控制下，异宿边界附近的对数周期发散自然地生成亚 eV 有效质量尺度，而无需微调裸参数。此外，这种动态势垒溢出自然有利于类马约拉纳自共轭态而不是狄拉克型态。此外，沿异宿通道的非线性相位干扰会引起不对称相空间收缩，解耦右手模式并动态产生左手Weyl方程。这些结果将非微扰波动力学、拓扑质量抑制、手性选择和活跃中微子质量的动态起源联系起来。

title: Relativistic Covariance from Hamiltonian Hydrodynamics in the Chiral Limit
abstract: We derive the covariant equations of nondissipative chiral hydrodynamics from their equal-time Hamiltonian formulation and identify the Lie--Poisson structure implicit in the chiral brackets. This structure combines fluid motion with local chiral transformations. For a parity-invariant Hamiltonian quadratic in chiral charge densities and pion gradients, without external backgrounds, we derive and solve the constraints imposed by Lorentz boosts. Their coupled nonlinear sector is equivalent to the linear boost transformation laws of a symmetric tensor, which determine the velocity dependence from rest-frame data. For finite, positive rest-frame coefficients, finite ordinary-fluid energy density and thermodynamic derivatives, and a momentum--velocity relation that can be solved in either direction, the chiral Hamiltonian coefficients remain finite at every fluid speed below light speed if and only if the rest-frame pion propagation speed does not exceed the speed of light. This formulation makes symmetry constraints explicit and provides a starting point for future thermodynamically consistent dissipative extensions.
summary: 我们从等时哈密顿公式推导了非耗散手性流体动力学的协变方程，并确定了隐含在手性括号中的李-泊松结构。这种结构将流体运动与局部手性变换相结合。对于手性电荷密度和π介子梯度中的宇称不变哈密顿二次方程，在没有外部背景的情况下，我们推导并解决了洛伦兹增强所施加的约束。它们耦合的非线性部分相当于对称张量的线性升压变换定律，它确定了静止帧数据的速度依赖性。对于有限的正静止框架系数、有限的普通流体能量密度和热力学导数，以及可以在任一方向求解的动量-速度关系，当且仅当静止框架π介子传播速度不超过光速时，手性哈密顿系数在低于光速的每个流体速度下保持有限。该公式使对称约束变得明确，并为未来热力学一致的耗散扩展提供了起点。

title: Retarded Green Function For Bopp--Podolsky Electrodynamics in Four-Dimensional De Sitter Spacetime
abstract: We study classical Bopp--Podolsky (BP) electrodynamics on four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, focusing on its transverse retarded Green function and gauge-invariant electromagnetic response. Because de Sitter spacetime is maximally symmetric, its vector Green functions admit a covariant expansion in a finite basis of invariant bitensors, with scalar coefficients depending only on the invariant separation. For conserved sources, the fourth-order field operator factorizes into Maxwell and massive-vector operators, yielding the BP retarded kernel as the difference of their transverse Green functions. Using the invariant bitensor decomposition, we reduce the propagator equations to a hypergeometric master equation and determine the distributional structure of its solution. The common leading short-distance singularity of the Maxwell and massive-vector sectors cancels, leaving a logarithmic master singularity and a softened vector-potential wavefront. After one curl, the gauge-invariant field-strength kernel contains a null-cone delta distribution and a regular timelike tail. The smooth Maxwell master tail is annihilated by the curl, so the interior electromagnetic tail is generated entirely by the massive sector. We also derive an exact horizon-regular static potential, demonstrate the cancellation of the Coulomb divergence, recover the flat-space BP potential, and formulate the generalized Gauss law. On global de Sitter spacetime, the compactness of the spatial sections requires the total charge to vanish; we implement this constraint using an antipodal charge configuration with smooth factorized initial data. The analysis is classical and does not assume a quantum Lee--Wick contour or a preferred de Sitter vacuum.
summary:
我们研究了四维德西特时空上的经典波普-波多尔斯基（BP）电动力学，重点关注其横向延迟格林函数和规范不变电磁响应。因为德西特时空是最大对称的，所以它的向量格林函数允许在不变双张量的有限基础上进行协变展开，标量系数仅取决于不变分离。对于守恒源，四阶场算子分解为麦克斯韦算子和大向量算子，产生 BP 延迟核作为它们横向格林函数的差。使用不变双张量分解，我们将传播方程简化为超几何主方程，并确定其解的分布结构。麦克斯韦和大矢量扇区的共同领先短距离奇点相互抵消，留下对数主奇点和软化的矢量势波前。一次卷曲后，规范不变的场强核包含零锥增量分布和规则的类时尾部。

光滑的麦克斯韦主尾被卷曲湮灭，因此内部电磁尾完全由大质量扇区产生。我们还推导了精确的水平正则静态势，证明了库仑散度的消除，恢复了平坦空间 BP 势，并制定了广义高斯定律。在全局德西特时空中，空间截面的紧凑性要求总电荷消失；我们使用具有平滑因式分解初始数据的对映电荷配置来实现此约束。该分析是经典的，并且不假设量子李-威克轮廓或优选的德西特真空。

title: A first order nonabelian antisymmetric tensor model with hidden higher symmetry
abstract: We present a nonabelian complex self-dual antisymmetric tensor model, with gauged internal symmetry, comprising a complex multiplet of massless self-dual antisymmetric tensor fields and its conjugate (interacting with massless Yang-Mills gauge fields). We build the model at the classical level, via a first order formulation, assigning local fields to a component expansion over the Dirac algebra and a basis of internal matrices, with Lorentz and gauge invariance ensured by tracing, and applying an appropriate bilinear form. The full expansion requires auxiliary place-holder fields, which are not potentials, but become curvatures (field strengths) after elimination via their algebraic equations of motion. The component expansion over the Dirac algebra is closed under multiplication by additional internal matrices, which are not gauge group generators, but mix internal components, and link auxiliary curvatures with potentials. The model is shown to be invariant under such transformations, and thus possesses a type of hidden internal symmetry. We analyze the specific case of gauge group $SU(2)\! \times \! U(1)$, and as higher symmetry candidates, we consider both the Lie group $SU(3)$ and the Lie superalgebra $SU(2/1)$ (with the additional matrices acting via Lie brackets, or graded Lie brackets, respectively).
summary:
我们提出了一种具有规范内部对称性的非阿贝尔复数自对偶反对称张量模型，包括复数多重无质量自对偶反对称张量场及其共轭（与无质量杨-米尔斯规范场相互作用）。我们通过一阶公式在经典层面构建模型，将局部场分配给狄拉克代数上的分量展开式和内部矩阵的基础，通过追踪确保洛伦兹和规范不变性，并应用适当的双线性形式。完全展开需要辅助占位场，这些场不是势，而是通过代数运动方程消除后变成曲率（场强）。狄拉克代数上的分量展开在乘以附加内部矩阵时闭合，这些矩阵不是规范群生成器，而是混合内部分量，并将辅助曲率与势联系起来。该模型在这种变换下被证明是不变的，因此具有一种隐藏的内部对称性。我们分析一下规范组$SU(2)\!的具体情况\次\！

U(1)$，作为更高对称性的候选者，我们考虑李群 $SU(3)$ 和李超代数 $SU(2/1)$ （附加矩阵分别通过李括号或分级李括号起作用）。

title: Regular-Zero Drinfeld-Sokolov Charges in Doubled Four-Dimensional Chern-Simons Theory
abstract: We study classical local conserved charges obtained after finite-defect reduction of doubled four-dimensional Chern--Simons theory. At a finite simple zero, the inhomogeneous derivative term in the affine gauge transformation induced by the twist function vanishes, so the residue evaluations of the two Gaudin currents transform by the ordinary adjoint action. For each simple ideal, we use the Evans-compatible invariant tensors of the principal Drinfeld--Sokolov hierarchy as external algebraic input, construct local circle integrals, and treat the same-zero, distinct-zero, and mixed sectors separately, proving pairwise Poisson commutativity. Under the explicit assumptions of Stedman's simple-pole/simple-zero boundary Hamiltonian, the periodic trivial-monodromy sector, and boundary weights independent of phase-space variables, the reduced Hamiltonian decomposes term by term into finite-pole, infinity, finite-zero, and residual first-class-constraint contributions, which yields conservation of the constructed charges. We distinguish the finite-defect reduced space, the extended space carrying the residual constraint, and the physical quotient. The result is a conditional existence statement for a classical local Abelian Poisson subalgebra; we make no claim of functional independence, maximality, or Liouville completeness. Extensions to higher-order zeros and nontrivial monodromy sectors are outside the scope of this work.
summary:
我们研究了双四维Chern-Simons理论有限缺陷约简后得到的经典局域守恒电荷。在有限简单零处，由扭曲函数引起的仿射规范变换中的非齐次导数项消失，因此两个高丁电流的剩余评估通过普通伴随作用进行变换。对于每个简单理想，我们使用主 Drinfeld-Sokolov 层次结构的埃文斯兼容不变张量作为外部代数输入，构造局部圆积分，并分别处理相同零、不同零和混合扇区，证明成对泊松交换律。在斯特德曼的简单极点/简单零边界哈密顿量、周期性平凡单性扇区和独立于相空间变量的边界权重的明确假设下，简化哈密顿量逐项分解为有限极点、无穷大、有限零和剩余一类约束贡献，从而产生所构造电荷的守恒。我们区分有限缺陷缩减空间、带有残差约束的扩展空间和物理商。

结果是经典局部阿贝尔泊松子代数的条件存在性陈述；我们不主张功能独立性、最大化或刘维尔完备性。高阶零和非平凡单峰扇区的扩展超出了本工作的范围。

title: A No-Go Theorem for Nonspherical Bounces with a Single Negative Mode
abstract: False vacuum decay is conventionally described by a spherically symmetric bounce with a single negative fluctuation mode. This raises a fundamental question: can the single negative mode requirement itself enforce spherical symmetry, independently of action minimization? For a single real scalar field with a smooth potential in flat spacetime, we rigorously prove that every localized nonspherical saddle with zero initial velocity has at least three negative modes. Additional reflection symmetries further tighten these bounds, as illustrated in a sextic scalar model. Our findings exclude nonspherical bounce candidates with a single negative mode, providing a complementary spectral foundation for the spherical bounce description of false vacuum decay.
summary: 假真空衰变通常用具有单一负涨落模式的球对称反弹来描述。这就提出了一个基本问题：单一负模式要求本身能否强制实现球对称，而与动作最小化无关？对于平坦时空中具有平滑势的单个实标量场，我们严格证明每个初速度为零的局域非球面鞍座至少具有三个负模态。额外的反射对称性进一步收紧了这些界限，如六次标量模型所示。我们的研究结果排除了具有单一负模式的非球形弹跳候选者，为假真空衰变的球形弹跳描述提供了补充的光谱基础。

title: About P-adic Numbers and Professor Igor Volovich on the Occasion of his 80th Anniversary
abstract: We recall a 1987 paper written by Volovich and our subsequent work with Okada which established the Feyman rules for the p-adic string and the related non-local field theory which found diverse physical applications. We add some memories of visits to Moscow during 1989-91.
summary: 我们回想起 Volovich 于 1987 年撰写的一篇论文以及我们随后与 Okada 的合作，该论文建立了 p 进弦的费曼规则以及相关的非局部场论，这些理论发现了多种物理应用。我们添加了 1989-91 年间访问莫斯科的一些回忆。

title: TheoPhysEval: Assessing AI agents at autonomous theoretical physics problem solving
abstract: We present a suite of 50 unpublished research-level theoretical physics problems with verifiable answers. Without AI assistance, a typical problem in our collection could be solved by a world expert in about a day or less but would take considerably longer for experts in adjacent specialties. We test the ability of off-the-shelf AI agents to tackle these problems autonomously, without human hints. When given access to tools available in a realistic setting, including the ability to search the literature and write scripts for numerical and symbolic work, the best-performing agent, GPT-6-Astra harnessed in Codex, obtains the final answers with a near-perfect accuracy of 98% at an average cost under USD 3 per problem. On average, agents show only small changes in accuracy when denied web search and access to background research papers, suggesting significant memorization of the literature. These results suggest that state-of-the-art agents can accurately perform concrete calculations required across theoretical physics research. We comment on the broader implications of these findings and discuss possible explanations for the current lack of agent-led breakthroughs in theoretical physics despite their outstanding problem-solving abilities.
summary:
我们提出了一套 50 个未发表的研究级理论物理问题以及可验证的答案。如果没有人工智能的帮助，我们收集的一个典型问题可以由世界专家在大约一天或更短的时间内解决，但对于相邻专业的专家来说则需要更长的时间。我们测试现成的人工智能代理在没有人类提示的情况下自主解决这些问题的能力。当能够访问现实环境中可用的工具时，包括搜索文献以及为数字和符号工作编写脚本的能力，Codex 中使用的表现最佳的代理 GPT-6-Astra 能够以每问题 3 美元以下的平均成本获得接近完美准确度 98% 的最终答案。平均而言，当拒绝进行网络搜索和访问背景研究论文时，代理人的准确性仅表现出很小的变化，这表明他们对文献的记忆很重要。这些结果表明，最先进的智能体可以准确地执行理论物理研究所需的具体计算。

我们评论了这些发现的更广泛的影响，并讨论了尽管代理具有出色的解决问题能力，但目前在理论物理方面缺乏代理主导的突破的可能解释。

title: Out-of-time-order hydrodynamics and scrambling
abstract: Hydrodynamics as an effective field theory (EFT) has been immensely successful for predicting the behaviour of time-ordered correlation functions in the long-time, large-distance regime. In this paper, we analyse the predictions of hydrodynamics for scrambling as probed by out-of-time order correlators (OTOCs). To do so, we consider an all-derivative order generalisation of the Schwinger-Keldysh EFT of hydrodynamics extended to a four-fold time contour required to capture OTOCs. A crucial ingredient of the construction is a local SL(2,R) symmetry, which has previously been suggested as a mechanism for scrambling. We also derive this exact EFT from the microscopic formulation of the maximally chaotic low-temperature limit of the SYK lattice, thereby determining all transport coefficients for this model. As a novel application, we compute the OTOC of energy currents, find that its exponential growth saturates the chaos bound, and match it to expectations based on a shockwave (or scramblon) effective description. Our work shows that the universality of hydrodynamics degrees of freedom extends beyond traditional time-ordered correlators to more complex observables such as OTOCs.
summary: 流体动力学作为一种有效场论 (EFT) 在预测长时间、大距离状态下的时间有序相关函数的行为方面取得了巨大成功。在本文中，我们分析了超时序相关器 (OTOC) 探测的扰乱流体动力学预测。为此，我们考虑将流体动力学的 Schwinger-Keldysh EFT 的全导数阶推广扩展到捕获 OTOC 所需的四倍时间轮廓。该结构的一个重要组成部分是局部 SL(2,R) 对称性，此前曾被建议将其作为置乱机制。我们还从 SYK 晶格最大混沌低温极限的微观公式中推导出这个精确的 EFT，从而确定该模型的所有输运系数。作为一种新颖的应用，我们计算了能量流的 OTOC，发现其指数增长使混沌界限饱和，并将其与基于冲击波（或扰乱）有效描述的预期相匹配。我们的工作表明，流体动力学自由度的普遍性超出了传统的时间排序相关器，扩展到更复杂的可观测值，例如 OTOC。

title: Metric and dilaton information from high-overtone quasinormal modes of analytic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton black holes
abstract: Black-hole interiors are hidden from exterior observers, yet their geometry can enter the high-overtone spectrum of linear perturbations. We study how this spectrum encodes metric and supporting-matter information in analytic Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton black holes. Coupling a neutral spectator to the dilaton at fixed UV dimension provides a matter-sensitive channel alongside the momentum response. For real-endpoint spacelike connections, the momentum response and mass-label dependence separate the metric exponents from the signed dilaton slope. Near the causal threshold, a complex endpoint controls the spectral family: the mass profiles approach a common value, producing a shared fractional correction, while regular propagation retains label dependence. This mechanism is present at criticality without an inner horizon and continues locally into timelike interiors. Exterior numerical spectra support the reconstruction and the leading complex-endpoint responses. Local scaling and probe coupling set the candidate responses, while wave connection determines their imprint on the exterior spectrum.
summary: 黑洞内部对外部观察者来说是隐藏的，但它们的几何形状可以进入线性扰动的高泛音谱。我们研究这个谱如何编码解析爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-膨胀黑洞中的度量和支持物质信息。将中性观察者耦合到固定 UV 维度的膨胀子，可以在动量响应旁边提供物质敏感通道。对于实端点类空间连接，动量响应和质量标签依赖性将度量指数与带符号的膨胀斜率分开。在因果阈值附近，复杂的端点控制光谱族：质量分布接近公共值，产生共享的分数校正，而常规传播保留标签依赖性。这种机制在没有内部地平线的情况下处于临界状态，并在局部延续到类似时间的内部。外部数值谱支持重建和主要复杂端点响应。局部缩放和探头耦合设置候选响应，而波连接决定它们在外部光谱上的印记。

title: Modular Flow and Holographic Timelike Entanglement Entropy in AdS and Flat Holography
abstract: Timelike entanglement entropy provides a useful probe of holographic theoris, yet an explicit bulk realization of the modular flow underlying its timelike extremal curve construction has so far been lacking. We construct modular flows associated with spacelike and timelike intervals in AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ and extend this framework to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$. Beginning with the boundary symmetry generators, we explicitly derive the boundary modular flows and extend them into the bulk, providing a systematic procedure that relates bulk modular flows to the extremal curves and holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. For spacelike intervals, the resulting bulk modular flows determine the extremal curves, whose integrated line elements reproduce the standard holographic entanglement entropy. We then generalize this approach to timelike intervals, explicitly constructing the modular flows whose fixed points reproduce the extremal spacelike and timelike curves which gives the holographic timelike entanglement entropy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction of the modular flow associated with a timelike extremal curve for a timelike interval. The same procedure is then carried over to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$, which give rise to the holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. Finally, we show that the flat space results obtained in this work can be recovered from their AdS$_3$ counterparts in the flat space limit.
summary:
类时纠缠熵为全息理论提供了有用的探索，但迄今为止，仍缺乏对其类时极值曲线构造背后的模流的明确批量实现。我们在 AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ 中构建与类空间和类时间间隔相关的模块化流，并将该框架扩展到 flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$。从边界对称生成器开始，我们明确地导出边界模流并将其扩展到体中，提供了将体模流与极值曲线和全息（类时）纠缠熵相关联的系统程序。对于类空间间隔，所得的块模流确定极值曲线，其积分线元素再现标准全息纠缠熵。然后，我们将这种方法推广到类时间隔，显式地构造模流，其不动点再现极值类空和类时曲线，从而给出全息类时纠缠熵。据我们所知，这是与类时间隔的类时极值曲线相关的模块化流的第一个显式构造。

然后将相同的过程转移到 flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$，从而产生全息（类时）纠缠熵。最后，我们表明，在这项工作中获得的平坦空间结果可以从平坦空间限制中的 AdS$_3$ 对应项中恢复。

title: On the analytic continuation and asymptotic behaviour of the two-point function in massless $ϕ^4$-theory in Euclidean de Sitter space
abstract: For the two-point function of the massless, minimally-coupled, real scalar field in Euclidean de Sitter space with $\lambda\phi^4$-interaction, we compute the leading-logarithmic terms in the invariant distance of the two-point function to $O(\lambda^2)$, which counts as the fifth subleading order (N$^5$LO) in the $\sqrt{\lambda}$-expansion. We show that the analytic continuation to Lorentzian signature coincides with the expansion of the analogous quantity computed in the stochastic formalism. We determine the large-order behaviour of the stochastic series expansion and prove its Borel summability, which suggests that the Euclidean theory can be used to extract the late-time behaviour of massless correlation functions in Lorentzian de Sitter space.
summary: 对于具有 $\lambda\phi^4$ 相互作用的欧几里德德西特空间中无质量、最小耦合、实标量场的两点函数，我们计算两点函数到 $O(\lambda^2)$ 的不变距离中的前导对数项，这算作 $\sqrt{\lambda}$ 展开中的第五次前导阶 (N$^5$LO)。我们证明了洛伦兹签名的解析延拓与随机形式主义中计算的类似量的展开相一致。我们确定了随机级数展开的大阶行为并证明了其 Borel 可求和性，这表明欧几里得理论可以用来提取洛伦兹德西特空间中无质量相关函数的后期行为。

title: New analytic Janus and $S^4$ solutions for $\mathcal{N}=2^*$
abstract: We construct a three-parameter family of regular analytic supergravity solutions which are dual to (a) the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ gauge theory on the four-sphere, and (b) $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$-invariant Janus interfaces in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with or without the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ mass turned on. To this end we employ a five-dimensional supergravity model coupled to six scalars which arises as a certain consistent truncation of type IIB supergravity on $S^5$. The curved domain wall solutions feature a hidden integral of motion which allows for their analytic treatment. We relate the three parameters of the solution to field theory sources and vevs and show how regularity of the solutions restricts their range. We briefly discuss the holographic evaluation of the one-point function of the field theory Lagrangian for our family of Janus solutions.
summary: 我们构造了一个三参数族的常规解析超重力解，它与 (a) 四球体上的 $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ 规范理论和 (b) $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 中的 $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$ 不变 Janus 接口（无论是否打开 $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ 质量）对偶。为此，我们采用与六个标量耦合的五维超重力模型，该模型作为 IIB 型超重力在 $S^5$ 上的某种一致截断而出现。弯曲畴壁解决方案具有隐藏的运动积分，可以进行分析处理。我们将解的三个参数与场论源和向量联系起来，并展示解的规律性如何限制它们的范围。我们简要讨论了我们的 Janus 解族的场论拉格朗日单点函数的全息评估。

title: Holographic Pseudo Entropy from the Rindler Method in AdS and Flat Space
abstract: Via the Rindler method, we study holographic timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) for a general timelike interval in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$. The TEE is the pseudo entropy of a timelike interval. In the bulk, the imaginary part of the TEE comes from a timelike geodesic, but in the Rindler picture this geodesic has not been identified. After a Rindler transformation to a rotating BTZ black hole, the two spacelike extremal curves lie on the inner and outer horizons, and exchanging $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_\phi$ takes one to the other. We find the geometric meaning of the timelike extremal curve: a geodesic stretched between the two horizons. Its length, $i\pi\ell$, is independent of the interval, and it alone produces the imaginary part $i\pi c/6$. We follow the same procedure in flat space holography, where the spacelike curve sits on the cosmological horizon and the timelike curve lies between the cosmological horizon and timelike infinity. Evaluating the holographic TEE for a timelike interval in CCFT$_2$ on the plane, we find that, in contrast with the cylinder, the real and imaginary parts are equal.
summary: 通过 Rindler 方法，我们研究了 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 和 flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$ 中一般类时区间的全息类时纠缠熵 (TEE)。 TEE 是类时间隔的伪熵。总体而言，TEE 的虚部来自类时测地线，但在 Rindler 图片中尚未识别出该测地线。在对旋转 BTZ 黑洞进行 Rindler 变换后，两条类空间极值曲线位于内部和外部视界上，并且交换 $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_\phi$ 将一个变为另一个。我们找到了类时极值曲线的几何意义：在两个地平线之间延伸的测地线。它的长度 $i\pi\ell$ 与间隔无关，并且它单独产生虚部 $i\pi c/6$。我们在平面空间全息术中遵循相同的过程，其中类空曲线位于宇宙视界上，类时曲线位于宇宙视界和类时无穷之间。评估平面上CCFT$_2$中的类时区间的全息TEE，我们发现，与圆柱体相比，实部和虚部是相等的。

title: Love at First Loop: Quantum Deformability of Near-Extremal Black Holes
abstract: The static Love numbers of black holes vanish in classical, four-dimensional, asymptotically flat General Relativity. We study how this changes for the response of near-extremal Reissner--Nordström black holes to a minimally coupled massless scalar, at energies where the Schwarzian mode of the near-horizon throat fluctuates strongly. The black hole then responds as a quantum system with a spectrum of states. Its static response is a polarizability, given by virtual transitions between them. For $\ell=0$ the static Love number vanishes, by the shift symmetry of the scalar, but for multipoles $\ell\geq1$ the static Love numbers are nonzero: the finite rotational energy of the spin-$\ell$ intermediate states spoils the cancellation responsible for the classical result. Since the throat no longer has a classical geometry from which to read off a tidal response, we define it through the retarded Green's function, and compute its full frequency dependence at leading order in $r_+\omega$. Its conservative part requires renormalization: the near-horizon theory fixes the coefficient of its logarithm, and with it a dependence on the energy that no local term can remove, while its finite local terms are matching data of the four-dimensional theory. The dissipative part is finite and scheme independent. For $\ell\geq1$, it vanishes at low frequencies when the energy is below the rotational gap, while at the gap threshold it becomes non-analytic in frequency and produces a late-time $t^{-3/2}$ tail.
summary:
黑洞的静态洛夫数在经典的、四维的、渐近平坦的广义相对论中消失了。我们研究了在近地平线喉部施瓦茨模式强烈波动的能量下，近极值赖斯纳-诺德斯特伦黑洞对最小耦合无质量标量的响应如何变化。然后黑洞作为具有状态谱的量子系统做出响应。它的静态响应是极化率，由它们之间的虚拟过渡给出。对于$\ell=0$，静态洛夫数因标量的移位对称性而消失，但对于多极子$\ell\geq1$，静态洛夫数不为零：自旋$\ell$中间态的有限旋转能量破坏了导致经典结果的抵消。由于喉部不再具有用于读取潮汐响应的经典几何结构，因此我们通过延迟格林函数来定义它，并在 $r_+\omega$ 中计算其前导阶的完整频率依赖性。

它的保守部分需要重整化：近视界理论固定了它的对数系数，并且依赖于任何局部项都无法消除的能量，而它的有限局部项是四维理论的匹配数据。耗散部分是有限的并且与方案无关。对于$\ell\geq1$，当能量低于旋转间隙时，它在低频下消失，而在间隙阈值处，它在频率上变得非解析并产生后期$t^{-3/2}$尾部。

title: Gauge-Invariant Brout--Englert--Higgs Mechanism without Spontaneous Breaking of Local Gauge Symmetry: A Quantum-Reference-Frame Formulation
abstract: The Brout--Englert--Higgs (BEH) mechanism can be formulated in gauge-invariant relational terms without assigning physical spontaneous breaking to a local gauge redundancy. We treat the gauge orientation of the Higgs field as dynamical internal reference data and describe the gauge connection relative to this Higgs frame. On a regular patch where the frame exists, the Higgs kinetic term induces a positive-semidefinite mass-squared quadratic form on the gauge-orbit directions and reproduces the standard tree-level vector masses. A complete Higgs frame yields a gauge-invariant relational connection, whereas a partial frame is defined only up to a stabilizer group $H$ and produces Higgs stiffness only along the coset directions $G/H$. In quantum field theory the normalized frame and relational connection are nonpolynomial composite variables; physical masses are therefore characterized through suitably renormalized gauge-invariant composite correlators, or through fully dressed operators in residual-charged sectors. Applying this construction to the electroweak theory, we show that the Higgs frame relationalizes the $SU(2)_L$ redundancy while leaving a residual electromagnetic $U(1)_{\rm em}$ Gauss law: $W^\pm$ and charged fermionic modes require electromagnetic dressing, whereas neutral channels admit local gauge-invariant interpolators. This formulation connects Higgs dressings, FMS composites, and internal quantum-reference-frame language while keeping local mass generation distinct from global symmetry realization and topological obstructions.
summary:
布劳特-恩格勒特-希格斯（BEH）机制可以用规范不变的关系项来表述，而无需将物理自发断裂分配给局部规范冗余。我们将希格斯场的规范方向视为动态内部参考数据，并描述相对于该希格斯框架的规范连接。在存在框架的规则斑块上，希格斯动力学项在规范轨道方向上引入正半定质量平方二次形式，并再现标准树级矢量质量。完整的希格斯框架产生规范不变的关系连接，而部分框架仅定义为稳定组 $H$，并且仅沿陪集方向 $G/H$ 产生希格斯刚度。在量子场论中，归一化框架和关系连接是非多项式复合变量；因此，物理质量可以通过适当的重整化规格不变复合相关器或通过剩余电荷扇区中的全装操作员来表征。

将这种结构应用于电弱理论，我们表明希格斯框架将$SU(2)_L$冗余关联起来，同时留下残余电磁$U(1)_{\rm em}$高斯定律：$W^\pm$和带电费米子模式需要电磁修整，而中性通道允许局部规范不变插值器。该公式连接了希格斯敷料、FMS 复合材料和内部量子参考系语言，同时保持局部质量生成与全局对称实现和拓扑障碍不同。

title: Yang-Baxter deformed sigma models on $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$
abstract: We study Yang--Baxter deformations of two-dimensional sigma models on compact symmetric spaces $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$, with particular emphasis on their ultraviolet behavior. We claim that the ultraviolet fixed point is described by the $\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb C)/\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb R)$ non-compact WZW model together with $N-1$ compact free bosons. We determine the leading correction to this fixed point and identify it with the perturbation generated by the corresponding screening currents. We also extend our construction to the broader class of symmetric spaces of maximal rank.
summary: 我们研究紧致对称空间 $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$ 上二维 sigma 模型的 Yang--Baxter 变形，特别强调它们的紫外行为。我们声称紫外线不动点由 $\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb C)/\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb R)$ 非紧致 WZW 模型和 $N-1$ 紧致自由玻色子一起描述。我们确定该固定点的主导校正，并将其与相应屏蔽电流产生的扰动进行识别。我们还将我们的构造扩展到更广泛的最大等级对称空间。

title: Type I-II/II-I vortices from dimension-six self-interaction
abstract: We show that adding a dimension-six self-interaction to the Abelian-Higgs or Ginzburg Landau model results in a remarkable and rich structure of multi-vortex solutions. Besides the standard type I (attractive) and type II (repulsive) regimes, separated by the Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfeld limit (BPS), we identify two new possibilities: type I-II vortices, which attract at short distances and repel at long distances; and type II-I vortices, with the opposite behaviour. Specifically, within the type II-I regime, multi-vortex solutions form chunks of the Abrikosov lattice or clusters. Conversely, in the I-II regime, axially symmetric multi-vortices are stable; nevertheless, depending on the model parameters and topological charge (winding number), they can be either the ground state or not.
summary: 我们证明，在阿贝尔-希格斯或金兹堡朗道模型中添加六维自相互作用会产生显着且丰富的多涡解结构。除了由 Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfeld 极限 (BPS) 分隔的标准 I 型（吸引）和 II 型（排斥）状态之外，我们还确定了两种新的可能性：I-II 型涡流，在短距离处吸引，在长距离处排斥；和 II-I 型涡流，具有相反的行为。具体来说，在 II-I 型体系内，多涡流解形成阿布里科索夫晶格或簇的块。相反，在 I-II 体系中，轴对称多涡是稳定的；然而，根据模型参数和拓扑电荷（绕数），它们可以是基态，也可以不是。

title: Evading the Swampland de Sitter Obstruction via Thermodynamic Duality-Induced Horizon Corrections in Unimodular Gravity
abstract: We investigate the early-universe cosmological implications of Unimodular Gravity coupled to Power-Law Nonlinear Electrodynamics in the presence of quantum-corrected horizon thermodynamics derived from the principle of thermodynamic duality. By incorporating both logarithmic and inverse-area corrections to the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, we derive modified Friedmann equations exhibiting novel $H^4$ and $H^6$ terms that represent genuine quantum gravity effects. We demonstrate that these higher-order corrections become dynamically significant in the high-energy regime of cosmic inflation, naturally modifying the slow-roll dynamics without requiring a fundamental inflaton potential. A comprehensive phase-space analysis reveals that the quantum corrections drive early-time de Sitter-like attractors, providing a robust mechanism for sustained inflationary expansion. Confronting the model with the Swampland program, we show that the correction factor $\mathcal{F}(H)$ modifies the effective slow-roll parameters, enabling the model to satisfy the Swampland de Sitter and Distance conjectures during the inflationary epoch. We calculate the inflationary observables, including the spectral index $n_s$ and the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$, and demonstrate that the model's predictions are in excellent agreement with the Planck 2018 observational constraints. Our results suggest that thermodynamic duality-induced horizon corrections offer a viable and testable pathway for realizing successful inflation within a well-motivated quantum-gravitational framework.
summary:
我们研究了在存在从热力学对偶性原理导出的量子校正视界热力学的情况下，单模引力与幂律非线性电动力学耦合的早期宇宙宇宙学含义。通过结合对贝肯斯坦-霍金熵的对数和反面积修正，我们推导了修正的弗里德曼方程，展示了代表真正量子引力效应的新颖的 $H^4$ 和 $H^6$ 项。我们证明，这些高阶修正在宇宙暴胀的高能状态中变得动态显着，自然地改变慢滚动力学，而不需要基本的暴胀势。全面的相空间分析表明，量子修正驱动早期德西特吸引子，为持续的暴胀扩张提供了强大的机制。将该模型与 Swampland 程序对比，我们发现修正因子 $\mathcal{F}(H)$ 修改了有效的慢滚参数，使模型能够满足暴胀时期的 Swampland de Sitter 和 Distance 猜想。

我们计算了暴胀可观测值，包括谱指数 $n_s$ 和张量标量比 $r$，并证明该模型的预测与 Planck 2018 观测约束非常一致。我们的结果表明，热力学对偶性引起的视界修正为在良好的量子引力框架内实现成功的暴胀提供了可行且可测试的途径。

title: Resonant JPZ algebras and 3D Chern--Simons gravity
abstract: In this work we construct three-dimensional Chern--Simons gravity theories for the six resonant $JPZ$ algebras generated by the Lorentz generators $J_a$, translations $P_a$, and an additional Lorentz-like generator $Z_a$. The resonance condition together with the Jacobi identities leaves precisely six configurations arising from the semigroup expansions. Our main result is that three of them, $B_4$, $\widetilde C_4$, and $C_4$, are isomorphic to $iso(2,1)\oplus so(2,1)$, although they yield different gravitational realizations when we keep the original $JPZ$ field identification fixed. For each case $JPZ$, we determine the invariant tensors, gauge curvatures, Chern--Simons action, field equations, and the corresponding maximal-rank coupling sectors. The field equations can be written in the compact form $\Omega_\sigma\mathbf F=0$, which makes explicit how the additional field $h^a$ contributes to the curvature, torsion, and the remaining gauge-curvature components. We use the direct-sum isomorphisms to classify the local metric sectors and to relate them to known global and asymptotic solutions, while keeping the gravitational interpretation tied to the original $(\omega,e,h)$ fields.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们为洛伦兹生成器 $J_a$、平移 $P_a$ 和附加的类洛伦兹生成器 $Z_a$ 生成的六个共振 $JPZ$ 代数构建了三维 Chern-Simons 引力理论。共振条件与雅可比恒等式一起留下了由半群展开产生的精确六种配置。我们的主要结果是，其中三个 $B_4$、$\widetilde C_4$ 和 $C_4$ 与 $iso(2,1)\oplus so(2,1)$ 同构，尽管当我们保持原始 $JPZ$ 场标识固定时，它们会产生不同的引力实现。对于每种情况 $JPZ$，我们确定不变张量、规范曲率、Chern-Simons 作用、场方程和相应的最大秩耦合扇区。场方程可以写成紧凑的形式 $\Omega_\sigma\mathbf F=0$，这明确了附加场 $h^a$ 如何影响曲率、扭转和剩余的规范曲率分量。

我们使用直和同构对局部度量扇区进行分类，并将它们与已知的全局和渐近解联系起来，同时保持引力解释与原始 $(\omega,e,h)$ 字段的联系。

title: Beyond the circle: current algebras, geometry and higher gauge structures
abstract: Replacing the circle by a manifold leads to current Lie algebras and their central and derivation extensions. We separate the coefficient algebra, harmonic analysis and geometric data. Differentials modulo exact forms describe central extensions; divergence-free vector fields give explicit cocycles, whose compatible derivations satisfy a stabilizer equation. Compact examples include the three-sphere and its current--Virasoro extension. We also explain the analytic qualifications for SL(2,R) and its symmetric space and the role of transported multiplication in soft geometries. The recent harmonic constructions of Campoamor-Stursberg, Marrani and Rausch de Traubenberg are compared with the cohomological work of Coquereaux, Frappat, Ragoucy and Sorba and Castellani's loop geometry and infinite-dimensional free differential algebras. A coefficient-algebra construction connects currents to higher brackets and clarifies the additional requirements of a dynamical theory. For Lie algebras of order F, central extensions obey coupled binary and symmetric F-ary conditions, with explicit examples and obstructions.
summary: 用流形代替圆就得到了当前的李代数及其中心和推导扩展。我们将系数代数、调和分析和几何数据分开。微分模精确形式描述了中心扩展；无散向量场给出显式余循环，其兼容导数满足稳定方程。紧凑的例子包括三球体及其当前的 Virasoro 扩展。我们还解释了 SL(2,R) 及其对称空间的解析条件以及软几何中传输乘法的作用。 Campoamor-Stursberg、Marrani 和 Rausch de Traubenberg 的最新调和结构与 Coquereaux、Frappat、Ragoucy 和 Sorba 以及 Castellani 的环几何和无限维自由微分代数的上同调工作进行了比较。系数代数结构将电流连接到更高的括号，并阐明了动力学理论的附加要求。对于 F 阶李代数，中心扩张服从耦合二元和对称 F 元条件，并具有明确的示例和障碍。

title: Construction and geometric properties of the fuzzy $CP^3$ onion
abstract: We consider the matrix model of a seven-dimensional quantum space built from concentric fuzzy $CP^3$'s of increasing matrix size, and show that its continuum limit is the metric cone $C(CP^3)$ over $CP^3$, not flat $R^7$. Every ingredient is fixed before any comparison, so this geometry is a prediction rather than an input. The two geometries agree in the $s$ wave ($p=0$) but separate in the higher angular sectors (harmonics on $CP^3$ of degree $p\geq1$): in each sector tested, the spectrum of the free Laplacian converges at second order to that of the cone, and at 20480 layers the cone is matched to $1\times10^{-9}$ for $p\leq8$, whereas flat space misses by 8-18%. The free propagator converges to that of the cone at the same order, and heat diffusion reproduces the $r^6$ measure and the Bessel spectrum of the cone. The maps between neighbouring layers are obtained in closed form from the polar decomposition of the second-quantized Schwinger-boson lift, using a known operator identity, and coincide with the Kováčik-Tekel coefficient-copying prescription. For $CP^1$ the construction reduces, away from the outer boundary, to the Kováčik-Tekel fuzzy onion. Modes along the twistor fibre are exactly degenerate with the harmonics on $S^4$.
summary:
我们考虑由矩阵大小不断增加的同心模糊 $CP^3$ 构建的七维量子空间的矩阵模型，并表明其连续统极限是 $CP^3$ 上的度量圆锥 $C(CP^3)$，而不是平坦的 $R^7$。在进行任何比较之前，每种成分都是固定的，因此该几何形状是预测而不是输入。这两个几何形状在 $s$ 波 ($p=0$) 中一致，但在较高角度扇区中分开（$CP^3$ 上的谐波，度数为 $p\geq1$）：在每个测试扇区中，自由拉普拉斯算子的频谱在二阶处收敛于圆锥体的频谱，并且在 20480 层处，圆锥体与 $p\leq8$ 的 $1\times10^{-9}$ 匹配，而平坦空间则错过了8-18%。自由传播器以相同的阶数收敛到圆锥体的传播器，热扩散再现了圆锥体的 $r^6$ 测量和贝塞尔谱。相邻层之间的映射是使用已知的算子恒等式从第二量化施温格玻色子升力的极分解中以闭合形式获得的，并且与 Kováčik-Tekel 系数复制规定一致。对于 $CP^1$，结构从外部边界减少到 Kováčik-Tekel 模糊洋葱。

沿扭转光纤的模式与 $S^4$ 上的谐波完全简并。

title: Supersymmetric Observables from Surface Defect Anomalies in 4d and 6d SCFTs
abstract: We study the contributions of half-BPS surface defects to supersymmetric Casimir energy and the universal logarithmic term of supersymmetric Rényi entropy in four- and six-dimensional SCFTs. Using equivariant integration of defect anomaly polynomials and its extension to supersymmetric Rényi backgrounds, we obtain closed expressions for these observables in terms of defect 't Hooft anomalies. For Gukov--Witten defects preserving transverse rotations in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = 4$ super Yang--Mills theories, both observables depend on a single R-symmetry anomaly. For $\mathcal{N} = (0, 4)$ defects in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (1, 0)$ theories, additional terms arise from the gravitational anomaly. We provide complementary checks using chiral algebras, five-dimensional localization, and holographic probe branes at large $N$, while localized chiral fermions reproduce the gravitational-anomaly contributions. The framework also recovers Wilson-surface results in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (2, 0)$ theories.
summary: 我们研究了半 BPS 表面缺陷对四维和六维 SCFT 中超对称卡西米尔能量和超对称 Rényi 熵的通用对数项的贡献。使用缺陷异常多项式的等变积分及其对超对称 Rényi 背景的扩展，我们获得了这些可观测量在缺陷 't Hooft 异常方面的闭合表达式。对于在四维 $\mathcal{N} = 4$ super Yang--Mills 理论中保留横向旋转的 Gukov--Witten 缺陷，两个可观测量都依赖于单个 R 对称异常。对于六维 $\mathcal{N} = (1, 0)$ 理论中 $\mathcal{N} = (0, 4)$ 的缺陷，附加项是由引力异常产生的。我们使用手性代数、五维定位和大$N$的全息探针膜提供补充检查，同时局域手性费米子再现了重力异常贡献。该框架还恢复了六维 $\mathcal{N} = (2, 0)$ 理论中的威尔逊表面结果。

title: Geometry and holography of $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathrm{S}^2$: towards the field theory dual
abstract: We take a first step in identifying the superconformal quantum mechanics dual to supersymmetric AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ solutions. We focus on the Type IIB solutions of the form AdS$_2\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2\times\Sigma$ that preserve eight supercharges, with $\Sigma$ a two-dimensional space parametrised by $(x_1,x_2)$, and read off their brane content, a D1-D5-NS5 intersection with D3 and D7 flavour branes. We propose that their dual $\mathcal{N}=4$ quantum mechanics is organised over a two-dimensional lattice of cells in $\Sigma$. Namely, it consists of copies of the linear quiver along $x_1$ dual to the U(1)-invariant solutions of the class, one for each interval along $x_2$, with ranks given by the D1 and D5 charges of the corresponding cell. Its central charge agrees with the holographic one at leading order. We show that the family of SL$(2,\mathbb{R})$ non-Abelian T-duals of the AdS$_3\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2$ solutions of massive Type IIA supergravity, constructed in previous work, belongs to this class, as does the SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times$SU$(2)$ non-Abelian T-dual of AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$CY$_2$, and work both out in detail. For both we propose global completions that introduce additional D3 and D7 branes. Along $x_2$ we interpret the fundamental strings stretched between the colour branes and the additional D3 and D7 branes as baryon vertices. Finally, we extend this proposal from the non-Abelian T-duals to the solutions of the class whose defining functions factorise in $x_1$ and $x_2$, including those in which the AdS$_2$ and S$^2$ factors have the same warp factor.
summary:
我们迈出第一步，确定超共形量子力学对偶超对称 AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ 解。我们关注 AdS$_2\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2\times\Sigma$ 形式的 IIB 型解决方案，保留八个增压，其中 $\Sigma$ 是由 $(x_1,x_2)$ 参数化的二维空间，并读取其膜内容，即 D1-D5-NS5 与 D3 和 D7 风味膜的交集。我们提出，他们的对偶 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 量子力学是在 $\Sigma$ 的二维细胞晶格上组织的。也就是说，它由沿 $x_1$ 的线性颤动副本组成，该副本与该类的 U(1) 不变解对偶，沿 $x_2$ 的每个间隔都有一个副本，其等级由相应单元的 D1 和 D5 电荷给出。其中心电荷与主序的全息电荷一致。我们表明，在之前的工作中构造的 AdS$_3\times$S$^2\times$CY$_2$ 大规模 IIA 型超引力解的 SL$(2,\mathbb{R})$ 非阿贝尔 T 对偶族属于此类，SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times$SU$(2)$ 非阿贝尔 T 对偶也是如此AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$CY$_2$，并详细计算两者。

对于这两者，我们建议引入额外的 D3 和 D7 膜的全局完成。沿着 $x_2$，我们将颜色膜和附加的 D3 和 D7 膜之间拉伸的基本弦解释为重子顶点。最后，我们将这个建议从非阿贝尔 T-对偶扩展到定义函数因式分解 $x_1$ 和 $x_2$ 的类的解，包括那些 AdS$_2$ 和 S$^2$ 因子具有相同扭曲因子的解。

title: Giant Graviton Expansions from Symmetric Functions and Free Fermions
abstract: Giant graviton expansions express finite-rank corrections to supersymmetric indices in terms of indices for wrapped D3-branes. We give detailed algebraic proofs of two previously proposed relations for four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ $U(N)$ super-Yang--Mills theory. The first is the Gaiotto--Lee single-sum expansion of the full superconformal index, proved by Hall--Littlewood orthogonality and an elementary calculation of operator traces. The second is the symmetric double-sum expansion of the flavored Schur index, proved by factorizing its exact free-fermion mode product. We specify the analytic continuation of the brane indices and justify the sums coefficient by coefficient. The two proofs apply to different expansion prescriptions and do not establish the full three-species expansion of Imamura. We discuss the additional physical and mathematical questions raised by that expansion and by the modular properties of the Schur index.
summary: 巨引力子展开式以包裹的 D3 膜的指数表示对超对称指数的有限秩校正。我们对四维 $\mathcal N=4$ $U(N)$ super-Yang--Mills 理论给出了先前提出的两个关系式的详细代数证明。第一个是完全超共形指数的 Gaiotto-Lee 单和展开，由 Hall-Littlewood 正交性和算子迹线的基本计算证明。第二个是风味 Schur 指数的对称双和展开，通过分解其精确的自由费米子模式乘积来证明。我们指定膜指数的解析延拓，并通过系数证明总和系数的合理性。这两个证明适用于不同的扩展处方，并没有建立今村完整的三物种扩展。我们讨论由该扩展和 Schur 指数的模属性引起的额外物理和数学问题。

title: Black Strings and Black Holes: Worldsheet Spectra and Near-Extremal Limits
abstract: We study aspects of the Euclidean partition function of the $\frac{SL(2,\mathbb R)\times U(1)}{U(1)}$ gauged WZW model. The target space geometry is either a smooth horizonless geometry with a linear-dilaton asymptotic region, or the Horne--Horowitz black string, depending on which circles we unwind as the time-direction. We first study the worldsheet spectrum and obtain the character decomposition via the holonomy integrals. Next, we obtain the spacetime spectrum of the horizonless geometry by directly performing the unfolded modular integrals, and recover the Maldacena-Ooguri-Son spectrum in the ungauged limit. When the chirally charged three-dimensional black string is dimensionally reduced, the target space is instead a two-dimensional charged black hole. We study the near extremal regime of the black hole and black string. For the two dimensional black hole, we propose two candidate towers of states that produce the expected $\frac{3}{2}\log T$ of the AdS$_2$ throat from the worldsheet discrete series representation. These towers appear only below the temperature at which the full amplitude becomes divergent. We comment on the contribution of these states in the near-extremal limit of the full partition function.
summary:
我们研究 $\frac{SL(2,\mathbb R)\times U(1)}{U(1)}$ 计量 WZW 模型的欧几里得配分函数的各个方面。目标空间几何结构要么是具有线性膨胀渐近区域的平滑无水平几何结构，要么是霍恩-霍洛维茨黑弦，具体取决于我们在时间方向上展开的圆。我们首先研究世界表谱并通过完整积分获得字符分解。接下来，我们通过直接进行展开模积分获得无水平几何的时空谱，并恢复非计量极限下的Maldacena-Ooguri-Son谱。当手性带电三维黑弦降维时，目标空间变成二维带电黑洞。我们研究黑洞和黑弦的近极值状态。对于二维黑洞，我们提出了两个候选状态塔，它们根据世界表离散序列表示产生 AdS$_2$ 喉咙的预期 $\frac{3}{2}\log T$。这些塔仅在全振幅发散的温度以下出现。

我们评论这些状态在全配分函数的近极值极限中的贡献。

title: Carrollian Yang-Mills theories in the homogeneous temporal gauge
abstract: We quantize, in the homogeneous temporal gauge, both the electric and the magnetic Carrollian Yang-Mills theories with SU(N) gauge symmetry in the fundamental representation. We use the BRST method implemented in the path integral. We show that in the first case all the interaction vertices vanish, thus, giving a free theory. In the magnetic case, there are no loop contributions to the Green functions of the elementary fields --i.e., Green functions not involving composite operators-- and the only connected parts of such Green functions with a dependence on the coupling constant are the tree level contributions to the three and four point functions of the field $\xi_i$. We also show that in the magnetic case the Green functions involving only Wilson loops are trivial and not so in the electric case.
summary: 我们在齐次时间规范中量子化电学和磁学的卡罗尔杨-米尔斯理论，并在基本表示中使用 SU(N) 规范对称性。我们使用路径积分中实现的 BRST 方法。我们证明，在第一种情况下，所有相互作用顶点都消失了，从而给出了一个自由理论。在磁性情况下，对基本场的格林函数没有环路贡献，即不涉及复合算子的格林函数，并且此类格林函数依赖于耦合常数的唯一连接部分是对场 $\xi_i$ 的三点和四点函数的树级贡献。我们还表明，在磁性情况下，仅涉及威尔逊环的格林函数是微不足道的，而在电情况下则不然。

title: Imaginary HTEE: Probing Criticality and Coherence
abstract: We study the imaginary part of the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) in a charged asymptotically AdS$_5$ black-hole background whose dual field theory exhibits a critical point in the presence of a chemical potential $\mu$ and temperature $T$. Identifying the imaginary part of the HTEE with the imaginary part of the pseudoentropy, we derive an analytical expression for this quantity and investigate its behavior on the stable and unstable thermodynamic branches. We find that the imaginary HTEE vanishes in the uncharged limit and is induced entirely by a nonzero chemical potential, signaling the emergence of quantum coherence between the initial and final states. As the dimensionless ratio $\mu/T$ approaches its critical value, we obtain an inverse-square-root divergence in the derivative of the imaginary HTEE and extract the critical exponent $\theta_I = 1/2$ analytically. We further show that the same exponent governs the temperature response at fixed chemical potential. Our results establish the imaginary part of the HTEE as a non-local quantum-information probe of criticality in strongly coupled systems, and they imply that the initial and final states become maximally coherent at the critical point.
summary:
我们研究了带电渐近 AdS$_5$ 黑洞背景中的全息类时纠缠熵 (HTEE) 的虚部，其双场理论在化学势 $\mu$ 和温度 $T$ 存在的情况下表现出临界点。通过识别 HTEE 的虚部和赝熵的虚部，我们推导了该量的解析表达式，并研究了其在稳定和不稳定热力学分支上的行为。我们发现，假想的 HTEE 在不带电极限下消失，并且完全由非零化学势引起，这表明初始态和最终态之间出现了量子相干性。当无量纲比 $\mu/T$ 接近其临界值时，我们获得虚数 HTEE 导数的反平方根散度，并解析地提取临界指数 $\theta_I = 1/2$。我们进一步表明，相同的指数控制着固定化学势下的温度响应。

我们的结果将 HTEE 的虚部确立为强耦合系统中临界点的非局域量子信息探针，并且它们意味着初始状态和最终状态在临界点处变得最大相干。

title: Late-time electric screening in dS from EAdS loops
abstract: We compute the one-loop gauge-field two-point functions analytically in scalar QED on dS$_{d+1}$ for general dimension and scalar mass, using the EAdS reformulation of the in-in formalism arXiv:2007.09993 . The Dirichlet EAdS gauge field acquires a Schwinger-type mass, with its longitudinal mode supplied by a composite of charged scalars obeying opposite boundary conditions, while the Neumann mode remains protected by gauge invariance. In dS, the Dirichlet correction induces an anomalous dimension $\gamma_J$ for the boundary current and modifies the late-time falloff of the electric field. This bulk calculation reproduces the boundary multiplet-recombination result of arXiv:2509.18888 . Summing over the in-in contour branches gives the retarded dS bubble kernel, making direct contact with the Bros-Moschella framework. We establish a spectral Cutkosky rule that expresses the discontinuity of this kernel across the principal-series cut in the Casimir plane in terms of a two-particle cut, with both internal scalar lines placed on shell. Although the full bubble coefficient involves a ${}_7F_6$ hypergeometric function, the cut collapses to a closed product of Gamma functions and determines the complete non-local part of the kernel through a dispersion relation. Analytic continuation of the same cut reproduces the complete one-loop result for $\gamma_J$. In the complex Casimir plane, the loop-corrected Dirichlet photon appears as a pole on the second sheet and is therefore naturally interpreted as a dS resonance, or quasinormal mode, whose frequency is shifted at one loop.
summary:
我们使用 in-in 形式主义 arXiv:2007.09993 的 EAdS 重新表述，在 dS$_{d+1}$ 上的标量 QED 中分析计算单环规范场两点函数的一般维度和标量质量。狄利克雷 EAdS 规范场获得施温格型质量，其纵模由服从相反边界条件的带电标量复合材料提供，而诺依曼模仍然受到规范不变性的保护。在 dS 中，狄利克雷校正会引起边界电流的异常尺寸 $\gamma_J$ 并修改电场的后期衰减。此批量计算重现了 arXiv:2509.18888 的边界多重重组结果。对内向内轮廓分支求和得到延迟的 dS 气泡内核，与 Bros-Moschella 框架直接接触。我们建立了谱 Cutkosky 规则，以双粒子切割的形式表示该核在卡西米尔平面中主级数切割上的不连续性，两条内部标量线都放置在壳上。

虽然全气泡系数涉及${}_7F_6$超几何函数，但切割会塌陷为Gamma函数的闭积，并通过色散关系确定核的完整非局部部分。相同切割的分析延续再现了 $\gamma_J$ 的完整单循环结果。在复卡西米尔平面中，环路校正的狄利克雷光子在第二片上显示为极点，因此自然地被解释为 dS 共振或准正规模式，其频率在一个环路处发生偏移。

title: Energy, Passivity, and Diffusive Representations in Anisotropic Fractional Maxwell--Cole--Cole Media
abstract: This study develops an energy formulation for linear anisotropic Maxwell--Cole--Cole media with multiple fractional polarization channels, passive conductivity, prescribed currents, and finite-terminal Caputo memory with zero prehistory. A weighted solution class captures the integrable fractional initial layer generated by quiescent polarization. Fractional polarization power then separates into a nonnegative history storage and a nonnegative constitutive dissipation rate. Although the instantaneous rate may diverge at initialization, it remains integrable, while stored history energy and accumulated loss vanish initially. Combined with the Poynting theorem, this decomposition yields a global field-plus-memory identity that establishes electromagnetic passivity, closed-system energy decay, and conditional uniqueness under zero-supply boundary conditions. The framework also recovers the Debye, instantaneous-dielectric, vanishing-susceptibility, and vacuum limits under convergence assumptions. A positive diffusive representation provides a second decomposition whose storage never exceeds the history storage. Their difference is an exact nonnegative weighted variance that vanishes only for a zero polarization history. In agreement with these time-domain results, the finite-time harmonic response approaches the anisotropic multichannel Cole--Cole permittivity, whose Hermitian imaginary part ensures nonnegative cycle-averaged absorption. A reproducible single-channel study shows that fractional order broadens the dielectric-loss band, redistributes wave attenuation, strengthens the integrable initial power layer, and prolongs the step-response tail. An exact electric-step response verifies both energy representations. The formulation connects fractional initial layers, hereditary storage, passivity, diffusive relaxation, dispersion, absorption, and attenuation in a local constitutive model.
summary:
本研究开发了线性各向异性麦克斯韦-科尔-科尔介质的能量公式，该介质具有多个分数极化通道、无源电导率、规定电流和零史前的有限终端卡普托记忆。加权解类捕获由静态极化生成的可积分数初始层。然后分数极化功率分为非负历史存储和非负本构耗散率。尽管瞬时速率可能在初始化时发散，但它仍然可积，而存储的历史能量和累积损失最初消失。与坡印廷定理相结合，这种分解产生了全局场加记忆恒等式，该恒等式建立了电磁无源性、封闭系统能量衰减以及零电源边界条件下的条件唯一性。该框架还恢复了收敛假设下的德拜、瞬时介电常数、消失磁化率和真空极限。正扩散表示提供了第二次分解，其存储永远不会超过历史存储。

它们的差异是精确的非负加权方差，仅在零极化历史中消失。与这些时域结果一致，有限时间谐波响应接近各向异性多通道科尔-科尔介电常数，其埃尔米特虚部确保非负循环平均吸收。可重复的单通道研究表明，分数阶拓宽了介电损耗带，重新分布了波衰减，增强了可积分的初始功率层，并延长了阶跃响应尾部。精确的电阶跃响应验证了两种能量表示。该公式在局部本构模型中连接了分数初始层、遗传存储、无源性、扩散弛豫、色散、吸收和衰减。

title: Comment on "Landau Levels and Riemann Zeros"
abstract: Sierra and Townsend (ST) [1] showed that the ``absorption spectrum'' model of Connes [2] arises as the lowest-Landau-level (LLL) limit of a charged particle in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and suggested that the higher Landau levels supply the fluctuation part of the Riemann-zero counting function $N(E)$. Within the approximation used by ST we construct the eigenfunctions of an arbitrary Landau level $n$ and derive their asymptotics at the two box boundaries that ST identify. The boundary condition is the same as for $n=0$ up to an $E$-independent phase $(-\ii)^n$, so no $\ln E$ term arises for any fixed $n$. We also note that the $\ln E$ term in the semiclassical Eq.~(29) of ST is the first-order shift of the smooth LLL counting function, $E\to E+\gamma z^2$.
summary: Sierra 和 Townsend (ST) [1] 表明 Connes [2] 的“吸收谱”模型是带电粒子在交叉电场和磁场中的最低朗道能级 (LLL) 极限，并表明较高的朗道能级提供了黎曼零计数函数 $N(E)$ 的涨落部分。在 ST 使用的近似内，我们构造任意 Landau 级别 $n$ 的特征函数，并在 ST 识别的两个框边界处导出它们的渐近函数。边界条件与 $n=0$ 直至 $E$ 独立相 $(-\ii)^n$ 相同，因此对于任何固定的 $n$ 都不会出现 $\ln E$ 项。我们还注意到 ST 的半经典方程 ~(29) 中的 $\ln E$ 项是平滑 LLL 计数函数 $E\to E+\gamma z^2$ 的一阶移位。

title: Categorifying Quantum Spin Systems
abstract: We develop a homotopical framework for understanding the space of quantum spin systems based on topological $n$-nets, which assign associative unital algebras to local regions in an $n$-dimensional space in a manner that captures the locality structure of the underlying lattice theories. The net-theoretic perspective admits a natural categorification, in which the category of topological $n$-nets carries the structure of a higher Morita category. Moreover, the nets of greatest physical interest form a Karoubi-complete subcategory that shares many of the characteristic structural features of the category of finite TQFTs. Our main result identifies the group of locality-preserving symmetries of (3+1)-dimensional quantum spin systems (i.e. quantum cellular automata modulo stabilization, finite-depth quantum circuits, and translations) with the full Witt group of nondegenerate braided fusion categories, thereby answering a question posed by Haah.
summary: 我们开发了一个同伦框架，用于理解基于拓扑 $n$ 网络的量子自旋系统的空间，该框架以捕获底层晶格理论的局域结构的方式将关联单位代数分配到 $n$ 维空间中的局部区域。网络理论的观点承认一种自然的分类，其中拓扑$n$网络的范畴承载着更高的森田范畴的结构。此外，最具物理意义的网络形成了一个 Karoubi 完全子类别，它具有有限 TQFT 类别的许多特征结构特征。我们的主要结果确定了 (3+1) 维量子自旋系统（即量子细胞自动机模稳定、有限深度量子电路和平移）的保局性对称性组与非简并编织融合类别的完整维特组，从而回答了 Haah 提出的问题。

title: An Introduction to the $p$-Differential Forms in Spinor Variables on the Minkowskian Manifold
abstract: This article presents an introductory study of $p$-differential forms in spinor variables defined on the Minkowskian (or Lorentzian) manifold. Starting from the algebraic and geometric foundations of spinor spaces and Clifford algebras, we establish the correspondence between Minkowski spacetime and Hermitian matrices in spinor coordinates. Within this framework, we construct differential 1-forms and 2-forms expressed in spinor notation, and formulate the Dirac operator in terms of exterior calculus. Furthermore, we extend this approach to the case of non-monogenic functions, following the method proposed in~\cite{Jaramillo2024}. The results illustrate the consistency of the spinorial exterior calculus and its potential applications in the study of relativistic field equations and geometric formulations of quantum theory.
summary: 本文介绍了闵可夫斯基（或洛伦兹）流形上定义的旋量变量的 $p$-微分形式的介绍性研究。从旋量空间和克利福德代数的代数和几何基础出发，我们建立了明可夫斯基时空与旋量坐标下埃尔米特矩阵的对应关系。在此框架内，我们构造了用旋量符号表示的微分1-形式和2-形式，并用外微积分形式表述了狄拉克算子。此外，我们按照 ~\cite{Jaramillo2024} 中提出的方法将这种方法扩展到非单基因函数的情况。结果说明了旋外微积分的一致性及其在相对论场方程和量子理论几何公式研究中的潜在应用。

title: Inverse Resonance Problem for the Half-Line Schrödinger Operator with a Complex Robin Boundary Condition
abstract: We study the inverse resonance problem for the one-dimensional Schrödinger operator on the half-line with a compactly supported complex-valued potential and a complex Robin boundary condition \[ u'(0)-a u(0)=0,\qquad a\in\mathbb C. \] The proof follows the transformation-operator, entire-function, and Fourier analytic strategy developed by Marletta, Shterenberg and Weikard for the Dirichlet problem \cite{MSW}. The Dirichlet Jost function $\psi(z,0)$ is replaced by the Robin characteristic function \[ F_a(z;q)=\psi_x(z,0;q)-a\psi(z,0;q). \] We establish the corresponding large-energy estimates, Hadamard factorization, finite-data stability, and uniqueness results. The principal new feature is that $F_a(z;q)=iz-a+O(1)$ rather than $1+O(z^{-1})$. In the transformation-operator argument the relevant boundary quantity is $B_x(0,t)-aB(0,t)$, together with the scalar term $B(0,0)$. For fixed $a\in\mathbb C$, and uniformly for $a$ in bounded subsets of $\mathbb C$, the resulting inverse resonance estimates have the same qualitative form as those proved in \cite{MSW} for the Dirichlet problem. In particular, for a fixed Robin parameter $a$, the complete set of Robin eigenvalues and resonances, counted with multiplicity, determines the potential uniquely. The text is produced with the help of AI ChatGPT for Academy.
summary:
我们研究半线上的一维薛定谔算子的逆共振问题，具有紧支持的复值势和复杂的 Robin 边界条件 \[ u'(0)-a u(0)=0,\qquad a\in\mathbb C。 \] 证明遵循 Marletta、Shterenberg 和 Weikard 针对 Dirichlet 问题开发的变换算子、全函数和傅立叶分析策略 \cite{MSW}。 Dirichlet Jost 函数 $\psi(z,0)$ 被 Robin 特征函数 \[ F_a(z;q)=\psi_x(z,0;q)-a\psi(z,0;q) 替代。 \] 我们建立了相应的大能量估计、Hadamard 分解、有限数据稳定性和唯一性结果。主要的新功能是 $F_a(z;q)=iz-a+O(1)$ 而不是 $1+O(z^{-1})$。在变换运算符参数中，相关边界量是 $B_x(0,t)-aB(0,t)$，以及标量项 $B(0,0)$。对于固定的 $a\in\mathbb C$，以及统一地对于 $\mathbb C$ 有界子集中的 $a$，所得的逆共振估计具有与在 \cite{MSW} 中证明的狄利克雷问题相同的定性形式。

特别是，对于固定的 Robin 参数 $a$，完整的 Robin 特征值和共振集（以多重性计算）唯一地确定了势。该文本是在 AI ChatGPT for Academy 的帮助下生成的。

title: Yang-Mills Theory in the Multisymplectic Framework
abstract: This Master's thesis develops and applies the multisymplectic field-theory framework to (pure) Yang-Mills theory. Building from the geometric foundations of jet bundles and the Poincaré-Cartan forms, the work constructs the Lagrangian multisymplectic formalism for first-order field theories, recovering the usual Euler-Lagrange field equations and extending the Poisson brackets of symplectic mechanics to a full graded Lie algebra. It then establishes the Legendre correspondence with the multisymplectic Hamiltonian formalism (in which Hamilton equations are retrieved) including the case of singular Lagrangians (where a constraint algorithm is reproduced). Breaking Lorentz covariance via a Cauchy surface slicing, the thesis then relates the covariant multisymplectic picture to an instantaneous presymplectic (infinite-dimensional) formulation in which the instantaneous De Donder equations and presymplectic brackets are obtained in a compatible way. A comprehensive treatment of symmetries then leads to multisymplectic and instantaneous momentum maps generalizations and to several versions of Noether's theorems. Specializing the formalism to principal-bundle gauge theory, the thesis identifies the multisymplectic configuration space with the bundle of connections, gauge symmetries with symmetries in the multisymplectic language and builds the Yang-Mills Lagrangian. Lastly, among many computations, the standard tensorial Yang-Mills equations and the Bianchi identity in local trivializations are retrieved, Yang-Mills conserved currents and charges are obtained and the graded algebra is derived for a special class of Hamiltonian forms.
summary:
本硕士论文发展了多辛场论框架并将其应用于（纯）杨-米尔斯理论。该工作以喷流丛和庞加莱-嘉当形式的几何基础为基础，构建了一阶场论的拉格朗日多重辛形式主义，恢复了通常的欧拉-拉格朗日场方程，并将辛力学的泊松括号扩展到全分级李代数。然后，它与多重辛哈密顿形式主义（其中检索哈密尔顿方程）建立勒让德对应关系，包括奇异拉格朗日的情况（其中再现约束算法）。通过柯西曲面切片打破洛伦兹协方差，然后将协变多辛图像与瞬时预辛（无限维）公式联系起来，其中瞬时 De Donder 方程和预辛括号以兼容的方式获得。对对称性的综合处理导致了多重辛和瞬时动量图的概括以及诺特定理的几个版本。

论文将形式主义专门化为主丛规范理论，将多辛构型空间与联系丛、规范对称性与多辛语言中的对称性相识别，并建立了杨-米尔斯拉格朗日量。最后，在众多计算中，检索了标准张量Yang-Mills方程和局部平凡化中的Bianchi恒等式，获得了Yang-Mills守恒电流和电荷，并导出了一类特殊的哈密顿形式的分级代数。

title: Non-Intrusive Balancing for Data-Driven Model Reduction with Oblique Projections
abstract: Non-intrusive reduced-order modeling is essential for systems simulated with black- or gray-box solvers, yet computing accurate data-driven models remains challenging when the dynamics exhibit large-amplitude transient energy growth. This is because state-of-the-art non-intrusive methods typically rely on orthogonal projection onto high-energy linear or nonlinear manifolds identified by minimizing static reconstruction losses, which truncates low-energy, yet dynamically important, states. Intrusive methods such as Balanced Truncation and its extensions address this issue by using adjoint information to define dynamics-aware oblique projections. Here, we show that balancing-based oblique projections for nonlinear systems can instead be computed non-intrusively from forward simulation data. Specifically, we develop a framework to compute the nonlinear empirical reachability Gramian and balance it against its observability counterpart, projected onto a suitable restriction subspace. This procedure provably recovers the oblique projection of Balanced Truncation when the dynamics are linear and the range of either Gramian is contained in the restriction subspace. Moreover, in the linear case and in the absence of adjoint information, we show that the minimax-optimal restriction subspace spans the dominant eigenspaces of the reachability Gramian, which informs an efficient balancing algorithm with cost comparable to a standard SVD. Once the oblique projection is computed, we use Operator Inference to learn the latent-space dynamics on its range. The method is demonstrated on several examples of increasing complexity, including the three-dimensional incompressible flow past a wing with $8\times 10^7$ degrees of freedom. In all examples, the Balanced Operator Inference models significantly outperform their POD-based counterparts, reducing forecasting error by up to two orders of magnitude.
summary:
非侵入式降阶建模对于使用黑盒或灰盒求解器模拟的系统至关重要，但当动态表现出大幅瞬态能量增长时，计算精确的数据驱动模型仍然具有挑战性。这是因为最先进的非侵入性方法通常依赖于通过最小化静态重建损失来识别的高能线性或非线性流形的正交投影，这会截断低能量但动态重要的状态。平衡截断等侵入式方法及其扩展通过使用伴随信息来定义动态感知的倾斜投影来解决这个问题。在这里，我们表明非线性系统的基于平衡的倾斜投影可以通过正向仿真数据非侵入式地计算。具体来说，我们开发了一个框架来计算非线性经验可达性格拉米安，并将其与可观测性对应物进行平衡，投影到合适的限制子空间上。当动力学是线性的并且任一格拉米亚的范围包含在限制子空间中时，该过程可证明恢复平衡截断的斜投影。

此外，在线性情况下和缺乏伴随信息的情况下，我们表明极小极大最优限制子空间跨越了可达性 Gramian 的主要特征空间，这提供了一种高效的平衡算法，其成本与标准 SVD 相当。一旦计算出倾斜投影，我们就使用算子推理来学习其范围内的潜在空间动力学。该方法通过几个复杂性不断增加的示例进行了演示，包括通过具有 $8\times 10^7$ 自由度的机翼的三维不可压缩流。在所有示例中，平衡算子推理模型的性能均显着优于基于 POD 的模型，将预测误差减少了两个数量级。

title: From isolated singular wells to exact Bloch bands: the trigonometric Pöschl-Teller lattice
abstract: An exactly solvable lattice with periodic inverse-square singularities exhibits two physically distinct mechanisms of spectral-gap closure. The model arises from the generalized trigonometric Pöschl-Teller potential in the coupling range where both local solutions at each singularity are square-integrable. A transmitting, current-preserving self-adjoint matching condition connects neighboring cells and generates a nontrivial Bloch spectrum. For a generic lattice with two inequivalent singular sublattices, the spectrum contains two alternating families of gaps, and the band edges reproduce the scale-invariant spectra of the associated finite singular system. One gap family closes when the two sublattices become equivalent. In this symmetric limit, however, the primitive period halves, so the apparent band crossing results from Brillouin-zone folding. A different family closes at a critical but genuinely asymmetric configuration. Because the primitive period is preserved, adjacent bands then meet at the center of the original Brillouin zone in a genuine massless Dirac-like cone. Near either critical limit, a small finite gap acts as an effective Dirac mass: the dispersion remains quadratic near a band edge but crosses over to a massive Dirac-like form beyond that narrow region. The band curvatures define effective electron and hole masses. Exact Bloch eigenfunctions further reveal that isospectral lattices can display different single-particle probability densities. This model therefore provides an analytically controlled one-dimensional setting in which conventional quadratic carriers, massive Dirac-like band dispersions, and a tunable massless contact coexist within the same singular lattice.
summary:
具有周期性反平方奇点的精确可解晶格表现出两种物理上不同的光谱间隙闭合机制。该模型源自耦合范围内的广义三角 Pöschl-Teller 势，其中每个奇点处的两个局部解都是平方可积的。传输的、电流保持的自伴随匹配条件连接相邻单元并生成重要的布洛赫谱。对于具有两个不等价奇异子晶格的通用晶格，光谱包含两个交替的间隙族，并且能带边缘再现相关有限奇异系统的尺度不变光谱。当两个子晶格变得相等时，一个能隙族就会闭合。然而，在这个对称极限下，原始周期减半，因此明显的能带交叉是由布里渊区折叠引起的。另一个系列以关键但真正不对称的配置结束。由于原始时期被保留下来，相邻的能带随后在原始布里渊区的中心相遇，形成真正的无质量狄拉克状锥体。

在任一临界极限附近，一个小的有限间隙充当有效的狄拉克质量：色散在带边缘附近保持二次方，但在该狭窄区域之外交叉到一个巨大的类狄拉克形式。能带曲率定义了有效电子和空穴质量。精确的布洛赫本征函数进一步揭示了等谱晶格可以显示不同的单粒子概率密度。因此，该模型提供了一种分析控制的一维设置，其中传统的二次载流子、大规模狄拉克能带色散和可调谐无质量接触共存于同一奇异晶格内。

title: The Fröhlich Polaron at large total momentum in d=3
abstract: We consider the three-dimensional Fröhlich polaron at fixed coupling strength $\alpha>0$ and total momentum $P \in \bbR^3$. We show that the bottom of the spectrum reaches the essential spectrum at a finite value of $|P|$, implying that the fiber Hamiltonian has no ground state at sufficiently large total momentum. This extends the known weak-coupling result to arbitrary coupling. Our approach describes states near the spectral threshold by a fully interacting polaron with small residual momentum and one additional phonon carrying almost all of the total momentum.
summary: 我们考虑固定耦合强度 $\alpha>0$ 和总动量 $P \in \bbR^3$ 下的三维 Fröhlich 极化子。我们表明，光谱的底部在 $|P|$ 的有限值处达到基本光谱，这意味着纤维哈密顿量在足够大的总动量下不具有基态。这将已知的弱耦合结果扩展到任意耦合。我们的方法通过具有小残余动量的完全相互作用的极化子和携带几乎所有总动量的一个附加声子来描述接近光谱阈值的状态。

title: Using the Renormalized Energy from Ginzburg-Landau Theory to Compute Solution Landscapes in the Reduced Landau-de Gennes Theory
abstract: We study nematic liquid crystal phases confined to bounded, two-dimensional (2D) domains, in the reduced Landau-de Gennes (rLdG) theoretical framework. The rLdG framework is equivalent to the celebrated Ginzburg-Landau (GL) theoretical setting, under certain assumptions. In the asymptotic limit of large domains (or low temperatures), we recall the concept of the finite-dimensional renormalized energy in the GL theory [Bethuel et al., GL Vortices, Prog. Nonlinear Differ. Equ. Appl. 13, Birkhäuser, 1994.] and generalize it to polygons with sharp corners. The renormalized energy is fully defined by the triplet, $(\mathbf{a},\mathbf{c}, \mathbf{d}$), of topological degrees of the interior defects ($\mathbf{d}$) and the winding number contribution of polygon vertices ($\mathbf{c}$) and interior defect locations ($\mathbf{a}$), subject to sum rules dictated by the imposed Dirichlet boundary condition. We use the critical points of the renormalized energy to construct initial conditions for the rLdG solver, recover known energy-minimizing and non-energy minimizing saddle points of the rLdG energy on a disc, regular hexagon and rectangle along with the discovery of previously unreported rLdG solution branches. The renormalized energy approach is computationally substantially more efficient than a direct PDE-solver in the rLdG setting but misses solution branches with line defects and finite-size effects.
summary:
我们在简化的 Landau-de Gennes (rLdG) 理论框架中研究局限于有界二维 (2D) 域的向列液晶相。在某些假设下，rLdG 框架相当于著名的 Ginzburg-Landau (GL) 理论设置。在大域（或低温）的渐近极限中，我们回想起 GL 理论中有限维重正化能量的概念 [Bethuel 等人，GL Vortices，Prog.非线性差分。等式。应用。 13，Birkhäuser，1994。]并将其推广到具有尖角的多边形。重整化能量完全由内部缺陷 ($\mathbf{d}$) 的拓扑度的三元组 $(\mathbf{a},\mathbf{c}, \mathbf{d}$) 以及多边形顶点 ($\mathbf{c}$) 和内部缺陷位置 ($\mathbf{a}$) 的缠绕数贡献定义，并遵循强加的狄利克雷边界规定的总和规则条件。

我们使用重整化能量的临界点来构造 rLdG 求解器的初始条件，恢复圆盘、正六边形和矩形上已知的 rLdG 能量的能量最小化和非能量最小化鞍点，同时发现以前未报告的 rLdG 解分支。重整化能量方法在计算上比 rLdG 设置中的直接 PDE 求解器更有效，但会错过具有线缺陷和有限尺寸效应的解分支。

title: Superintegrable systems in curved spaces via coalgebras and deformed Racah algebras
abstract: We determine the Poisson algebras generated by partial Casimirs of undeformed and non-standard $q$-deformed $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$ coalgebras, respectively. The derivation is performed on the abstract algebraic level and does not depend on any particular symplectic realization. For the 3- and 4-site cases the constructions associated with the undeformed $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$ produce the rank-one and rank-two Racah Poisson algebras, respectively, while those with the non-standard deformed $\mathfrak{sl}$ yield finite quadratic Poisson algebras generated by connected partial Casimirs. At both the three and four sites, the final closure coefficients do not explicitly depend on the deformation parameter. The results hold at the Poisson coalgebra level and hence apply to any realizations which preserve the defining brackets and coproducts. Canonical symplectic realizations give rise to Hamiltonians in spaces of non-constant curvature. For the Stäckel $q$-deformed Smorodinsky-Winternitz model we show explicitly how the universal coalgebra sector is completed to maximal superintegrability. An exact two-block identity, proved directly in the localized Poisson algebra without appealing to a symplectic realization, controls the additional Stäckel integrals. In three dimensions, it generates a quadratic Poisson block with its own Casimir relation; in four dimensions, its coupling to the full left/right coalgebra family is organized into three nested quadratic blocks, and the same identity extends this nested coupling to arbitrary $N$. Explicit higher-site partial Casimirs and factorized bracket generators are collected in the appendices.
summary:
我们分别确定由未变形和非标准$q$变形$\mathfrak{sl}(2)$煤代数的部分卡西米尔生成的泊松代数。推导是在抽象代数层面上进行的，不依赖于任何特定的辛实现。对于 3 点和 4 点情况，与未变形 $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$ 相关的构造分别产生一阶和二阶 Racah 泊松代数，而与非标准变形 $\mathfrak{sl}$ 相关的构造则产生由连接的部分卡西米尔生成的有限二次泊松代数。在三个和四个位置处，最终的闭合系数并不明确取决于变形参数。结果在泊松余代数水平上成立，因此适用于保留定义括号和余积的任何实现。正则辛实现在非恒定曲率空间中产生哈密顿量。对于 Stäckel $q$ 变形的 Smorodinsky-Winternitz 模型，我们明确展示了通用余代数扇区是如何完成最大超可积性的。

精确的两块恒等式直接在局部泊松代数中证明，无需借助辛实现，控制着附加的 Stäckel 积分。在三维空间中，它生成具有自己的卡西米尔关系的二次泊松块；在四个维度中，它与完整左/右余代数族的耦合被组织成三个嵌套二次块，并且相同的恒等式将这种嵌套耦合扩展到任意 $N$。附录中收集了显式的较高位点部分卡西米尔和因式分解括号生成器。

title: Geometric bulk conductances in even dimensions
abstract: Let $P$ be a short-range projector on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}^{2n},\mathbb{C}^m)$ and $U=(U_1,\dots,U_{2n})$ be a transverse family of open subsets of $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$. We give an elementary proof of a recent result of Martinian-Stoiber, which extends a two-dimensional result of Drouot-Zhu to all even dimensions. Specifically, using only Stokes' theorem and the Poincaré lemma, we show that the geometric Kubo formula $\operatorname{Tr}\big(P[P,\mathbf{1}_{U_1}]\wedge\cdots\wedge[P,\mathbf{1}_{U_{2n}}]\big)$ is the product of a topological integer $\mathcal{X}_U$, which depends only on the relative positions of $U_1, \dots, U_{2n}$, and of the bulk conductance of $P$. Our proof writes the geometric bulk conductance as the pairing of $P$ with a cochain on $\mathbb{Z}^{2n}$ - an idea originally due to Kitaev - and deforms the cochain rather than the sets $(U_1, \dots, U_{2n})$. The proof presented in this paper is due to Claude Opus 5.5.
summary: 设$P$为$\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}^{2n},\mathbb{C}^m)$上的短程投影仪，$U=(U_1,\dots,U_{2n})$为$\mathbb{R}^{2n}$的开子集的横向族。我们给出了 Martinian-Stoiber 最近结果的基本证明，该结果将 Drouot-Zhu 的二维结果扩展到所有偶数维度。具体来说，仅使用斯托克斯定理和庞加莱引理，我们证明几何 Kubo 公式 $\operatorname{Tr}\big(P[P,\mathbf{1}_{U_1}]\wedge\cdots\wedge[P,\mathbf{1}_{U_{2n}}]\big)$ 是拓扑整数 $\mathcal{X}_U$ 的乘积，它仅取决于$U_1、\dots、U_{2n}$ 和 $P$ 的体电导的相对位置。我们的证明将几何体电导写为 $P$ 与 $\mathbb{Z}^{2n}$ 上的 cochain 的配对（这个想法最初是由 Kitaev 提出的），并且使 cochain 变形而不是集合 $(U_1, \dots, U_{2n})$。本文中提出的证明来自 Claude Opus 5.5。

title: Nested polynomial algebras and the exact spectrum of a three-dimensional two-spin oscillator
abstract: We construct representations of the symmetry algebra and derive the exact spectrum of a three-dimensional oscillator with two spin-$\tfrac12$ degrees of freedom. The Hamiltonian and its first-order scalar and pseudo-scalar integrals were obtained in earlier classifications. Here we determine their action on the complete spectral basis. At fixed total angular momentum, a quadratic algebra acts on the three triplet orbital channels and admits a three-dimensional deformed-oscillator representation, while an overlapping two-state exchange algebra joins the middle triplet to the singlet. These finite modules determine angular--spin multiplicities but do not quantize the radial energy. A separate positive-discrete-series $su(1,1)$ representation of the common radial Hamiltonian generates the energy sequence. We give the finite matrices, Casimir and structure functions, normalized eigenfunctions, radial ladder actions, the exceptional $j=0$ sector, complete energy-shell multiplicities, and the effect of particle interchange.
summary: 我们构造对称代数的表示，并导出具有两个自旋 $\tfrac12$ 自由度的三维振荡器的精确谱。哈密​​顿量及其一阶标量和伪标量积分是在早期分类中获得的。在这里，我们在完整的光谱基础上确定它们的作用。在固定的总角动量下，二次代数作用于三个三重态轨道通道并允许三维变形振荡器表示，而重叠的二态交换代数将中间三重态连接到单重态。这些有限模块确定角自旋多重性，但不量化径向能量。公共径向哈密顿量的单独正离散级数 $su(1,1)$ 表示生成能量序列。我们给出了有限矩阵、卡西米尔和结构函数、归一化本征函数、径向阶梯作用、特殊的 $j=0$ 扇区、完整的能量壳多重性以及粒子交换的效应。

title: Almost invariant subspaces in the topologically non-trivial setting: a pedestrian approach
abstract: We present a self-contained, algorithmic construction of almost invariant subspaces [Panati et al. (2003), De Nittis and Panati (2010), Freund and Teufel (2016)] for Hofstadter-like Hamiltonians $H_b $ acting on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}^2,\mathbb{C}^n)$. More precisely, for rational values of $b_0/(2\pi)$ we describe an iterative procedure that takes a ``locally gapped" projection $P_{0}$ (possibly topologically non-trivial) which commutes with $H_{b_0}$, into a projection $P_{\varepsilon}$ that commutes with $H_{b_0+\varepsilon}$ up to an error of order $\varepsilon^\infty$. Our construction insures that the Chern number of $P_{\varepsilon}$ equals the Chern number of $P_0$ as long as $P_\varepsilon$ exists. Moreover, its integrated density of states varies linearly with $\varepsilon$ (the ``Středa formula"). We also show that any spatially localized Parseval frame of $P_{0}$ can be mapped into to a localized Parseval frame of $P_{\varepsilon}$. We choose to work with a discrete model in order to keep the technicalities to a minimum level, with no need for advanced pseudo-differential calculus. Nevertheless, we are confident that most of our results can be extended to (unbounded) magnetic (pseudo)differential operators, but the technical burden would be much heavier. This is left for future work.
summary:
我们提出了一种几乎不变子空间的独立算法构造[Panati et al. (2003)、De Nittis 和 Panati (2010)、Freund 和 Teufel (2016)] 类似 Hofstadter 的哈密顿量 $H_b $ 作用于 $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}^2,\mathbb{C}^n)$。更准确地说，对于 $b_0/(2\pi)$ 的有理值，我们描述了一个迭代过程，该过程将与 $H_{b_0}$ 交换的“局部有间隙”投影 $P_{0}$ （可能拓扑上不平凡）转换为与 $H_{b_0+\varepsilon}$ 交换的投影 $P_{\varepsilon}$ ，直到阶数错误$\varepsilon^\infty$。只要 $P_\varepsilon$ 存在，我们的构造就确保 $P_{\varepsilon}$ 的陈数等于 $P_0$ 的陈数。此外，它的积分态密度随 $\varepsilon$ 线性变化（“Středa 公式”）。我们还表明，$P_{0}$ 的任何空间局部 Parseval 框架都可以映射到 $P_{\varepsilon}$ 的局部 Parseval 框架。我们选择使用离散模型，以便将技术细节保持在最低水平，而不需要先进的伪微分微积分。

尽管如此，我们相信我们的大部分结果可以扩展到（无界）磁（伪）微分算子，但技术负担会重得多。这留待以后的工作。

title: Willis-type thermal homogenization for particulate composites under harmonic heat transfer
abstract: This paper develops a Willis-type thermal homogenization framework for two-dimensional particulate composites under harmonic heat transfer and establishes a unique effective constitutive relation without introducing residual fields. The local thermal fields are obtained using the dual-reciprocity inclusion-based boundary element method, in which two eigen-fields are introduced to simulate the mismatches in thermal conductivity and heat capacity. Instead of retrieving effective kernels from several independent macroscopic solutions generated by residual fields, the complete constitutive operator is constructed upon relations between eigen-fields and generalized macroscopic responses. The effective constitutive relations are validated against a one-dimensional analytical solution and an extended Fourier-series homogenization scheme. The Fourier formulae further establish the opposite-wavenumber reciprocity relations between two coupling tensors and reflection-symmetry parity relations, which explain when transverse coupling components vanish and the sign reversal of off-diagonal conductivity components under reflection. Numerical results further demonstrate that the de-phased average is required to extract physically consistent effective thermal properties under the Bloch conditions, and reveal their nonlocal frequency/wavenumber-dependent behavior. The framework provides a general computational method for Willis-type homogenization of particulate composites and is extendable to three-dimensional, multiphysical problems.
summary:
本文开发了调和传热下二维颗粒复合材料的 Willis 型热均匀化框架，并在不引入剩余场的情况下建立了独特的有效本构关系。采用基于双互易包含的边界元方法获得局部热场，其中引入两个特征场来模拟热导率和热容的不匹配。完整的本构算子不是从残差场生成的几个独立的宏观解中检索有效核，而是根据特征场和广义宏观响应之间的关系构建。针对一维解析解和扩展的傅里叶级数均匀化方案验证了有效的本构关系。傅里叶公式进一步建立了两个耦合张量之间的相反波数互易关系和反射对称宇称关系，解释了横向耦合分量何时消失以及反射下非对角电导率分量的符号反转。

数值结果进一步证明，需要去相位平均值来提取布洛赫条件下物理一致的有效热特性，并揭示它们的非局部频率/波数相关行为。该框架为颗粒复合材料的威利斯型均质化提供了通用计算方法，并且可扩展到三维多物理问题。
